using Micros.PosCore.DataStore.DbRecords;
using PosCore.Check.Operations.Extensions;
using PosTransaction.Abstractions.Interfaces.CheckDetail;
using PosTransaction.Abstractions.Interfaces.Definitions.Composites;
using PosTransaction.Abstractions.Interfaces.GuestCheck;
using System;
using System.Linq;
using PosTransaction.DiscountEngine.Definitions;
using PosTransaction.DiscountEngine.Source;

namespace PosCore.Check.Operations.Discount
    // Class is used to support the AddAutomaticDiscountsToCheck delegate that the discount engine supports
    // This class is not my favorite but elimination of duplicate code trumps my dislike by a wide margin
    internal class AutomaticDiscountHelper
        private Action<DiscountInfo> _setOpsSpecificData = null; // only used by POS Operations see OPS\Ops\State\CheckSession.cs
        private IGuestCheck _guestCheck;
        private IDiscountConfigurationProvider _configurationProvider;

        public AutomaticDiscountHelper( IGuestCheck guestCheck, IDiscountConfigurationProvider configuration, Action<DiscountInfo> setOpsSpecificData )
            _guestCheck = guestCheck;
            _configurationProvider = configuration;
            _setOpsSpecificData = setOpsSpecificData;

        public void AddAutomaticDiscountsToCheck( DEProcessor engine  )
            foreach ( DEDiscountSpecification discount in engine.Results.Discount )
                if ( discount.MenuItems.Count == 0 )
                    continue;                               //Sanity check - should never happen.

                DiscountInfo discountInfo = new DiscountInfo()
                    Def = discount.DiscountDef,
                    Count = 1,
                    Seat = 0
                };

                discountInfo.Taxes = _configurationProvider.TaxClasses.FirstOrDefault( txClass => txClass.ObjectNumber == discount.DiscountDef.TaxClassObjNum );

                if ( discountInfo.Taxes == null )
                    discountInfo.Taxes = new DbTaxClass();

                discountInfo.Count = discount.DiscountCount();
                discountInfo.Percent = discount.DiscountDef.Percentage;
                discountInfo.Total = -discount.DiscountTotal;
                discountInfo.EmplMealId = new DbKey.EmployeeID( discount.RunTimeData.EmployeeMealId );
                discountInfo.EmployeeMealObjectNumber = discount.RunTimeData.EmployeeMealObjNum;
                discountInfo.Reference = discount.RunTimeData.RefNum;
                discountInfo.Seat = 0;                       //This is what Simphony 1.0 does. What else can we do?
                discountInfo.OwnerDetailLink = discount.RunTimeData.DetailLink;

                discountInfo.FixupDiscountSigns( discount.DiscountTotal );

                _setOpsSpecificData?.Invoke( discountInfo );

                var dbDscDetail = new DbDiscountDetail( discountInfo, _guestCheck.TransactionStateInterface.IUwsDef.GetPrintOptionBits( _configurationProvider.PrintClasses.FirstOrDefault( pc => pc.ObjectNumber == discountInfo.Def.PrintClassObjNum ) ) );
                dbDscDetail.AutoDiscount = true;

                foreach ( DEMenuItemSpecification miData in discount.MenuItems )
                    DiscountAllocation item = new DiscountAllocation();
                    item.MenuItemDetail = miData.MenuItemDetail as DbMenuItemDetail;      //Simphony 2.8 Safety/optimization
                    item.Total = miData.DiscountTotal;

                    //2.4: SCR 6242: Emergency fix to be ported to Starbucks Hot Fix to support inclusive tax reporting on automatic
                    //               discounts. The Discount Engine should but doesn't do these calculations
                    //item.IncludesMenuItemTax = miData.ForgivesInclTax;          //Discount Engine nevers sets
                    //item.InclusiveTax = miData.IncludedTax;                     //Discount Engine nevers sets

                    if ( _guestCheck.IDetail.GetItemFromDetailLink( miData.MenuItemDetail.DetailLinkDe ) is IMenuItemDetail miDtl )
                        DiscountMenuItem miInfo = DiscountSupportBase.GetRemainingDiscountable( _guestCheck, discount.DiscountDef, discountInfo.Taxes.ITaxes, miDtl, _configurationProvider.Discounts );

                        if ( miInfo.AmountGreaterThanZero )
                            item.IncludesMenuItemTax = miInfo.DiscountForgivesInclusiveTax;
                            item.InclusiveTax = DiscountSupportBase.CalculateInclusiveTax( miInfo, item, _guestCheck.TransactionStateInterface.ICurrencyParameters.BaseCurrencyScaleFactor );

                    dbDscDetail.DiscAllocations.Add( item );      //Add discount allocation for parent menu item

                _guestCheck.AddDiscountAsParent( dbDscDetail );
                if ( !string.IsNullOrEmpty( discountInfo.Reference ) )
                    _guestCheck.AddNewReference( dbDscDetail, discountInfo.Reference );

using System;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Micros.PosCore.Common;
using Micros.PosCore.DataStore;
using Micros.PosCore.DataStore.DbRecords;
using Micros.EGatewayHandlerCommon;
using SimphonyUtilities.Common;
using System.Linq;
using Micros.PosCore.Common.Classes;
using Micros.PosCore.Text;
using Micros.Ops.PosCoreText;
using PosTransaction.Abstractions.Common;
using PosTransaction.Abstractions.Interfaces.CheckDetail;
using PosTransaction.Constants;

namespace Micros.PosCore.Checks

    //TODO: Add check info and team info support.
    //TODO: FUTURE: Simphony 1.0 is ignoring Mi options 41 and 42 regarding consolidation of menu items
    //      with condiments for order devices. One of these bits is also copied to str_dtl.status
    //      as mi_dtl.type_def wasn't big enough in a 9700 version!
    //TODO: FUTURE: RES has options to sort all condiments or just the allowed condiments.

    public class CheckDetailSorter
        //TPID 107773 | v-ikottachchi | collection required for adding decorators
        private List<int> mDecorationsAdded = null;

        public CheckDetailSorter()
            //TPID 107773 | v-ikottachchi | collection required for adding decorators
            mDecorationsAdded = new List<int>();

        // TP#79791/79790/79789:
        internal bool CheckPickUp = false;
        internal bool NeedToNotifyChkDtlAreaAfterOrderTypeInfoChange = false;

        //2.3: Added to sort the internal contents of a Combo Meal
        public CheckDetailSorter(DbMenuItemDetail mi): this()
            mSingleMenuItemToSort = mi;

        List<SortedDetailBase> List = new List<SortedDetailBase>();

        public CheckDetailFormatOverride CheckDetailFormatOverride = null;
        //public SortedCheckParameters CheckParam = null;

        private SortAndConsolidateParameters mParameters;
        private CheckDetail mCheckDetail;
        private DataStoreClient mDS;
        private GuestCheck guestCheck;
        private IComparer<SortedDetailBase> mParentSorter;
        private CondimentSorting mCondimentSorter;
        private int mBaseCurrencyDp;
        public NumberFormatInfo mNumFmtInfo;
        private DbMenuItemDetail mSingleMenuItemToSort = null;

        private bool mSortAllowedCondimentsOnly;  // 130527 | gwelivita | Flag to determine when sort only allowed condiments
        private int mPreviousRoundParentCount = 0;
        private int mLastRoundParentCount = 0;

        internal bool SortBySeat;
        public int Seat { get; set; }

        private uint TestTicks(ref uint startTicks)
            uint endTicks = (uint)Environment.TickCount;
            uint result = endTicks - startTicks;
            startTicks = endTicks;
            return result;

        //89691 | v-ikottachchi | 12-14-2015 | Decorator group lists
        private Dictionary<int, DbDiningCourse> mDiningCourses;
        private Dictionary<int, DbMajorGroup> mMajorGroups;
        private Dictionary<int, DbFamilyGroup> mFamilyGroups;

        //The caller is expected to pass in fully configured sorting and consolidation requirements.
        public void Sort(SortAndConsolidateParameters parameters, GuestCheck check, DataStoreClient datastore,
                          int baseCurrencyDp, out List<SortedDetailBase> list, NumberFormatInfo numFmtInfo)
            //Detailed timings
            uint ticks = (uint)Environment.TickCount;
            uint initTime = 0;
            uint addTime = 0;
            uint assocTime = 0;

            mParameters = parameters;
            mCheckDetail = check.Detail;
            mDS = datastore;
            guestCheck = check;
            mBaseCurrencyDp = baseCurrencyDp;
            mParentSorter = null;
            mCondimentSorter = null;
            mNumFmtInfo = numFmtInfo;

            switch (mParameters.Sorting.SortType)
                //#8146 - Pass the KDSCourseSorting parameter onto the Sorting delegates.
                case SortingType.NoSort:
                        if (mParameters.KDSCourseSorting)
                            mParentSorter = new SortingByDiningCourse();
                            //89691 | v-ikottachchi | 12-14-2015 | Retrieve the list of dining courses
                            mDiningCourses = mDS.GetDiningCourseList (parameters.CurrentLangId);
                        break;
                case SortingType.Seat: mParentSorter = new SortingBySeat(mParameters.KDSCourseSorting); break;
                case SortingType.PrintGroup: mParentSorter = new SortingByPrintGroup(mParameters.KDSCourseSorting); break;
                case SortingType.SeatAndPrintGroup: mParentSorter = new SortingBySeatAndPrintGroup(mParameters.KDSCourseSorting); break;
                case SortingType.PrintGroupAndSeat: mParentSorter = new SortingByPrintGroupTypeAndSeat(mParameters.KDSCourseSorting); break;
                case SortingType.MajorGroup: mMajorGroups = mDS.GetMajorGroupList (parameters.CurrentLangId); break; //89691 | v-ikottachchi | 12-14-2015 | Retrieve the list of major groups
                case SortingType.FamilyGroup: mFamilyGroups = mDS.GetFamilyGroupList (parameters.CurrentLangId); break; //89691 | v-ikottachchi | 12-14-2015 | Retrieve the list of family groups

             if (mParameters.Sorting.SortType == SortingType.PrintGroup ||
                 mParameters.Sorting.SortType == SortingType.PrintGroupAndSeat ||
                 mParameters.Sorting.SortType == SortingType.SeatAndPrintGroup ||
                 mParameters.Sorting.CondimentSortType == CondimentSortType.AllCondimentSort ||
                 mParameters.Sorting.CondimentSortType == CondimentSortType.AllowedCondimentSort) // 130527 | gwelivita | Sort all the condiments
                mCondimentSorter = new CondimentSorting();

            // 130527 | gwelivita | Sort only the allowed condiments
            if (mParameters.Sorting.CondimentSortType == CondimentSortType.AllowedCondimentSort)
                mSortAllowedCondimentsOnly = true;

            if (mParameters.ViewBySeat && !guestCheck.FilteringActive)
                AddSeatDecoration(guestCheck.Seat);
                AddSeatDecoration(guestCheck.GetNextAvailableSeat());

            if (mParameters.SeatFilteringActive)
                AddSeatFilteringIndicatorText();

            //For the display, only sort previous round items.
            if (mSingleMenuItemToSort != null)
                AddMenuItem(null, mSingleMenuItemToSort, 1, null);  //2.3: Combo Meal optimization
            else if (mParameters.Masking.StartRoundNumber > 0)

                //FPS-5868 PORT - Check details are missing on the printout of void closed check, check reference is wrong.
                //FPS-5869 PORT - 137325 | Printing|Voids on Guest Checks and Receipts are not printing
                //Below if condition is for Guest check printing where voided items are not included in case of voided closed check operation and also
                //during rounds, voided items are not included on guest check printing.

                //FPS-1452 164971 | Replacing a Combo Placeholder is voiding and resending the entire combo, not just the Placeholder and its replacement item
                //Changed the Order of items to be added on sorted list for proper consolidation.
                //Consolidation is expecting voided items first and current round items next for prepare the consolidated items out of this list.

                //FPS-7070 : EMC | Format Parameters | Option 16 - Print Void Line on Checks is not printing void(s) correctly and causing overprinting on slip printer
                //Option bit 16 CSH content was wrong and removed a condition to add voided items if option bit 16 enabled.
                //Now, every time voided items will be added to list except the option bit 51 disabled(FPS-1000) for ClosedCheckVoids.
                if (!check.ClosedCheckVoid || mParameters.Masking.IncludeVoidItemsOnVoidedClosedCheck)
                    AddVoidedItems(parameters);

                //TP 142381 | shfaiz | Obtain only the active menu items to be fired the remaining items during the service total
                AddParentDetail(mCheckDetail.GetActiveParentListByRound(mParameters.Masking.StartRoundNumber, mParameters.Masking.EndRoundNumber));

            else if (mParameters.Masking.IncludeCurrentRoundOnly)
                //TP 142381 | shfaiz | Obtain only the active menu items to be fired the remaining items during the service total
                //92207 | GetCurrentRoundParentListForPrint() method returns only the menu items which are not
                //already being Held or Timed Fire. But in this case we need to have all the menu items to decide
                //if the each item needs to go to the Order Device.
                //
                // TPID 131969 Validation printing was not including menu items and service charges because
                // the hold and fire code had already set the items to ItemHasFired so the fix is that if we are sorting for the
                // display ignore the WantsToBeFired setting on the detail item. The code makes sense here anyway because
                // if you are sorting for the display and only want to see current round items you don't care if they have
                // fired to the Remote Order Devices. You want to see them on the display. [12/2/2016 ckgough]

                //TODO: Surely the check should be whether for order device or not!
                //IEnumerable<CheckDetailItem> detailToSelect = mParameters.Device.IsOrderDevice() ?
                //    mCheckDetail.GetActiveCurrentRoundParentList() : mCheckDetail.GetActiveCurrentRoundParentListForOrderDevicePrinting();

                //FPS-5868,5869. Moved include void items related lines to common method for re-using for including void items on guest check and cust receipts.

                //FPS-1452 164971 | Replacing a Combo Placeholder is voiding and resending the entire combo, not just the Placeholder and its replacement item
                //Changed the Order of items to be added on sorted list for proper consolidation.
                //Consolidation is expecting voided items first and current round items next for prepare the consolidated items out of this list.
                AddVoidedItems(parameters);

                IEnumerable<CheckDetailItem> outputDetailItems = mCheckDetail.GetActiveCurrentRoundParentList();
                //cgough https://hgbu.oracle.com/jira/browse/FPS-16855 sending partial items off a combo meal does not fire to the order device but is flagged as being sent.
                if ( mParameters.Device.IsOrderDevice() )
                    var outputItemPlusOrphans = mCheckDetail.GetActiveCurrentRoundParentListForOrderDevicePrinting().ToList();
                    // TP 146418 | We have Combo Sides that may need to be fired but their parents have already gone to the kitchen, which means they won't show up in the
                    // detailToSelect list. So we are going find all of the detail sides and check to see if we find any orphans.

                    // Get Parent Detail Links
                    var parentDetailLinks = outputItemPlusOrphans.Select( d => d.DetailLink ).ToList();
                    // Get Side items that want to fire where we don't find your parent detail link. This is an orphan. If the parent fired then it already got the children.
                    var orphanedSides = mCheckDetail.GetActiveCurrentRoundComboSidesListForOrderDevicePrinting().Where( sideItem => !parentDetailLinks.Contains( sideItem.ParentDetailLink ) );
                    // Add Orphans
                    outputItemPlusOrphans.AddRange( orphanedSides );
                    // Assign the Enumerable and off you go
                    outputDetailItems = outputItemPlusOrphans;

                AddParentDetail(outputDetailItems);

            else if (mParameters.Sorting.SortPreviousRoundsOnly)
                //Need to get previous rounds and last rounds separately so they can be sorted and consolidated
                //separately. This is for the display possibly for repeat last round functionality).
                AddParentDetail(mCheckDetail.GetPreviousRoundButNotLastRoundParentList());
                mPreviousRoundParentCount = List.Count;

                AddParentDetail(mCheckDetail.GetLastRoundParentList());
                mLastRoundParentCount = List.Count - mPreviousRoundParentCount;
            else if (mParameters.Sorting.SortRefillableItemsOnly)
                AddParentDetail(mCheckDetail.GetRefillableItemList(guestCheck.RoundNumber).Cast<CheckDetailItem>());
            else
                IEnumerable<ICheckDetailItem> detailsList = null;
                //140409 | Memo | Adding a menu item from OPS for selected seat of s MEMO check will display all the menu items attached to other seats as voided in KDS
                //140360 | Memo | Voiding a menu item from a MEMO check will display in KDS as all the other menu items attached to other seats as voided
                //When creating Suborder to send to KDS need to ignore seat filter. Otherwise details items assign to other seats will be display as void items.
                if (parameters.IsForKds)
                    detailsList = mCheckDetail.GetParentListIgnoringSeatFilter().Cast<ICheckDetailItem>();
                else
                    detailsList = mCheckDetail.GetActiveParentList();

                AddParentDetail(detailsList.OfType<CheckDetailItem>());

            if (List.Count > 0)
                CheckDetailConsolidator consolidator = new CheckDetailConsolidator(mParameters, List, mDS, mBaseCurrencyDp, numFmtInfo);

                //Do before sorting so we have less items to sort (possibly) and before the order of the items changes.
                if (parameters.Masking.IncludeCurrentRoundOnly)
                    consolidator.RemoveItemsMovedToCurrentRoundButNotChanged();

                SortParents();

                //Sort previous round condiments
                if (!mParameters.Sorting.SortCurrentRoundCondiments && !mParameters.IsForOrderDevice)
                    if (mCondimentSorter != null)
                        SortCondiments(mCondimentSorter);

                AssociateDiscounts();

                //TODO: FUTURE: OPTIMIZATION: If need to sort and consolidate by round, we should pass
                //in lists by round rather than have the consolidator try and consolidate different rounds and
                //have to check for a round match. This would reduce the number of loop iterations.
                consolidator.Consolidate();

                if (mParameters.ViewFireTimes)
                    AddDecorationOrderedTimes();

            //For the display, append the current round items without sorting or consolidation
            if (mParameters.Sorting.SortPreviousRoundsOnly && mParameters.Masking.StartRoundNumber == 0 && mSingleMenuItemToSort == null)
                initTime = TestTicks(ref ticks);
                AddParentDetail(mCheckDetail.GetCurrentRoundParentList().OfType<CheckDetailItem>());
                addTime = TestTicks(ref ticks);
                AssociateDiscounts();
                assocTime = TestTicks(ref ticks);

            //Live sorting of discount coupons
            MoveDiscountCouponsToTop();
            uint moveDiscsTime = TestTicks(ref ticks);

            //Live sorting of condiments on the display.
            if (mParameters.Sorting.SortCurrentRoundCondiments ||
                 mParameters.Sorting.CondimentSortType == CondimentSortType.AllCondimentSort ||
                 mParameters.Sorting.CondimentSortType == CondimentSortType.AllowedCondimentSort)
                    SortCondiments(mCondimentSorter);

            //Live rollup of combo meal side prices into parents
            RollupComboMealPrices();

            list = List;

            //Log detailed timings.
            uint doneTime = TestTicks(ref ticks);
            string s = "Init: " + initTime.ToString() + " Add: " + addTime.ToString() + " Assoc: " + assocTime.ToString() + " MoveDisc: " + moveDiscsTime.ToString() + " Done: " + doneTime.ToString();
            LogUtils.LogDetailFlow(s, LES.EGateway.EGatewayAppParams.LOG_ZONE_INDEX.POSCORE);

        private void AddVoidedItems(SortAndConsolidateParameters parameters)
            //TP146686|Yaswanth|Order Device Output | Void is not sent to Order Devices when Menu Item from previous round is modified.
            //Removed the code from KDS specific section as this should be applicable for Ordered devices as well.
            //Simphony 3.0: Colin: Moved the void check here.
            if (parameters.Masking.IncludeCurrentRoundVoids && !parameters.Masking.ExcludeVoidedItems)

                if (parameters.Masking.IncludeVoidItemsOnVoidedClosedCheck)
                    IEnumerable<CheckDetailItem> voidedItems = mCheckDetail.GetCurrentRoundTotalVoidedList();
                    if (voidedItems.Count() > 0)
                        AddParentDetail(voidedItems);
                else
                    //TP146686|Yaswanth|Order Device Output | Void is not sent to Order Devices when Menu Item from previous round is modified.
                    //Reading the voided items from the current round to be sent to KDS
                    //FPS-93790 | PARTCHAT | Apart from voided menu items, voided discounts, service charges and tender media also need to be added to the check journal.
                    //Voided discounts, service charges and tender media are not needed for order device printer output.
                    IEnumerable<CheckDetailItem> voidedItems = mParameters.IsForJournal ? mCheckDetail.GetCurrentRoundTotalVoidedList() : mCheckDetail.GetCurrentRoundVoidedList();

                    if (voidedItems.Count() > 0)
                        AddParentDetail(voidedItems);

                // FPS-1171.  Add current round voided service charges if we are producing a validation slip
                if (parameters.Masking.IncludeVoidValidation)
                    var voidedService = mCheckDetail.GetCurrentRoundVoidedServiceChargeList().ToList().ConvertAll( d => (CheckDetailItem)d);
                    if (voidedService.Any())
                        AddParentDetail(voidedService);

        //TODO: FUTURE: ComboMeals: Add parent only unless parent not included in sort.
        //TODO: FUTURE: Fixed Price Meals: Add parents only unless parent not included in sort.
        private void AddParentDetail(IEnumerable<CheckDetailItem> detailList)
            //Scan through the check detail looking for items to add.
            foreach (CheckDetailItem item in detailList)
                //TP 16190 - Hide unflagged items.
                if (!item.CanDisplay)
                    // FPS-15775 | Equal Payment | Include change due details to calculate actual payment amount on Guest Checks and Receipts
                    if (!(mParameters.Device.IsGuestCheckOrCustomerReceipt() && item.IsChange()))
                        continue;

                if (mParameters.Masking.ExcludeVoidedItems && item.LineNumVoid)
                    continue;

    class TenderMediaNlu : TenderMediaBase

        protected override CommandResult RunCommand()

            int nluNumber = 0;

            // If NLU key was used but no NLU number was entered, we need to
            // prompt for a selection.
            if (KeyboardData.IsEmpty)
                Input.SelectionRequest req = new Micros.Ops.Input.SelectionRequest(new Dictionary<long, Micros.Ops.Input.SelectionRequestEntry>());
                req.Init(OP.Text, ETitlesIds.TenderMedia, EPromptsIds.SelectTenderMedia);

                IEnumerable<DbTenderMedia> tenderMedias = ListTmedWithNlu().Values;

                if (tenderMedias == null || tenderMedias.Count() == 0)
                    return new CommandResult(EErrorIds.NoItemsFoundForNLU);

                // it is possible for two tenders to have the same NLU and be active on the same level(s).
                // because of this, we need to create a sorted list here by NLU, and add or replace entries
                // based on the tender with the lowest object number.
                SortedList<int, DbTenderMedia> listByNlu = new SortedList<int, DbTenderMedia>();

                foreach (DbTenderMedia tm in tenderMedias)
                    if (CheckTmedMenuLevels(tm).IsFailed)
                        continue;

                    if (tm.Nlu == 0)
                        continue;

                    if (!listByNlu.ContainsKey(tm.Nlu))
                        listByNlu.Add(tm.Nlu, tm);
                    else
                        DbTenderMedia existingTm = listByNlu[tm.Nlu];

                        // if the object number of the item in the loop is lower
                        // than the one already in the list, replace it
                        if (tm.ObjectNumber < existingTm.ObjectNumber)
                            listByNlu[tm.Nlu] = tm;

                DbRvcFormatParameter fm = CS.TransState.RvcParm.Format;

                //146355 | NLU screen sort type does not get applied when the sort type is set via Format Parameters
                //Sort menu items according to format parameters.
                if ((NLUSortType)fm.HelpSort == NLUSortType.Alphabetical)
                    tenderMedias = listByNlu.Values.OrderBy(tmd => tmd.Name.GetString(CS.CurrentLangId)).ToList();
                else if ((NLUSortType)fm.HelpSort == NLUSortType.Numerical)
                    tenderMedias = listByNlu.Values.OrderBy(tmd => tmd.Nlu).ToList();

                // now add
                foreach (DbTenderMedia tm in tenderMedias)
                    req.Add(tm.Nlu, tm.Name);

                if (req.Entries.Count == 0)
                    return new CommandResult(EErrorIds.NoItemsFoundForNLU);

                // Run request.
                OP.RunRequest(req);

                if (req.SelectedEntry == null)
                    return CommandResult.Cancelled;

                nluNumber = (int)req.SelectedEntry.Number;
            else
                if (KeyboardData.Read(out nluNumber, 1, CommonConstants.MaxTmedNluNumber, OP.OpsNumberFormatInfo))
                    KeyboardData.Clear();
                else
                    KeyboardData.Clear();
                    return KeyboardData.LastReadResult;

            if (nluNumber == 0)
                return new CommandResult(EErrorIds.TenderMediaNotFound);   //TODO is this the right error?

            TenderInfo tmedInfo = new TenderInfo();
            CommandResult result = ReadTmedByNLU(nluNumber, tmedInfo);
            if (result.IsFailed)
                return result;

            result = BaseRunCommand(tmedInfo);
            OP.OptionallyPopUpOperatorAfterTransaction(EXT_OPS::OpsSignOutPreviewEventArgs.SignOutEventRaisedFrom.TenderMedia, tmedInfo.ObjectNumber);          //SCR 5597: call moved here as was firing prematurely.
            return result;

        private CommandResult ReadTmedByNLU(int nluNumber, TenderInfo tmedInfo)
            var list = DS.ReadTenderMediaByNlu(nluNumber, OP.TransactionState.RvcId);

            if (!list.Any())
                return new CommandResult(EErrorIds.TenderMediaNotFound, DS.LastDataStoreResult);

            // it is possible for multiple records to have the same nlu and be active on the same levels.
            // because of this, we need to create this sorted list (by object number) and then iterate
            // over this. this is the legacy behavior - if two have the same nlu, the lowest obj num wins.
            SortedDictionary<int, DbTenderMedia> sorted = new SortedDictionary<int, DbTenderMedia>();

            foreach (DbTenderMedia tender in list)
                sorted[tender.ObjectNumber] = tender;

            // find the first one with the nlu that is active.
            foreach (DbTenderMedia t in sorted.Values)
                if (CheckTmedMenuLevels(t).IsSuccess)
                    tmedInfo.TmedDef = t;
                    tmedInfo.ObjectNumber = tmedInfo.TmedDef.ObjectNumber;

                    if (tmedInfo.TmedDef.ChargedTipNumber != 0)
                        tmedInfo.SetChargeTipServiceDef(tmedInfo.TmedDef.ChargedTipNumber, DS, OP.CurrentWsRvcId);

                    return CommandResult.Success;
            return new CommandResult(EErrorIds.TenderMediaNotFound);

        //TODO the DB should provide this
        SortedList<int, DbTenderMedia> ListTmedWithNlu()
            SortedList<int, DbTenderMedia> result = new SortedList<int, DbTenderMedia>();

            foreach (DbTenderMedia tm in DS.ReadAllTenderMedia(OP.TransactionState.RvcId))
                if (tm.Nlu != 0)
                    result.Add(tm.ObjectNumber, tm);
            return result;

    //---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    class TenderMedia : TenderMediaBase
        protected override CommandResult ValidateCommandNumber()
            return ValidateNumberRange(1, CommonConstants.MaxObjectNumber, EErrorIds.OutOfRangeTenderNumber);

        protected override CommandResult RunCommand()
            int tmedNumber = (int)InitiatingCommand.Number;

            TenderInfo tmedInfo = new TenderInfo();
            tmedInfo.CashoutPickupTransaction = (bool)InitiatingCommand.CashoutPickupTransaction;
            CommandResult result = ReadTmedByNumber(tmedNumber, tmedInfo);
            if (result.IsFailed)
                return result;

            result = BaseRunCommand(tmedInfo);
            //If check suspend failed; do not sign out
            if (result.IsSuccess)
                OP.OptionallyPopUpOperatorAfterTransaction(EXT_OPS::OpsSignOutPreviewEventArgs.SignOutEventRaisedFrom.TenderMedia, tmedInfo.ObjectNumber);            //SCR 5597: call moved here as was firing prematurely.

            return result;

        private CommandResult ReadTmedByNumber(int tmedNumber, TenderInfo tmedInfo)
            tmedInfo.TmedDef = DS.ReadTenderMediaByNum(tmedNumber, OP.TransactionState.RvcId);
            if (tmedInfo.TmedDef == null)
                return new CommandResult(EErrorIds.TenderMediaNotFound, DS.LastDataStoreResult);

            //86165 | gwelivita | Send Order not allowed with waste checks. Display an error message if the check is a waste one.
            if (tmedInfo.TmedDef.SendOrder && CS.GuestCheck.IsWasteActive)
                return new CommandResult(EErrorIds.InvalidWasteEntry);

            tmedInfo.ObjectNumber = tmedInfo.TmedDef.ObjectNumber;

            if (tmedInfo.TmedDef.ChargedTipNumber != 0)
                tmedInfo.SetChargeTipServiceDef(tmedInfo.TmedDef.ChargedTipNumber, DS, OP.CurrentWsRvcId);

            return CheckTmedMenuLevels(tmedInfo.TmedDef);

    //---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    //---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    abstract class TenderMediaBase : CommandHandlerBase
        protected override bool AllowedWithNoTransaction() { return true; }
        protected override bool AllowedInVoidMode() { return true; }
        protected override bool AllowedInEqualPaymentMode() { return true; }

        protected override CommandResult AllowCommand()
            // 4/25/2011 FYan SCR 4731: "No transaction in progress" error reported when performing a tender of type Pickup or Loan
            // Payment and Service Total will override this later with TestTransFullyStartedAndIdle, etc.
            CommandResult result = TestState(TestValidSalesLevel |
                                TestNotItemWeighed |
                                TestCashierActive);
            if (!result.IsSuccess)
                return result;

            result = ParentDetailIsComplete(); // SCR 4423 Don't allow discount/ service charge / authorization / payment with a condiment required [5/2/2011 cgough]
            return result;

        protected override bool ModifiesOpenClosedCheckState() { return true; }

        private bool ShouldValidateBeverageControl(TenderInfo tmedInfo)
            if (CS.LineFlags.TF_FIRE_NOW_TMED)
                return false; // This is a send and stay thing beverage control is not appropriate.

            return tmedInfo.TmedDef.TendMedType != TenderTypes.TmedPaymentType && tmedInfo.PaymentData == null && !tmedInfo.TmedDef.SendOrder;

        private bool cfdEmailSent = false;
        private bool cfdEmailCancelled = false;

        protected CommandResult BaseRunCommand(TenderInfo tmedInfo)
            CommandResult result = CommandResult.Cancelled;
            //TPID# 48511 - OPS | SIM | PMS | @checkData is not populated anymore with the final tender event
            //When TenderMedia type is Payment, Check's closing status will be saved in this variable.
            bool checkClosed = true;
            AppOfflineInfo info = new AppOfflineInfo(OP);

            if (CS.GuestCheck.FilteringActive)
                if (!tmedInfo.TmedDef.PrintMemoChk)
                    OpsLogger.LogDetailFlow(() => "Tender Media - Memo check printing not activated");
                    return new CommandResult(EErrorIds.MemoPrintingNotActivated);

                //Simphony 18.2 restriction until we add seat printing support to the Quebec SRM code
                if (OP.TransactionState.PropertyParm.General.EnableQuebecSRM && !CS.GuestCheck.IsWasteActive && !(OP.DebugQuebecSrm > 2))
                    OpsLogger.LogDetailFlow(() => "Tender Media - Memo check printing not supported for Quebec SRM");
                    return new CommandResult(EErrorIds.MemoPrintingQuebecSRM);

                // No need to filter since ther's only one seat left
                //TP #153174 - Anoop - We need to reset the seat filter if this is last seat(s) in the memo check getting tendered
                //Till now we were closing the original check if the last seat getting tendered = 1,
                //if there are more than 1 seats and they are the last seats on check then also we have to close the original check
                //Comparing with the seat filter count and open seats count,
                //if they are same that means after tendering filtered seats there are no seats left
                if (tmedInfo.TmedDef.TendMedType == TenderTypes.TmedPaymentType)
                    if(CS.GuestCheck.GetSeatsInDetail().Count == CS.GuestCheck.Detail.SeatFilter.Count)
                        //Utility.SetMemoCheckGuestCount(CS);
                        CS.GuestCheck.ResetSeatFilter();
                        // Set print count to 0, so that would not appear in the check
                        CS.GuestCheck.PrintCount = 0;

                    if(!info.IsOffline && CS.GuestCheck.DiningTableID != 0)
                        //FPS-89087 | PARTCHAT | Before memo tendering, check that next group number will be available. Otherwise, the memo tendering will "succeed"
                        //but the check won't be written to the DB.
                        var rvcId = new DbKey.RevCtrID(CS.GuestCheck.TransState.RvcId.Value);
                        var diningTableId = new DbKey.DiningTableID(CS.GuestCheck.DiningTableID.Value);

                        PosCoreResult pcr = PostTotals.GetNextGroupNumberForTableCheck(info, OP.PostingInterface, rvcId, diningTableId, out List<int> groups);

                        if (!pcr.IsSuccess)
                            return new CommandResult(EErrorIds.GroupsNotAvailableForTable);

            // Check the employee's privilege to use this tender/media key.
            // Authorization will be skip, if its been verified in payment module.
            TransactionPrivileges tp;
            if (!tmedInfo.PrivilegeAuthorizion)
                if (GetTmedTransactionPrivilege(tmedInfo.TmedDef, out tp))

    public class JournalFormatter
        //Simphony 2.8: Cash Management: Changed to allow OPS to create and use a real object.
        private TransactionState mTransState;

        private List<string> mDataLines = new List<string>();

        const int LINE_WIDTH = 40;     //Historical value when journal was sent to a printer but also allows reporting to show in a chit style.

        internal event EventHandler Intercept;

        private void ClearLists()
            mHeaderLines.Clear();
            mDataLines.Clear();

        /// <summary>
        ///     Get next transaction number.
        /// </summary>
        internal static int GetNextTransNum(TransactionState transState)
            if (transState == null)
                return 9999;        //We should never get here!

            CGwGetNextTransNumRequest req = new CGwGetNextTransNumRequest();
            req.mWorkstationID = transState.WorkstationId;

            CGwGetNextTransNumResponse resp = new CGwGetNextTransNumResponse();
            PosCoreResult pcr = transState.PostingInterface.SendLocally(EMsgTypes.MSG_GET_NEXT_TRANS_NUMBER, req, resp, ref resp.mReturnCode);
            if ( pcr.IsFailed || resp == null )
                //For some reason the call failed (probably a major database issue). This is extremely unikely but need to continue so use a local in-memory
                //copy of the transaction number.
                transState.UwsDef.NextTransNumber++;
                return transState.UwsDef.NextTransNumber;

            transState.UwsDef.NextTransNumber = resp.TransactionNumber;       //Save a local copy of the the number in case of database issues.
            return resp.TransactionNumber;

        #region CGwJournalLogEntry data object init methods

        /// <summary>
        ///     Simphony 2.8: Encapsulated
        /// </summary>
        private static void SetEntryFromTransState( CGwJournalLogEntry cgwJnlLogEntry, TransactionState transState, JournalType type )
            cgwJnlLogEntry.mUwsDbId = transState.WorkstationId;
            cgwJnlLogEntry.mRvcDbId = transState.RvcId;

            //Not set if no-one is signed in.
            if( transState.EmployeeSession.EmployeeSignedIn )
                cgwJnlLogEntry.mEmplDbId = transState.EmployeeId;

            cgwJnlLogEntry.mTransTime = DateTime.UtcNow;
            cgwJnlLogEntry.mCheckOpenTime = cgwJnlLogEntry.mTransTime;   //default time if no check.

            cgwJnlLogEntry.mType = (byte)type;

            cgwJnlLogEntry.mStatus = new byte[ 1 ];
            cgwJnlLogEntry.mStatus[ 0 ] = 0;

            cgwJnlLogEntry.mRequestGuid = Guid.NewGuid();

        /// <summary>
        ///     Simphony 2.8: Encapsulated
        /// </summary>
        private static void SetCMEntryFromTransState(CGwCMJournalLogEntry cgwJnlLogEntry, TransactionState transState, JournalType type)
            cgwJnlLogEntry.mUwsDbId = transState.WorkstationId;
            cgwJnlLogEntry.mRvcDbId = transState.RvcId;

            //Not set if no-one is signed in.
            if (transState.EmployeeSession.EmployeeSignedIn)
                cgwJnlLogEntry.mEmplDbId = transState.EmployeeId;

            cgwJnlLogEntry.mTransTime = DateTime.UtcNow;
            cgwJnlLogEntry.mCheckOpenTime = cgwJnlLogEntry.mTransTime;   //default time if no check.

            cgwJnlLogEntry.mType = (byte)type;

            cgwJnlLogEntry.mStatus = new byte[1];
            cgwJnlLogEntry.mStatus[0] = 0;

            cgwJnlLogEntry.mRequestGuid = Guid.NewGuid();

        /// <summary>
        ///     Simphony 2.8: Encapsulated
        /// </summary>
        private static void SetEntryFromCheck( CGwJournalLogEntry cgwJnlLogEntry, GuestCheck check )
            if ( check == null )
                cgwJnlLogEntry.mGuid = new CGwDruid(); // zero guid
            else
                cgwJnlLogEntry.mRvcDbId = check.RevenueCenterID;
                cgwJnlLogEntry.mCheckNum = check.CheckNumber;
                cgwJnlLogEntry.mCheckOpenTime = check.CheckOpenTime;

                if ( check.CheckOpenTime == DateTime.MinValue )
                    cgwJnlLogEntry.mCheckOpenTime = DateTime.UtcNow;

                cgwJnlLogEntry.mGuid = CgwDruidExt.StringToCGwDruid( check.Guid  );

        private void GenerateNonSalesJournalEntry( CGwJournalLogEntry cgwJnlLogEntry, JournalType type, int transactionNumber )
            cgwJnlLogEntry.mJournalID = transactionNumber;

            SetEntryFromTransState( cgwJnlLogEntry, mTransState, type  );
            cgwJnlLogEntry.mGuid = new CGwDruid();

        private void GenerateCMNonSalesJournalEntry(CGwCMJournalLogEntry cgwJnlLogEntry, JournalType type, int transactionNumber)
            cgwJnlLogEntry.mJournalID = transactionNumber;

            SetCMEntryFromTransState(cgwJnlLogEntry, mTransState, type);
            cgwJnlLogEntry.mGuid = new CGwDruid();

        //TODO: Used by check discarded code that doesn't have access to TransState? This needs to be changed to fix the TODO below yesterday and simplify the code
        private static void GenerateNonSalesJournalEntry( CGwJournalLogEntry cgwJnlLogEntry,
                                                          DbKey.RevCtrID rvcDbId,
                                                          long emplDbId,
                                                          DbKey.WorkstationID wsId,
                                                          JournalType type,
                                                          byte status,
                                                          int checkNum,
                                                          DateTime checkOpenTime,
                                                          CGwDruid checkGuid )
            try
                cgwJnlLogEntry.mJournalID = GetNextTransNum(null);      // TODO: BryCarey - Need to deal with this null and actually update the database with the proper NextTransNum
                cgwJnlLogEntry.mUwsDbId = wsId;
                cgwJnlLogEntry.mRvcDbId = rvcDbId;
                cgwJnlLogEntry.mEmplDbId = emplDbId;

                if( checkNum <= 0 || checkGuid == null )
                    cgwJnlLogEntry.mGuid = new CGwDruid();
                else
                    cgwJnlLogEntry.mGuid = checkGuid;

                SetCommonDataInEntry( cgwJnlLogEntry, type, status, checkNum, checkOpenTime );
            catch( Exception e )
                LogException( e, "non sales" );
                cgwJnlLogEntry = null;

        /// <summary>
        ///     Encapsulated common code
        /// </summary>
        private static void SetCommonDataInEntry( CGwJournalLogEntry cgwJnlLogEntry, JournalType type, byte status, int checkNum, DateTime checkOpenTime )
            cgwJnlLogEntry.mCheckNum = checkNum;
            cgwJnlLogEntry.mTransTime = DateTime.UtcNow;
            cgwJnlLogEntry.mType = (byte)type;

            // If the check time is bogus (i.e. there is no check ), use the trans time to avoid problems
            // with this non-nullable field in the DB.  The db datetime type doesn't like dates before 1753.
            cgwJnlLogEntry.mCheckOpenTime = (checkOpenTime.Year > 2000) ? checkOpenTime : cgwJnlLogEntry.mTransTime;
            cgwJnlLogEntry.mStatus = new byte[ 1 ];
            cgwJnlLogEntry.mStatus[ 0 ] = status;

            cgwJnlLogEntry.mRequestGuid = Guid.NewGuid();

        /// <summary>
        ///     Populate CGwJournalLogEntry object.
        /// </summary>
        private void GenerateSalesJournalEntry( CGwJournalLogEntry cgwJnlLogEntry, JournalType type, int transactionNumber, GuestCheck check )
            try
                cgwJnlLogEntry.mJournalID = transactionNumber;

                //TODO_FUTURE: Combine these 2?
                SetEntryFromTransState( cgwJnlLogEntry, mTransState, type );
                SetEntryFromCheck( cgwJnlLogEntry, check );
            catch( Exception e )
                LogException( e, "sales" );

        #endregion CGwJournalLogEntry data object init methods

        #region Journal formatter methods

        /// <summary>
        /// Log no sale journal.
        /// </summary>
        internal void LogNoSaleJournal( ref CGwJournalLogEntry entry, string reasonName, string sessionID,int drawerNumber)
            ClearLists();

            entry = new CGwJournalLogEntry();
            GetNoSaleEntry(entry, null /*GuestCheck*/, EJournalIds.NoSale, JournalType.NoSale, reasonName, sessionID,drawerNumber);

--- Common/PosCore/Printing/GuestCheckPrinting.cs
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Text;
using Micros.PosCore.Common;
using Micros.PosCore.DataStore;
using Micros.PosCore.Posting;
using EXT_OPS = Micros.PosCore.Extensibility.Ops;
using Micros.EGatewayHandlerCommon;

namespace Micros.PosCore.Printing
    class GuestCheckPrinting
        public delegate bool Print2ndCheckQuestion( System.Enum e );

        /// <summary>
        ///     Called when we have to print
        /// </summary>
        internal static bool ForcePrint( GuestCheckPrintParameters parameters )
            bool printed = false;
            PrintDefinitions printDefs = GetPrintDefinitions( parameters );

            PrintGuestCheck printer = new PrintGuestCheck( parameters, printDefs );
            printer.ConfigureForForcedPrint();

            PrintJob job;
            printer.CreatePrintJob( out job );

            if ( job != null )
                int printCount = GetPrintCount( parameters );              //Let script decide how many to print (default 1)
                if ( printCount > 0 )
                    if (parameters.FormatOnly)
                        parameters.FormattedJob = job;
                    else
                        PrintManager.SubmitUnsupervisedJob(job, false, printCount);
                        printed = true;

            //119956 Update flag depending on the print status
            if (printed && job.QuebecFiscalDocument)
                printed = PrintManager.WaitForPrintJobToComplete( parameters, job );

            if ( printed )
                parameters.IncrementPrintCountAndSetPageNumberLineNumber( job );

            return printed;

        /// <summary>
        ///     Called when we have to get check standard header
        /// </summary>
        internal static IList<string> ForceGetCheckStandardHeader(GuestCheckPrintParameters parameters)  // #62782: Make SIM easily access to rows of Check Header
            // CE not support IList<string> checkHeaderLines = new string[MAX_CHECK_HEADER_LINES]{...}
            IList<string> checkHeaderLines = new List<string>();

            PrintDefinitions printDefs = GetPrintDefinitions(parameters);

            PrintGuestCheck printer = new PrintGuestCheck(parameters, printDefs);
            printer.ConfigureForForcedPrint();

            PrintJob job;
            printer.GetCheckFormatHeader(out job);

            int lineWidth = 40;
            for(int i = 0; i < job.PrintData.Count; i++)
                if(job.PrintData[i] is PrintJobDataLine)
                    PrintJobDataLine line = (PrintJobDataLine)job.PrintData[i];
                    checkHeaderLines.Add(line.mstrLine.PadRight(lineWidth));

            return checkHeaderLines;

        /// <summary>
        ///     Called when we have to get check standard trailer
        /// </summary>
        internal static IList<string> ForceGetCheckStandardTrailer(GuestCheckPrintParameters parameters) // #62782: Make SIM easily access to rows of Check trailer
            // CE not support IList<string> checkTrailerLines = new string[MAX_CHECK_TRAILER_LINES]{...}
            IList<string> checkTrailerLines = new List<string>();

            PrintDefinitions printDefs = GetPrintDefinitions(parameters);

            PrintGuestCheck printer = new PrintGuestCheck(parameters, printDefs);
            printer.ConfigureForForcedPrint();

            PrintJob job;
            printer.GetCheckFormatTrailer(out job);

            int lineWidth = 40;
            for(int i = 0; i < job.PrintData.Count; i++)
                if(job.PrintData[i] is PrintJobDataLine)
                    PrintJobDataLine line = (PrintJobDataLine)job.PrintData[i];
                    checkTrailerLines.Add(line.mstrLine.PadRight(lineWidth));

            return checkTrailerLines;

        /// <summary>
        ///     Called when printing is based on configuration settings.
        /// </summary>
        //  FPS-1090 | sugandik | Added skipIfSlipPrinter parameter to check if the printer is a slip printer and to skip the guest check printing
        internal static bool Print( GuestCheckPrintParameters parameters,
                                   out PrintJob onDemandCustomeReceiptPrintJob,
                                   Print2ndCheckQuestion print2ndCheckQuestion,
                                   System.Enum e,
                                   bool tfCurCnvActive, bool skipIfSlipPrinter = false )
            //If we have saved the last customer receipt for an on-demand print, now is the time to get rid of it.
            onDemandCustomeReceiptPrintJob = null;
            bool printed = false;

            int startIndex = Micros.LES.MWS.Utils.StopWatch.GetInstance().DtlTimingStart( "CheckSession.PrintGuestCheck" );
            CStartAndEndLogger logger = new CStartAndEndLogger( "Print Guest Check", Micros.LES.EGateway.EGatewayAppParams.LOG_ZONE_INDEX.POSCORE );

            PrintDefinitions printDefs = GetPrintDefinitions( parameters );
            PrintGuestCheck printer = new PrintGuestCheck( parameters, printDefs );

            // FPS-1090 | sugandik | do not print the guest check if the printer is a slip printer and skipIfSlipPrinter is set to true...
            if (skipIfSlipPrinter)
            // guest check printing would fail at the time of autofire if the printer is a slip printer..
            // Hence, skipping it!
                if (printer.IsSlipPrinter())
                logger.End();
                return printed;

            if ( !parameters.PrintInfo.GuestCheck.PaidInFull && tfCurCnvActive )
                parameters.PrintInfo.GuestCheck.ForeignAmountDue = parameters.PrintInfo.ConvertCurrency( parameters.PrintInfo.GuestCheck.TotalDue, true /*baseToForeign*/ );

            parameters.PrintInfo.GuestCheck.TF_DUPLICATA_QUEBECSRM = parameters.Duplicata; //SCR 4267

            //Allow script/user to print their own subheader, detail or summary totals.
            //TODO: Do we do this for Round By Round printing (we should)?
            //if ( parameters.DbTenderMediaDef.PrintCustRcpt || parameters.DbTenderMediaDef.PrintCheckOnDemand )
            //#40466 - always call this when printing
            SetCustomPrinting(parameters, printer);

            bool onDemand;
            bool isCustReceipt;
            PrintJob job;
            printer.CreatePrintJob( out job, out onDemand, out isCustReceipt );
            if ( job != null )
                if ( isCustReceipt )
                    //Clone the print job so we don't copy any data that may get updated as a result of a print failure (SendPrintingRc and PrinterIndex)
                    //on the original print job.
                    onDemandCustomeReceiptPrintJob = job.GetCopy();

                if ( parameters.Reprint )
                    PrintManager.SubmitUnsupervisedJob( job, false );
                    printed = true;
                else if ( !onDemand )
                    int printCount = GetPrintCount( parameters );              //Let script decide how many to print (default 1)
                    if ( printCount > 0 )
                        // Print num checks requesed  - usually one
                        PrintManager.SubmitUnsupervisedJob( job, false, printCount );

                        // Print optional second copy if configured in tender media.
                        Print2ndGuestCheck( parameters, job, print2ndCheckQuestion, e );
                        printed = true;

            //119956 Getting Status of Job and updating flag accordingly
            if ( printed && job.QuebecFiscalDocument )
                printed = PrintManager.WaitForPrintJobToComplete( parameters, job );

            if ( printed )
                parameters.IncrementPrintCountAndSetPageNumberLineNumber( job );

            Micros.LES.MWS.Utils.StopWatch.GetInstance().DtlTimingStop( startIndex, "CheckSession.PrintGuestCheck" );
            logger.End();
            return printed;

        const int CHECK_IMAGE_LINE_WIDTH = 40;
        //Added for SIM support
        public static string GetCheckImage( GuestCheckPrintParameters parameters, int langId, bool CheckTransactionIsActive )
            List<string> lines = new List<string>();
            GetCheckImage( parameters, langId, CheckTransactionIsActive, lines );

            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder( CHECK_IMAGE_LINE_WIDTH * (1+lines.Count) );

            foreach( string s in lines )
                sb.AppendLine( s.PadRight( CHECK_IMAGE_LINE_WIDTH ) );

            return sb.ToString();

        internal static void GetCheckImage( GuestCheckPrintParameters parameters, int langId, bool CheckTransactionIsActive, List<string> lines )
            GetCheckImage( parameters, langId, CheckTransactionIsActive, lines, null );

        //Simphony 2.8: Broke above method into 2 for re-use.
        //98251 | Overloaded method to support Journals for Timed Fire items to seperate them from getting re-sorted.
        internal static void GetCheckImage( GuestCheckPrintParameters parameters, int langId, bool CheckTransactionIsActive, List<string> lines, List<int> fireRequestedHeldItemsOrTimedFiredDetailLinks )
            if ( CheckTransactionIsActive == false )
                return;

            PrintDefinitions printDefs = GetPrintDefinitions( parameters );
            if ( 0 < langId )
                printDefs.LangId = langId;

            PrintGuestCheck printer = new PrintGuestCheck( parameters, printDefs );
            PrintJob printJob;
            printer.CreateJournalPrintJob( out printJob, fireRequestedHeldItemsOrTimedFiredDetailLinks );

            if ( printJob == null )
                return;

            for ( int i = 0; i < printJob.PrintData.Count; i++ )
                if ( printJob.PrintData[i] is PrintJobDataLine )
                    PrintJobDataLine line = ( PrintJobDataLine )printJob.PrintData[i];
                    lines.Add( line.mstrLine );
                //106044 Belgian Tax Label - umacherl
                //Adding empty lines for SIM/Extensibility in case of LINEFEED
                else if (printJob.PrintData[i] is PrintJobDataDirective)
                    PrintJobDataDirective directive = (PrintJobDataDirective)printJob.PrintData[i];
                    if (directive.mDirective == PrintJobDataDirective.EPrintJobDataDirective.D_LINEFEED)
                        for (int ctr = 0; ctr < directive.miDirectiveArgument; ctr++)
                            lines.Add(string.Empty);

            return;

        //This is called to format a copy of the final receipt and write it to the journal.
        internal static void SendCheckImageToJournal(GuestCheckPrintParameters parameters, JournalFormatter journal)
            //CLogger logger = new CLogger( "Print Journal" );

            PrintDefinitions printDefs = GetPrintDefinitions( parameters );
            printDefs.LangId = parameters.PrintInfo.GuestCheck.TransState.Languages.DefaultLangID;

            int startIndex = Micros.LES.MWS.Utils.StopWatch.GetInstance().DtlTimingStart( "CheckSession.PrintJournal" );

            PrintGuestCheck printer = new PrintGuestCheck( parameters, printDefs );

            //Allow script/user to print their own subheader, detail or summary totals.
            SetCustomPrinting( parameters, printer );

            PrintJob job;
            printer.CreateJournalPrintJob( out job );

            JournalType journalType = printer.IsCustomerReceipt() ? JournalType.CustomerReceiptImage : JournalType.GuestCheckImage;

            //141231 | Memo | The Type 130 is not populating with a check image for memo check print (not tender) function.
            //The type 130 should only be populated with an check image for service total (memo print).
            //PaidInFull need to check to avoid memo tendering.
            if (!printDefs.Check.PaidInFull && parameters.MemoCheckPrint)
                journalType = JournalType.MemoCheckImage;

            journal.LogCheckImageJournal(journalType, parameters.PrintInfo.GuestCheck, job );

            Micros.LES.MWS.Utils.StopWatch.GetInstance().DtlTimingStop( startIndex, "CheckSession.PrintJournal" );
            //logger.End();

        static int GetPrintCount( GuestCheckPrintParameters parameters )
            //Default to 1 check
            EXT_OPS::OpsQueryPrintReceiptCountEventArgs args = new EXT_OPS::OpsQueryPrintReceiptCountEventArgs( 1, parameters.PrintInfo.GuestCheck.TaxExempt.AnyBitsSet );

            //Transaction services is passing null Extensibilty event
            if ( parameters.ExtensibilityEvent != null && !parameters.ExtensibilityEvent( args ) )
                return 0;

            int count = Math.Max( 0, args.Count );          //Handle a negative count!
            count = Math.Min(count, 5 );              //Common Sense: Don't allow more than 5

            return count;

        public static void SetCustomPrinting( GuestCheckPrintParameters parameters, PrintGuestCheck printer )
            //Simphony 2.6: extensibility can schedule it's own print with custom printing already defined.
            if ( printer.CustomReceiptEventArgs != null )
                return;                    //Already defined.

            //Default to 1 check
            EXT_OPS::OpsCustomReceiptEventArgs args = new EXT_OPS::OpsCustomReceiptEventArgs();
            args.CashDrawerNumber = printer.CashDrawerNumber; //SCR 3733 (derived from SCR 2285): To be used by custom scripts to access the Cash Drawer number

            //Transaction services is passing null Extensibility event
            var eventRun = parameters.ExtensibilityEvent?.Invoke(args) ?? false;
            if (eventRun)
                printer.CustomReceiptEventArgs = args;

        private static void Print2ndGuestCheck( GuestCheckPrintParameters parameters,
                                               PrintJob job,
                                               Print2ndCheckQuestion print2ndCheckQuestion,
                                               System.Enum e )
            if ( parameters.DbTenderMediaDef.Prnt2Chks )

                bool print2ndCheck = true;

                //TPID 32653 comment: transaction service will never have a prompt message for display like OPS, we just bypass this question check.
                if ( print2ndCheckQuestion != null && parameters.DbTenderMediaDef.PrmptFor2Chks )
                    print2ndCheck = print2ndCheckQuestion( e );

                if ( print2ndCheck && job.QuebecSrmConfiguredAndEnabled ) // SCR 4267 Print 2nd check as duplicate when using a SRM device
                    parameters.PrintInfo.GuestCheck.TF_DUPLICATA_QUEBECSRM = true;
                    parameters.Reprint = true;
                    ForcePrint( parameters );       //2.4 MR1: Added back call that got accidentally deleted.
                else if ( print2ndCheck )
                    PrintManager.SubmitUnsupervisedJob( job.GetCopy(), false );

        private static void UpdateJournal( GuestCheckPrintParameters parameters,
                                          PrintJob printJob,
                                          JournalType jnlType,
                                          IAppOfflineInfo offlineInfo )

        // 10/22/2010: Colin: Encapsulated this code and changed to use the PrintLanguauge (if set)
        internal static PrintDefinitions GetPrintDefinitions( GuestCheckPrintParameters parameters )
            PrintDefinitions printDefs = new PrintDefinitions();

            parameters.PrintInfo.InitPrinterDefinitions( printDefs, parameters.PrintInfo.GuestCheckAndCustomerDisplayLangId );

            if ( parameters.PrintInfo.GuestCheckAndCustomerDisplayLangId != 0 )
                printDefs.LangId = parameters.PrintInfo.GuestCheckAndCustomerDisplayLangId;

            printDefs.ExtensibilityEvent = parameters.ExtensibilityEvent;                                  //Used to raise printer events
            printDefs.SimEvent = parameters.SimEvent;                                                      //Used to raise printer events
            printDefs.ExtensibilityModifyDetailData = parameters.PrintInfo.AddPrinterExtensibilityData;    //Used to get additonal lines to print with a Mi/Discount etc.

            // 14966 | mzameer | Tender type added. Will be used when printing the check number in seat filtered mode
            printDefs.TenderMediaType = parameters.DbTenderMediaDef.TendMedType;

            return printDefs;

--- Common/PosCore/Printing/GuestCheckPrintParameters.cs
using System.Collections.Generic;

using Micros.PosCore.DataStore.DbRecords;

using EXT_OPS = Micros.PosCore.Extensibility.Ops;

namespace Micros.PosCore.Printing
    /// <summary>
    ///     Class used to hold the parameters that control the formatting of a Guest Check.
    /// </summary>
    public class GuestCheckPrintParameters
        public GuestCheckPrintParameters( IPrintInfo printInfo,
                                         DbTenderMedia tenderMedia,
                                         int cashDrawerNumber,
                                         DelegateRaiseEvent extensibilityEvent,
                                         DelegateRaiseSimEvent simEvent )
            PrintInfo = printInfo;
            CashDrawerNumber = cashDrawerNumber;
            DbTenderMediaDef = tenderMedia;
            ExtensibilityEvent = extensibilityEvent;
            SimEvent = simEvent;

        /// <summary>
        ///     2.5: Slip printer support: we may need to print the guest check even if there are no new items this round.
        /// </summary>
        internal bool NeedToPrintGuestCheck( DbOperator optr, GuestCheck check, DbTenderMedia tmedDef )
            //Simphony 2.5: Slip printer support: tmedDef.ReprintChk option handled later in this method.

            // TPID:20153  menu items are not printing on guest checks 20153  [10/18/2012 cgough]
            /*
            ** When Slip Printing was added the StartRoundNumber and EndRoundNumber became important. What was happening here
            ** was were were only printing the current round items when the guest check was printed, so this code and the other code marked by
            ** 20153 is setting the default print for all rounds but this may be overridden below based on the operator type.
            */
            StartRoundNumber = 1;
            EndRoundNumber = check.RoundNumber;

            bool printCheck = false;

            if ( check.DoNotPostTtl && check.RvcParmDef.Autofire.PrntAutofireMemoChk )
                // print autofire memo chit
                RoundByRound = false;
                AutofireMemoChitPrint = true;
                printCheck = true;
            else if ( check.WasAutoFireCheck && check.RvcParmDef.Autofire.PrntAutofireGuestChk )
                // print the guest check when an autofire check is fired
                RoundByRound = false;
                AutofireCheckFiredPrint = true;
                printCheck = true;
            else if ( optr.OnDemand )
                RoundByRound = false;
                printCheck = tmedDef.PrintCheckOnDemand;
            else if ( optr.SpecialOnDemand )
                // Requirement for Turkey. Check needs to print after 1st round/when paid in full (user can configure this) or any time there is
                // an alcoholic drink on the check. (Server needs to handle this manually by choosing the right service total key).
                SetRoundByRound( check );
                printCheck = check.PageNumber == 0 || tmedDef.PrintCheckOnDemand;
            else
                //Round by Round printing
                SetRoundByRound( check );

                if ( check.PageNumber > 0 || !optr.TempOnDemand )
                    printCheck = true;            //Round by Round operator or already printed a round, so need to print the current round.
                else if ( tmedDef.PrintCheckOnDemand )
                    //Start printing for an on-demand operator (all rounds need to print)
                    StartRoundNumber = 1;
                    printCheck = true;
            //TPID 47765 [12/19/2013 abush] Added "&& (tmedDef.TendMedType.ToString().Equals("TmedSvcTtlType"))" to ensure only sets Reprint = true if a Service Total
            if (tmedDef.AllowReprintCheck && (tmedDef.TendMedType.ToString().Equals("TmedSvcTtlType")) )
                SetForReprint( check );
                printCheck = true;

            return printCheck;

        private void SetRoundByRound( GuestCheck check )
            RoundByRound = true;
            StartRoundNumber = check.PrintedRoundNumber + 1;     //Start with the 1st unprinted round
            EndRoundNumber = check.RoundNumber;

        //Simphony 2.6: TP: 19871. Allow extensibility to print a customized tax receipt
        internal void SetForCustomPrint( EXT_OPS::OpsCustomReceiptEventArgs args, List<int> checkDetailLinks )
            CustomReceiptEventArgs = args;
            CheckDetailLinks = checkDetailLinks;

        /// <summary>
        ///     Update the GuestCheck following a successful print:
        ///        o # printed count
        ///        o Page Number for round by round printing
        ///        o Line Number for round by round printing
        /// </summary>
        internal void IncrementPrintCountAndSetPageNumberLineNumber( PrintJob job )
            PrintInfo.GuestCheck.IncrementCheckPrintedCount();

            //2.5: If Round By Round or Temp On Demand we need to preserve page/line # state for next print to slip printer or to indicate
            //     we need to print round by round on roll printers.
            if ( RoundByRound )
                //Don't increment the round number if we are simply appending split check lines as this is not a real service total
                //and the round number is not actually incremented.
                if ( SplitChecksList == null )
                    PrintInfo.GuestCheck.PrintedRoundNumber = PrintInfo.GuestCheck.RoundNumber;
            else
                PrintInfo.GuestCheck.PageNumber = 0;
                PrintInfo.GuestCheck.LineFind = 0;
                PrintInfo.GuestCheck.PrintedRoundNumber = 0;

            //Simphony 2.9: Colin: If new Quebec Srm reference data was created, add it to the check.
            if ( job.NewQuebecSrmExtensibilityDetail != null )
                PrintInfo.GuestCheck.AddNewExtensibilityData(null, job.NewQuebecSrmExtensibilityDetail);

        public static bool PretendPrinterIsASlipPrinter;  //Debugging aid

        public bool AutofireMemoChitPrint = false;  // true when option bit set to print autofire check when created
        public bool AutofireCheckFiredPrint = false; // true when option bit set to print autofire check when fired.
        public bool AutofireMissedPrint = false; // true when print autofire check when missed firing time.
        public bool Reprint;
        public bool RoundByRound;
        public int  StartRoundNumber;
        public int  EndRoundNumber;
        // I have commented this out as it should not be used.
        // Instead the public property CashDrawerNumber should
        // be used. I have also change the two places where this
        // member was being used to use the property.
        // DSC 6/20/2012
        //public int  cashDrawerNumber; //SCR 2285
        public bool Duplicata = false; // SCR 4267
        public bool FormatOnly;
        public bool AppendingRoundByRoundLinesOnly;
        public PrintJob FormattedJob;

        //Round by round support
        public int  AddedToCheckNumber;              //Set when printing round by round check that has been added to another check
        public int  AddedFromCheckNumber;            //Set when printing round by round check that has jist had another check added
        public bool SplitCheckPrint;
        public SplitCheckData[] SplitChecksList = null;
        // Print memo check
        public bool MemoCheckPrint { get; set; }
        public bool MemoCheckReprint { get; set; }

        // 146411 | gwelivita | Print guest check for KDS
        public bool PrintKdsGuestCheck { get; set; }

        private IPrintInfo _printInfo;
        private int _cashDrawerNumber;
        private DbTenderMedia _DbTenderMediaDef;
        private DelegateRaiseEvent _extensibilityEvent;
        private DelegateRaiseSimEvent _simEvent;

        private DbPrinter selectedPrinter = null; //FPS-73662

        //Simphony 2.6: Allow extensibility to print a customized receipt/guest check at anytime.
        internal EXT_OPS::OpsCustomReceiptEventArgs CustomReceiptEventArgs = null;    //This must be null unless extensibility sets otherwise the OpsCustomreceiptEvent will not fire.
        internal List<int> CheckDetailLinks = null;
        internal bool ForceAsCustomeReceipt = false;
        internal bool ForceAsGuestCheck = false;
        internal bool FormatForJournal = false;

        public bool OnlyTrailers    = false;    //FPS 9752 comment: only get trailers
        public bool SkipTrailers     = false;    //FPS 9752 comment: dont get trailers
        //FPS-12742 Needed to get the close date time
        public bool PrintCloseTimeOnImg { get; set; } = false;

        // FPS-3375 | vkmadupa | Holds Customer name/ABN entered when check amount is above sales threshold configured in format parameters. Only used while printing and not stored in DB.
        internal string CustomerInfo { get; set; }

        internal bool EqualPaymentUsed = false;
        internal bool EqualPaymentChit = false;
        internal EqualPaymentPrintParameters EPPParameters;
        internal bool ForceOnDemandCheck = false;  // For Self Pay customer deciding to print

        public DelegateRaiseEvent ExtensibilityEvent
            get { return _extensibilityEvent; }
            set { _extensibilityEvent = value; }

        public DelegateRaiseSimEvent SimEvent
            get { return _simEvent; }
            set { _simEvent = value; }

        public DbTenderMedia DbTenderMediaDef
            get { return _DbTenderMediaDef; }
            set
                if ( value != null )
                    _DbTenderMediaDef = value;
                else
                    _DbTenderMediaDef = new DbTenderMedia();

        public int CashDrawerNumber
            get { return _cashDrawerNumber; }
            set { _cashDrawerNumber = value; }

        public IPrintInfo PrintInfo
            get { return _printInfo; }
            set { _printInfo = value; }

        //FPS-73662 - We store a selected printer in some cases to be used instead of prompting for it later
        public DbPrinter SelectedPrinter
            get { return selectedPrinter; }
            set { selectedPrinter = value; }

        /// <summary>
        ///     Set parameters when reprinting a check. If operator is a round by round operator make sure we set the options
        ///     correctly so we set the check parameters for any subsequent round by round prints.
        /// </summary>
        internal void SetForReprint( GuestCheck check )
            //Simphony 2.5: A round by round reprint will set PageNumber/LineFeed for subsequent prints. This is belived to be
            //              different behavior to Simphonmy 1.0.
            Reprint = true;
            StartRoundNumber = 1;                    //print all rounds (if round by round printing)
            EndRoundNumber = check.RoundNumber; // TPID:20153  menu items are not printing on guest checks 20153  [10/18/2012 cgough]
            check.PageNumber = 0;
            check.LineFind = 0;

        internal void SetToPrintFullCheck( GuestCheck check )
            check.PageNumber = 0;
            check.LineFind = 0;
            RoundByRound = false;
            StartRoundNumber = 1;
            EndRoundNumber = check.RoundNumber;  // TPID:20153  menu items are not printing on guest checks 20153  [10/18/2012 cgough]

        //2.5: Removed 2 constructors - we only need 1 when we have GuestCheckPrintParameters as an arg!
        public PrintGuestCheck(GuestCheckPrintParameters parameters, PrintDefinitions defs)
            : base(defs, defs.LangId)
            // 2.5: Added local references to objects referenced frequently (makes code more readable).
            mCheck = mDefs.Check;
            mCurrent = mCheck.CurrentBaseTotals;
            mPrevious = mCheck.PreviousBaseTotals;

            // Print memo check enabled
            mPrintMemoCheck = parameters.MemoCheckPrint;
            mReprintMemoCheck = parameters.MemoCheckReprint;

            mPrintKdsGuestCheck = parameters.PrintKdsGuestCheck;

            mParameters = parameters;
            CustomReceiptEventArgs = parameters.CustomReceiptEventArgs;

            //Dbtender will be null wen forcing a print with no tender or getting check images for Journal/SIM.
            if (parameters.DbTenderMediaDef == null)
                parameters.DbTenderMediaDef = StaticEmptyDbTenderMedia;

            mDbTender = parameters.DbTenderMediaDef;

            //tgurung TP ID 20233 transaction services obliged us to check for the table number in order to decide whether it is customer receipt or guest check

            // 140356 | Memo | The closed receipts are getting printed as a “Guest Check” when user performs “Memo Printing”
            // Remove mPrintMemoCheck validation according to following requirement given by FA.
            //  - A memo paid fast transaction should be printed a customer receipt.
            //  - A memo paid table should be printed as guest check.
            //mIsCustReceipt = mCheck.PaidInFull && mCheck.FastTransactionIfPayInFull && !mPrintMemoCheck && !(mCheck.DiningTableNum > 0);
            mIsCustReceipt = mCheck.PaidInFull && mCheck.FastTransactionIfPayInFull && !(mCheck.DiningTableNum > 0);

            //Simphony 2.6: TP: 19871. Allow extensibility to print a customized tax receipt
            if (parameters.ForceAsGuestCheck || mCheck.IsWasteActive) // 100817 | gwelivita | We do not print customer receipt for waste checks.
                mIsCustReceipt = false;
            else if (parameters.ForceAsCustomeReceipt)
                mIsCustReceipt = true;
            else if (parameters.FormatForJournal)
                mIsForJournal = true;

            //If forcing a print (i.e. no DbTender) we use an empty DbTender and these flags should all be false!
            mPrintCheckOnDemand = mDbTender.PrintCheckOnDemand;
            mPrintSummaryTotals = mDbTender.PrintSumTtls && !mParameters.AutofireMemoChitPrint;
            mPrintCustRcpt = mDbTender.PrintCustRcpt;
            // 142557 | Memo | Tender/Media | When memo printing is enabled, seat printing should be ignored
            // When both "Print Seat Check" and "Print Memo Check" options enabled for the same key:
            //       Seat Filter ACTIVE - “Print Seat Check” will be ignored and memo check will be printed
            //       Seat Filter NOT ACTIVE - Seat check will be printed
            mPrintSeatCheck = mDbTender.TendMedType == TenderTypes.TmedSvcTtlType && !mPrintMemoCheck && (mDbTender.PrintSeatChk || mDbTender.PrintFullSeatChk);
            mPrintFullSeatCheck = mPrintSeatCheck && mDbTender.PrintFullSeatChk;
            mPrintTrailer = mIsCustReceipt ? mDbTender.TrailerForFastTrans : mDbTender.PrintTrailer && !mParameters.AutofireMemoChitPrint;

            defs.SetAlternateCheckNumber(parameters, this);   //SBUX doesn't want the real check number to print.
            defs.PretendPrinterIsASlipPrinter = GuestCheckPrintParameters.PretendPrinterIsASlipPrinter;

            //106044 Belgian Tax label umacherl: Setting flag to be used by common code.
            mDefs.BelgiumGuestCheck = mDefs.TaxParameters.EnableBelgianTax && !mIsForJournal;

        // FPS-1090 | sugandik | Returns true if the check printer is a slip printer
        internal bool IsSlipPrinter()
            //FPS-73662 - Updated to avoid prompting for both printers when we are only going to use one of them
            DbKey.PrinterID receiptPrinterID = new DbKey.PrinterID();
            DbKey.PrinterID checkPrinterID = new DbKey.PrinterID();

            if (mIsCustReceipt)
                receiptPrinterID = mPrintJob.Workstation.Printers.ReceiptPrinterId(mDefs.DS);
            else
                checkPrinterID = mPrintJob.Workstation.Printers.GuestCheckPrinterId(mDefs.DS);

            DbPrinter checkPrinter = mDefs.DS.ReadPrinterByID(mIsCustReceipt ? receiptPrinterID : checkPrinterID);

            // The workstation may not have configured either printers.
            return checkPrinter != null && checkPrinter.IsSlipPrinter;
        //2.5: Removed 2 constructors - we had too many!

        /// <summary>
        ///     Used to force a print when no DbTenderMedia record available.
        ///     Also used to create a check image for the Journal and SIM.
        ///     2.5: Moved code into a method (from a constructor) so we can use the standard constructor.
        /// </summary>
        internal void ConfigureForForcedPrint()
            mPrintCheckOnDemand = true;
            mPrintCustRcpt = true;

            // print the whole check
            if (!mParameters.RoundByRound)      //I am not sure if "RoundByRound" will ever be set when forcing a print!
                mPrintSummaryTotals = true;      //No DbTender to set from (i.e. splitting a check)
                mPrintTrailer = mParameters.SplitCheckPrint ? mDefs.RvcParm.Format.PrintSplitChkTrailer : true;

        // TP 66727 | gwelivita

        /// Force Print On Demand For KDS Device
        /// This will override the Print On Demand (Tender/Media Printing Option bit 23)
        /// </summary>
        internal void ForcePrintOnDemandForKDSDevice()
            mPrintCheckOnDemand = true;

        /// <summary>

        public void CreatePrintJob(out PrintJob job)
            bool onDemand;
