        /// <summary>
        ///     Used when we are forcing a GuestCheck to get check format header
        /// </summary>
        public void GetCheckFormatHeader(out PrintJob job) // #62782
            SetPrintAttributes();
            AddSecondaryLanguage();
            mPrintHeaderIncludedBlankLine = true; // Set flag to Want to include blank line in header
            FormatStandardHeader();
            mPrintHeaderIncludedBlankLine = false; // Reset flage
            job = mPrintJob;

        /// <summary>
        ///     Used when we are forcing a GuestCheck to get check format trailer
        /// </summary>
        public void GetCheckFormatTrailer(out PrintJob job) //#62782
            SetPrintAttributes();
            AddSecondaryLanguage();
            //call this function for Australian GST requirement
            FormatAustralianGSTRequirementLines();
            FormatStandardPreTrailer();
            mPrintTrailerIncludedBlankLine = true;  // Set flag to Want to include blank line in trailer
            FormatStandardCheckTrailer();
            mPrintTrailerIncludedBlankLine = false;  // Reset flage
            job = mPrintJob;

        /// <summary>
        ///     Format a standard guest check/customer receipt
        /// </summary>
        public void CreatePrintJob(out PrintJob job, out bool onDemand, out bool isCustReceipt)
            onDemand = false;
            isCustReceipt = mIsCustReceipt;

            int startIndex = Micros.LES.MWS.Utils.StopWatch.GetInstance().DtlTimingStart("PrintGuestCheck.CreatePrintJob");
            job = null;

            //134222 | RVC Parameter "on demand check receipt" determines printing of fast transaction checks
            bool doPrint = mIsCustReceipt ? (!mDefs.RvcParm.General.OnDemandCustRcpt && mPrintCustRcpt) :
                mParameters.RoundByRound || mPrintCheckOnDemand || mParameters.AutofireMemoChitPrint || mParameters.AutofireCheckFiredPrint;

            // For Self Pay we have to force On Demand processing so we can print after payment
            // Note guest check / customer receipt / equal payment chit should be treated as on demand for Self Pay
            if (mParameters.ForceOnDemandCheck)
                onDemand = true;
            else
                if (!doPrint && !mParameters.Reprint && !mParameters.EqualPaymentChit)
                    if (mIsCustReceipt &&
                            (mDefs.RvcParm.General.OnDemandCustRcpt || mDefs.RvcParm.Confirm.ForcePrintCustRcpt))
                        onDemand = true;             //Continue and generate print job but only save for on demand printing
                    else if (!mPrintKdsGuestCheck)
                        return;
            // 146411 | gwelivita | No need to get the printer(s) for KDS guest check since the guest check will be submit to KDS controller.
            // User can print the formatted guest check via multiple Order Devices.
            if (!GetPrinters() && !mPrintKdsGuestCheck)
                return;

            mIsJournalPrint = false;          //TP: 148701
            SetPrintAttributes();             //Set options based on the language to print in.
            AddSecondaryLanguage();

            // sort the detail and format the print job
            if (!mParameters.AppendingRoundByRoundLinesOnly)
                SortCheckDetail(0);

                if (mSortedList.Count <= 0 && !NeedToPrintWithNoDetail())
                    return;

                //Add prefixes/suffixes.
                //Ask scripts for changes ( name, count or total ) or append any text lines to any of the detail entries.
                EXT_OPS::DeviceType deviceType = mIsCustReceipt ? EXT_OPS::DeviceType.GuestCheck : EXT_OPS::DeviceType.CustomerReceipt;
                DetailFormatExtender extender = new DetailFormatExtender(mDefs.RvcDesc, mDefs.RvcConfig, mDefs.DS, mDefs.ExtensibilityModifyDetailData, mDefs.LangId, false /*isOrderDevice*/ );
                extender.ExpandOrExtend(mSortedList, deviceType);
            //Simphony 3.0: Common code to format the print job for both the primary and backup printers.
            FormatForPrimaryAndBackupPrinters(out job);

            Micros.LES.MWS.Utils.StopWatch.GetInstance().DtlTimingStop(startIndex, "PrintGuestCheck.CreatePrintJob");

        protected override void FormatData()
            if (!mCheck.IsWasteActive && mDefs.PropertyParameter.General.EnableQuebecSRM && !mParameters.EqualPaymentChit) // Is the site a Quebec site
                FormatQuebecSRM();
            else
                Format();

            SplitCheckIntoPages();
            PadPageToMinimumSize();
            AddFullCut();

            //This is the line where the next round by round check needs to be positioned on a slip printer.
            if (!mSlipPrinter)
                mCheck.LineFind = 0;

        //98251 | Overloaded method to get the timed fire items for Journals rather re-sorting through all the items
        public void CreateJournalPrintJob(out PrintJob job)
            CreateJournalPrintJob(out job, null);

        public void CreateJournalPrintJob(out PrintJob job, List<int> holdNfireDetailLinks)
            int startIndex = Micros.LES.MWS.Utils.StopWatch.GetInstance().DtlTimingStart("PrintGuestCheck.CreatePrintJob");
            job = null;

            mIsJournalPrint = true;  //TP:148701
            //Simphony 2.6: Set flag so we don't mess up slip printing page/line numbers
            mParameters.FormatOnly = true;

            SetPrintAttributes();             //Set options based on the language to print in.

            // sort the detail and format the print job
            SortCheckDetail(0);

            if (mSortedList.Count <= 0)
                return;

            List<SortedDetailBase> holdNfireSortedDetails = new List<SortedDetailBase>();

            //If any of the items in the check are exisiting in the timedFiredDetailLink list then those items will be left as it is
            //for the journal entries others will be ignored.
            //This is executed only for either held items or timed fire items.
            if (holdNfireDetailLinks != null && holdNfireDetailLinks.Count > 0)
                foreach (SortedDetailBase item in mSortedList)
                    var mi = item as MiSortedDetail;
                    if (mi != null)
                        bool addParent = holdNfireDetailLinks.Contains(mi.MenuItem.DetailLink);

                        if (addParent)
                            holdNfireSortedDetails.Add(item);
                        else if (mi.MenuItem.IsComboMealParent /* and was not just added */  )
                            foreach (MiSortedDetail miSdtl in mi.ComboSides.Where(side => holdNfireDetailLinks.Contains(side.MenuItem.DetailLink)))
                                holdNfireSortedDetails.Add(miSdtl);

                mSortedList = holdNfireSortedDetails;

            //Add prefixes/suffixes.
            //Ask scripts for changes ( name, count or total ) or append any text lines to any of the detail entries.
            EXT_OPS::DeviceType deviceType = mIsCustReceipt ? EXT_OPS::DeviceType.CustomerReceipt : EXT_OPS::DeviceType.GuestCheck;
            DetailFormatExtender extender = new DetailFormatExtender(mDefs.RvcDesc, mDefs.RvcConfig, mDefs.DS, mDefs.ExtensibilityModifyDetailData, mDefs.LangId, false /*isOrderDevice*/ );
            extender.ExpandOrExtend(mSortedList, deviceType);

            //We are creating a check image and not actually printing. To guard against this messing up the round by round
            //printing (especially slip printing), we save and restore the appropriate check state (i.e. page and line numbers).
            int savedPageNumber = mCheck.PageNumber;
            int savedLineNumber = mCheck.LineFind;

            //FPS 9752 comment: we only need trailers
            if (mParameters.OnlyTrailers)
                FormatTrailer();
            else
                Format();

            mCheck.PageNumber = savedPageNumber;
            mCheck.LineFind = savedLineNumber;

            //AddFullCut(); Simphony 2.6: Removed as we are creating a check image and not actually printing

            job = mPrintJob;
            Micros.LES.MWS.Utils.StopWatch.GetInstance().DtlTimingStop(startIndex, "PrintGuestCheck.CreatePrintJob");

        public bool IsCustomerReceipt()
            return mIsCustReceipt;

        //Get the primary and backup printer information.
        private bool GetPrinters()
            mPrintJob.Printers.Clear();

            //FPS-73662 - Updated to have the KDS guest check image handling
            //            not perform an operator printer lookup.
            //            If the system has a specific printer configured, it will use that.
            //FPS-73662 - Updated to avoid prompting for both printers when we are only going to use one of them
            //FPS-73662 - Updated to look for a previously selected printer as we may have prompted for this in advance
            DbKey.PrinterID receiptPrinterID = new DbKey.PrinterID();
            DbKey.PrinterID checkPrinterID = new DbKey.PrinterID();
            DbKey.PrinterID backupPrinterID;

            if (mPrintKdsGuestCheck)
                if (mIsCustReceipt)
                    receiptPrinterID = mPrintJob.Workstation.Printers.FindPrinterIdNoLookup(PrinterType.CustomerReceipt, mDefs.DS);
                else
                    checkPrinterID = mPrintJob.Workstation.Printers.FindPrinterIdNoLookup(PrinterType.GuestCheck, mDefs.DS);
                backupPrinterID = mPrintJob.Workstation.Printers.FindPrinterIdNoLookup(PrinterType.Backup, mDefs.DS);
            else
                if (mIsCustReceipt)
                    if (mParameters?.SelectedPrinter == null)
                        receiptPrinterID = mPrintJob.Workstation.Printers.ReceiptPrinterId(mDefs.DS);
                else
                    if (mParameters?.SelectedPrinter == null)
                        checkPrinterID = mPrintJob.Workstation.Printers.GuestCheckPrinterId(mDefs.DS);
                backupPrinterID = mPrintJob.Workstation.Printers.BackupPrinterId(mDefs.DS);

            DbPrinter checkPrinter;
            if (mParameters?.SelectedPrinter != null)
                checkPrinter = mParameters.SelectedPrinter;
            else
                checkPrinter = mDefs.DS.ReadPrinterByID(mIsCustReceipt ? receiptPrinterID : checkPrinterID);
            DbPrinter backupPrinter = mDefs.DS.ReadPrinterByID(backupPrinterID);

            return AddPrinters(checkPrinter, backupPrinter);
        /// <summary>
        /// FPPRT-1913: QR Pay
        /// We add the QR code print feature.  Tai L. 03/30/2022
        /// QR code format: BaseURL/QRPayOrgShortCode/LocRef>/RvcRef/CheckRef
        /// </summary>
        /// <returns></returns>
        private bool GetQRPaymentURL(ref string url)
            url = "";
            string baseURL = "";
            string shortCode = "";
            bool qrPayEnabledEmc = false;
            bool qrPayEnabledPaymentApp = false;
            string locRef = "";
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();

            var qrPayCfg = mDefs.DS.ReadAllQrPayConfigs((int)mDefs.RvcParm.HierStrucID).FirstOrDefault();
            if (qrPayCfg != null)
                baseURL = qrPayCfg.QrPayPaymentBaseUrl;
                shortCode = qrPayCfg.QrPayOrgShortCode;
                qrPayEnabledEmc = qrPayCfg.QrPayEnabledEmc;
                qrPayEnabledPaymentApp = qrPayCfg.QrPayEnabledPaymentApp;
            else
                LogUtils.LogAlways(GetPrintingText(EPrintingStatusIds.InvalidQRCode));
                return false;
            LogUtils.LogDetailFlow("QR Payment BaseURL:" + baseURL, GATEWAY::EGatewayAppParams.LOG_ZONE_INDEX.PRINTING);
            LogUtils.LogDetailFlow("QR Payment QRPayOrgShortCode:" + shortCode, GATEWAY::EGatewayAppParams.LOG_ZONE_INDEX.PRINTING);
            if (!qrPayEnabledEmc || !qrPayEnabledPaymentApp)
                return false;

            var netViewPoint = mDefs.DS.ReadAllNetViewpointConfig().FirstOrDefault(x => x.HierStrucID == mDefs.PropertyParameter.HierStrucID);
            if (netViewPoint != null)
                locRef = netViewPoint.LocRef;
            else
                LogUtils.LogAlways(GetPrintingText(EPrintingStatusIds.InvalidQRCode));
                return false;
            LogUtils.LogDetailFlow("QR Payment LocRef:" + locRef, GATEWAY::EGatewayAppParams.LOG_ZONE_INDEX.PRINTING);

            if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(baseURL) && string.IsNullOrEmpty(shortCode) && string.IsNullOrEmpty(locRef))
                LogUtils.LogAlways(GetPrintingText(EPrintingStatusIds.InvalidQRCode));
                return false;

            if (baseURL.EndsWith("/"))
                sb.Append(baseURL);
            else
                sb.Append(baseURL + "/");
            sb.Append(shortCode + "/");
            sb.Append(locRef + "/");
            sb.Append(mDefs.RvcParm.ObjectNumber.ToString() + "/");
            sb.Append(mCheck.Guid);

            url = sb.ToString().Replace(" ", "%20");
            return true;

        private void PrintQRCode()
            if (mPrintJob.Printers != null & mPrintJob.Printers.Count > 0 && mPrintJob.Printers[0].Printer.Thermal)
                string qrCode = "";
                if (GetQRPaymentURL(ref qrCode))
                    LogUtils.LogDetailFlow("QR Payment URL:" + qrCode, GATEWAY::EGatewayAppParams.LOG_ZONE_INDEX.PRINTING);

                    AddSeparatorLine();
                    AddCenteredLineDW(GetPrintingText(EPrintingIds.ViewCheckAndPay));
                    AddCenteredLine(GetPrintingText(EPrintingIds.ScanToPay));
                    AddBarcode(OposSymbolType.PTR_BCS_QRCODE, 0, 0, OposSymbolAlignment.PTR_BC_CENTER, OposSymbolTextPos.PTR_BC_TEXT_NONE, qrCode);
                    AddSeparatorLine();

        private bool AppendingToAPreviousSlip { get { return mSlipPrinter && mParameters.RoundByRound && mCheck.PageNumber >= 1 && mCheck.LineFind >= 1; } }
        private void Format()
            if (LogUtils.ShouldLog(GATEWAY.ELogLevel.GENERAL_FLOW, GATEWAY::EGatewayAppParams.LOG_ZONE_INDEX.PRINTING))
                LogUtils.LogAlways(string.Format("Slip Printer = {0}; Round By Round = {1}; Page Number = {2}; Line Number = {3}; Appending = {4}",
                                       mSlipPrinter, mParameters.RoundByRound, mCheck.PageNumber, mCheck.LineFind, AppendingToAPreviousSlip), GATEWAY::EGatewayAppParams.LOG_ZONE_INDEX.PRINTING);

            //Simphiony 2.6: Extensibility can now provide, so make sure it is not null.
            if (CustomReceiptEventArgs == null)
                CustomReceiptEventArgs = new EXT_OPS::OpsCustomReceiptEventArgs();

            bool appendingToSlip = AppendingToAPreviousSlip;           //Check here before we start messing with the data used to determine this.

            SetPageSizes();
            SetStartingPageNumber();
            FormatInitialBlankLines();
            AddBackupPrinterLines();

            LogDetails(appendingToSlip);

            // If we are appending to an existing slip we skip the headers/check identification.
            // Journal formatter has its own code to format the header, skip
            if (!appendingToSlip && !mIsForJournal)
                PrintSection(FormatStandardHeader, CustomReceiptEventArgs.HeaderAction, CustomReceiptEventArgs.CustomHeader);
                if( mDbTender.TendMedType == TenderTypes.TmedSvcTtlType && mDbTender.PrintQRCode
                    && mCheck.TotalDue > 0 && !mDbTender.SendOrder && !mCheck.ClosedCheckVoid)
                    PrintQRCode();
                PrintSection(FormatStandardSubHeader, CustomReceiptEventArgs.SubHeaderAction, CustomReceiptEventArgs.CustomSubHeader);
                PrintSection(FormatTeamInfo, CustomReceiptEventArgs.TeamHeaderAction, CustomReceiptEventArgs.TeamHeaderAction); //TP 36749

            if (mIsForJournal && mDefs.PropertyParameter.Report.SaveFinalReceipt) //TP 39998
                PrintSection(FormatTeamInfo, CustomReceiptEventArgs.TeamHeaderAction, CustomReceiptEventArgs.TeamHeaderAction);

            //2.5: Round by round support
            PrintCheckAddedSplitTransferredLines();

            if (mParameters.EqualPaymentChit)
                PrintSection(FormatStandardCheckDetail, CustomReceiptEventArgs.DetailAction, CustomReceiptEventArgs.CustomDetail);
                PrintSection(FormatEqualPaymentChitSummaryTotals, CustomReceiptEventArgs.SummaryTotalsAction, CustomReceiptEventArgs.CustomSummaryTotals);
                PrintSection(FormatStandardPreTrailer, CustomReceiptEventArgs.PreTrailerAction, CustomReceiptEventArgs.CustomPreTrailer);
                PrintSection(FormatStandardCheckTrailer, CustomReceiptEventArgs.TrailerAction, CustomReceiptEventArgs.CustomTrailer);
            else if (!mParameters.AppendingRoundByRoundLinesOnly)
                PrintSection(FormatStandardCheckDetail, CustomReceiptEventArgs.DetailAction, CustomReceiptEventArgs.CustomDetail);

                if (!mPrintFullSeatCheck)
                    //106044 Belgian tax Label - umacherl
                    //Printing a new section for discounts and service charge with tax labels
                    if (mDefs.BelgiumGuestCheck)
                        FormatStandardDiscountServiceChargeWithTaxLabelTotals();
                    PrintSection(FormatStandardSummaryTotals, CustomReceiptEventArgs.SummaryTotalsAction, CustomReceiptEventArgs.CustomSummaryTotals);

                    FormatAustralianGSTRequirementLines();

                    // Journal does not print trailer, skip
                    if (!mIsForJournal && !mParameters.SkipTrailers)  // 9752 comment: if we are not skipping trailers, which is by default false
                        PrintSection(FormatStandardPreTrailer, CustomReceiptEventArgs.PreTrailerAction, CustomReceiptEventArgs.CustomPreTrailer);
                        PrintSection(FormatStandardCheckTrailer, CustomReceiptEventArgs.TrailerAction, CustomReceiptEventArgs.CustomTrailer);

        // 9752 comment: to generate trailers only
        /// <summary>
        /// Only get trailers
        /// </summary>
        private void FormatTrailer()
            if (CustomReceiptEventArgs == null)
                CustomReceiptEventArgs = new EXT_OPS::OpsCustomReceiptEventArgs();

            PrintSection(FormatStandardPreTrailer, CustomReceiptEventArgs.PreTrailerAction, CustomReceiptEventArgs.CustomPreTrailer);
            PrintSection(FormatStandardCheckTrailer, CustomReceiptEventArgs.TrailerAction, CustomReceiptEventArgs.CustomTrailer);

        /// <summary>
        ///     Print transaction number and workstation number on Guest Checks/Customer Receipts
        /// </summary>
        internal void AddWorkstationAndTransactionLine()
            //87984 | v-ikottachchi | 04-06-2015 | As per product management, we should display WS number, NOT the WSID
            string workstationNum = String.Empty;
            string transactionId = String.Empty;

            if (mDefs.RvcParm.Format.PrintWSOnChecksAndReceipts)
                workstationNum = StringUtils.SafeStringFormat(GetPrintingText(EPrintingIds.TerminalLabel), mDefs.Workstation.ObjectNumber.ToString());

            if (mDefs.RvcParm.Format.PrintTransNumberOnChecksAndReceipts)
                transactionId = StringUtils.SafeStringFormat(GetPrintingText(EPrintingIds.TransactionLabel), mDefs.Check.WorkstationDef.NextTransNumber);

            AddLineLeftAndRightJustified(transactionId, workstationNum, false);

        /// <summary>
        ///     Add the detail for each active seat.
        /// </summary>
        private void FormatSeatDetail()
            int numSeats = 0;
            int previousSeat = mCheck.Seat;
            // FPS-26432 | vaipraka | ToList() returns a new list from the IEnumerable. Without ToList() any changes on SeatFilter will reflect on previous variable.
            var previous = mCheck.Detail.SeatFilter.ToList();
            foreach (int seat in mCheck.GetOpenSeats())
                // FPS-34141 | PORT 19.2.1 | FPS-33294 | vaipraka | Clearing the seatfilter and only adding the current seat.
                // Moved the filtering logic from CalculateTotals, so that mSortedList contains the prorated manual service charge corresponding to each seat.
                mCheck.Detail.SeatFilter.Clear();
                mCheck.Detail.SeatFilter.Add(seat);
                mCheck.SetCurrentSeat(seat);
                mCheck.UpdateManualServiceCharges();                          //Calculate the service charge for a particular seat at a time.
                SortCheckDetail(seat, true /*sortBySeat*/ );                 //Get the list of items for a particular seat.
                if (mSortedList.Count <= 0)
                    continue;

                //Simphony 2.6: If this is the 2nd/3rd/4th seat, add the check header. We already have the header for the 1st check.
                if (mPrintFullSeatCheck && numSeats >= 1)
                    CutPaperAndPrintHeaderForNextSeat();

                numSeats++;
                PrintSeatHeader(seat);

                //Calculate Totals for the  seat
                mCheck.CalculateTotals(mDefs.CurrencyParameters, mDefs.TaxParameters);

                //Print Seat items and totals
                PrintSection(FormatCheckDetail, CustomReceiptEventArgs.DetailAction, CustomReceiptEventArgs.CustomDetail);
                //106044 Belgian tax Label - umacherl
                //Printing a new section for discounts and service charge with tax labels
                if (mDefs.BelgiumGuestCheck)
                    FormatStandardDiscountServiceChargeWithTaxLabelTotals();
                PrintSection(FormatStandardSummaryTotals, CustomReceiptEventArgs.SummaryTotalsAction, CustomReceiptEventArgs.CustomSummaryTotals);

                if (mPrintFullSeatCheck)
                    PrintSection(FormatStandardPreTrailer, CustomReceiptEventArgs.PreTrailerAction, CustomReceiptEventArgs.CustomPreTrailer);
                    PrintSection(FormatStandardCheckTrailer, CustomReceiptEventArgs.TrailerAction, CustomReceiptEventArgs.CustomTrailer);
                else
                    AddBlankLines(1);

            //This prints a header "All Seats" with no items. I think this is intended to nform the user that the checks for all customers have been printed.
            if (!mPrintFullSeatCheck)
                PrintAllSeatsHeader(numSeats);

            // FPS-34141 | PORT 19.2.1 | FPS-33294 | vaipraka | Resetting the seat filter and the current seat.
            mCheck.Detail.SeatFilter = previous;
            mCheck.SetCurrentSeat(previousSeat);
            mCheck.UpdateManualServiceCharges(); // Recalculate manual service charge for the check.
            //Recalculate check tootals instead of seat totals
            mCheck.CalculateTotals(mDefs.CurrencyParameters, mDefs.TaxParameters);

        private void CutPaperAndPrintHeaderForNextSeat()
            AddFullCut();

            mCheck.LineFind = 0;
            mCheck.PageNumber = 0;
            AddBlankLines((int)mDefs.RvcParm.Format.LineFeedsBeforeFirst);

            PrintSection(FormatStandardHeader, CustomReceiptEventArgs.HeaderAction, CustomReceiptEventArgs.CustomHeader);
            PrintSection(FormatStandardSubHeader, CustomReceiptEventArgs.SubHeaderAction, CustomReceiptEventArgs.CustomSubHeader);

        /// <summary>
        ///      Simphony 2.6: Encapsulated:
        ///         ******************************
        ///                    Seat 1
        ///         ******************************
        /// </summary>
        private void PrintSeatHeader(int seat)
            if (!mDefs.RvcParm.Format.DoNotPrintSeatHeaders)
                AddAsteriskLine();
                AddCenteredLine(StringUtils.SafeStringFormat("{0} {1}", GetPrintingText(EPrintingIds.Seat), seat));
                AddAsteriskLine();

                AddBlankLines(1);

        /// <summary>
        ///      Simphony 2.6: Encapsulated:
        ///         ******************************
        ///                   Seat 1,2,...,n
        ///         ******************************
        /// </summary>
        private void PrintMultiSeatHeader(int[] seats)
            if (!mDefs.RvcParm.Format.DoNotPrintSeatHeaders)
                AddAsteriskLine();
                StringBuilder seatNums = new StringBuilder();

                // Concatenate seat numbers
                foreach (int seatNum in seats)
                    seatNums.AppendFormat(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, "{0},", seatNum);

                // Trim additional ',' from the end
                string seatNumsText = seatNums.ToString().TrimEnd(',');

                AddCenteredLine(StringUtils.SafeStringFormat("{0} {1}", GetPrintingText(EPrintingIds.Seat), seatNumsText));
                AddAsteriskLine();

                AddBlankLines(1);

        /// <summary>
        ///      Simphony 2.6: Encapsulated:
        ///         ******************************
        ///                    All Seats
        ///         ******************************
        /// </summary>
        private void PrintAllSeatsHeader(int numSeats)
            if (!mDefs.RvcParm.Format.DoNotPrintSeatHeaders)
                // 5/5/2011: SCR#4832: Guofang You: Print Seat header for 1 seat
                if (numSeats >= 1)
                    AddAsteriskLine();
                    AddCenteredLine(GetPrintingText(EPrintingIds.AllSeat));
                    AddAsteriskLine();

        /// <summary>
        /// Adds the XML structure to the receipt when using a Quebec SRM device
        /// </summary>
        private void FormatQuebecSRM() // SCR 4267
            QuebecSRM quebecSRM = new QuebecSRM(mDefs, mDbTender.QuebecSrmDuplicata);
            mPrintJob.NewQuebecSrmExtensibilityDetail = quebecSRM.InitSRMData(ref QuebecSrmReprintCheck); // Sets the appropriate references on the check
            mDefs.TimeUtc = quebecSRM.GetPrintTimeUTC(); // Sets the time

            if (mPrintJob.QuebecSrmConfiguredAndEnabled)
                if (quebecSRM.ClosingBlankCheck())
                    mPrintJob.QuebecFiscalDocument = false;
                    Format();
                    mPrintJob.PrintData.Insert(0, new PrintJobDataLine(QuebecSRM.GetNonFiscalHeader()));
                    mPrintJob.PrintData += new PrintJobDataLine(QuebecSRM.GetNonFiscalFooter());
                    mPrintJob.NonFiscalHeaderAndTrailerAlreadyAdded = true;
                    //AddFullCut(); Removed this because it will add an extra chit to the receipt
                else
                    mPrintJob.QuebecFiscalDocument = true;

                    //119956 Setting Job Supervised Time
                    mPrintJob.SupervisedJobEndTimeUtc = DateTime.MinValue;

                    if (!mDefs.QuebecSrmDebugLimitOutput)       //Reduce print data when in test mode.
                        AddLine(quebecSRM.GetFiscalHeader());

                    DumpQuebecSRMData(quebecSRM);     //Debugging aid

                    Format();

                    if (mDefs.QuebecSrmDebugLimitOutput)       //Reduce print data when in test mode.
                        AddBlankLines(3);                        //Separate this print from the next one without cutting the paper.
                    else
                        AddLine(quebecSRM.GetFiscalFooter());
                        //AddFullCut(); Removed this because it will add an extra chit to the receipt
                        AddLine(quebecSRM.GetQuebecSRMClosingString());
            else // If the SRM device is bypassed use regular printing but we still need the refs saved
                Format();
                //AddFullCut(); Removed this because it will add an extra chit to the receipt

            quebecSRM.ResetValues(); // reset any instance type variables

            // 2.4 MR1: TP #9035: If we print when the device is disabled, then we need to set a flag so we can force a print
            // for this check if we print it again after the device is re-enabled.
            // (Also need to reset the flag whenver we print with the device enabled or we will subsequently print when we shouldn't).
            mCheck.PrintedWithSrmDisabled = !mPrintJob.QuebecSrmConfiguredAndEnabled;

        /// <summary>
        /// Print the Quebec SRM data in a readable format on the printer.
        /// </summary>
        private void DumpQuebecSRMData(QuebecSRM quebecSRM)
            if (mDefs.QuebecSrmCertification > 0 && !String.IsNullOrEmpty(mDefs.QuebecSrmTestName))
                AddCenteredLine(mDefs.QuebecSrmTestName);

            if (mDefs.QuebecSrmDebugMode)
                AddBlankLines(1);
                PosPrinterData data = new PosPrinterData(PosPrinterData.TextAttribute.Normal, PosPrinterData.TextAlignment.Left, PosPrinterData.TextSize.Normal);
                data.TextList = quebecSRM.GetDebugData();
                AddDataObject(data);
                AddBlankLines(1);

        private delegate void StandardMethod();

        private void PrintSection(StandardMethod standardMethod, EXT_OPS::CustomPrintType customType, object customData)
            bool printStandard = customType != EXT_OPS::CustomPrintType.DoNotPrint && customType != EXT_OPS::CustomPrintType.Replace;
            bool appendCustom = customType == EXT_OPS::CustomPrintType.Append || customType == EXT_OPS::CustomPrintType.Replace;

            if (customType == EXT_OPS::CustomPrintType.Prepend)
                AddDataObject(customData);

            if (printStandard)
                standardMethod();

            if (appendCustom)
                AddDataObject(customData);

        private void FormatStandardHeader()
            if (mDefs.QuebecSrmDebugLimitOutput)
                return;                    //Reduce print data when in test mode.

            if (mCheck.RvcParmDef.Format.PrintInfoBeforeHdr)
                FormatCheckInfo(mCheck.Detail, true);

            FormatHeaderDescriptorLines();

            // FPS-3375 | vkmadupa | Prints Customer name/ ABN entered when check amount is above sales threshold configured in format parameters.
            if (!String.IsNullOrEmpty(mParameters.CustomerInfo))
                // FPS-4973 | rsambu | Displaying the user defined label when total crossed second threshold
                if (String.IsNullOrEmpty(mDefs.RvcParm.Format.Label.ToString()))
                    FormatDescriptorLine(string.Format("{0}{1}", GetPrintingText(EPrintingIds.CustomerInfoDefaultLabel), mParameters.CustomerInfo));
                else
                    FormatDescriptorLine(string.Format("{0}{1}", StringUtils.SafeStringFormat(GetPrintingText(EPrintingIds.CustomerInfoLabel), mDefs.RvcParm.Format.Label), mParameters.CustomerInfo));

        //TODO: FUTURE: We should allow the user to customize this part of the check. How about 2 events:
        //      1: OpsReplaceCheckIdentification
        //         o Just replaces the CHK/TBL line(s)
        //      2: OpsReplaceCheckHeader
        //         o Replaces all but CheckInfo lines
        //         o How should we support the Reprint/Modified special lines with this event?
        //           - could these be arguments to the event?
        private void FormatStandardSubHeader()
            FormatEmployeeNameAndPrintCountOrPageNumber();

            if (mCheck.RvcParmDef.Format.PrintEventOnChecksAndReceiptsAfterHdr)  // TP #100910.  Show any 'group' event associated with current check
                FormatEventDescriptor();

            AddSeparatorLine();                         //"------------------------"
            FormatCheckIdentification();

            if (PrintCheckOpenTime())
                AddCenteredLineSW(mFormatter.DateAndTimeUtc(mCheck.CheckOpenTime, false));   //print date and time
            else //JIRA[FPS6009]- Date is always needed, since the combination of date and Guest check number ensures a unique check.
                AddCenteredLineSW(mFormatter.DateLocal(mCheck.CheckOpenTime.ToLocalTime()));  //print date only

            FormatSpecialLines();                       //Reprint/modified/Demo Mode etc
            AddSeparatorLine();                         //"------------------------"
            AddClosedCheckEdit();                       //CLierley "Closed Check Edit" SCR 4419

            AddOrderTypeLine();
            AddOrderChannelLine(); //FPS-95526 Print Order channel

            if (mCheck.RvcParmDef.Format.PrintInfoAfterHdr)
                FormatCheckInfo(mCheck.Detail, true);

        //TP 36749 to print team member info
        private void FormatTeamInfo()
            //TP 36748 - To check if option bit 41 is checked under format parameters
            if (mCheck.RvcParmDef.Format.PrintTeamInfo)
                //TP 36749 - Printing Team Information on Check/Receipt
                AddTeamInfo();

        //TP 36749 - Adding Team Info to the Check/Receipt
        private void AddTeamInfo()
            if (mDefs.Check.CheckTeam != null)
                if (mCheck.TeamInformation != null)
                    AddTeamInfoCommon(mCheck.TeamInformation);

        private void AddTeamInfoCommon(List<DbTeamMemberDef> teamMemberList)
            DbEmployee e = new DbEmployee();

            if (teamMemberList.Count != 0)//only printing the team information when there are atleast one member in the team

                AddBlankLines(1);
                AddCenteredLine(GetPrintingText(EPrintingIds.PrintTeamInfoOnCheck).ToUpper());
                AddBlankLines(1);

                foreach (DbTeamMemberDef memberList in teamMemberList)
                    e = mDefs.DS.ReadEmployeeByID(new DbKey.EmployeeID(memberList.EmployeeID));
                    AddLine(e.FullName);

                AddSeparatorLine();

        private void FormatSpecialLines()
            if (QuebecSrmReprintCheck)
                //AddCenteredLine( EPrintingIds.Reprint );
                AddCenteredLine(GetPrintingText(EPrintingIds.Reprint).ToUpper());

            if (mModifiedCheck)
                //AddCenteredLine( EPrintingIds.ModifiedCheck );
                AddCenteredLine(GetPrintingText(EPrintingIds.ModifiedCheck).ToUpper());

            AddReprintOrMemoCheckLine();
            AddAutofireLine();
            AddDemoModeLine();
            AddReopenedCheckLine();

        private void AddReprintOrMemoCheckLine()
            ////if ( mDefs.RvcParm.Format.GcPrntReprintMsg && ( mParameters.Reprint || mPrintMemoCheck ) )
            ////    AddCenteredLine( mPrintMemoCheck ? EPrintingIds.ReprintMemoCheck : EPrintingIds.Reprint );
            //TP#4825 clierley.  Added the following code to modify the Reprint message to add the number of the reprint to the message.
            if (mPrintMemoCheck)
                //143064 | MEmo | Printing | In order to print the ***********MEMO CHECK*********** header on a Memo check, Format Parameter option bit 9 has to be enabled
                //It should print the *******MEMO CHECK******** header every time a memo check is printed without enabling the Format Parameter option bit 9.
                //When a memo check is reprinted, it should print ********REPRINT MEMO CHECK******* on memo check header
                if (mReprintMemoCheck && mDefs.RvcParm.Format.GcPrntReprintMsg)
                    AddCenteredLine(GetPrintingText(EPrintingIds.ReprintMemoCheck).ToUpper());
                else
                    AddCenteredLine(GetPrintingText(EPrintingIds.MemoCheck).ToUpper());
            else if (mDefs.RvcParm.Format.GcPrntReprintMsg && mParameters.Reprint && mCheck.PrintCount > 0)
                AddCenteredLine(string.Format(GetPrintingText(EPrintingIds.ReprintNumber).ToUpper(), mCheck.PrintCount));
            //else if (mPrintMemoCheck)
            //    AddCenteredLine(GetPrintingText(EPrintingIds.MemoCheck).ToUpper());

        private void AddDemoModeLine()
            if (mDemoMode)
                AddCenteredLine(EPrintingIds.DemoMode);

        private void AddAutofireLine()
            if (mCheck.DoNotPostTtl)
                if (mCheck.AutofireMissed)
                    AddCenteredLine(GetPrintingText(EPrintingIds.MissedAutofireCheck).ToUpper());
                else
                    AddCenteredLine(EPrintingIds.AutofireCheck);
                AddPossiblyLongHeaderLine(mFormatter.NameAndDateTime(EPrintingIds.TimeToFire, mCheck.TimeToFire).ToUpper());

        /// <summary>
        /// Show "Reopened From Check 9999" if the check is reopened this round. It should not show on subsequent service rounds.
        /// </summary>
        private void AddReopenedCheckLine()
            if (mCheck.TF_REOPENED_CHECK && mCheck.ReopenedFromCheckNum != 0)
                //FPS-1000 Check details are missing on the printout of void closed check, check reference is wrong.
                //clierley: TP#8593 Changed from String.Format to SafeStringFormat.
                string strCheckLine = null;
                if (mCheck.ClosedCheckVoid)
                    strCheckLine = StringUtils.SafeStringFormat(GetPrintingText(EPrintingIds.VoidClosedCheck).ToUpper(), GetPrintingText(EPrintingIds.CheckHeader), mCheck.ReopenedFromCheckNum);
                else
                    strCheckLine = StringUtils.SafeStringFormat(GetPrintingText(EPrintingIds.CheckReopenedFrom).ToUpper(), GetPrintingText(EPrintingIds.CheckHeader), mCheck.ReopenedFromCheckNum);

                AddPossiblyLongHeaderLine(strCheckLine);

        private void AddPossiblyLongHeaderLine(string s)
            if (mPrintStr.RoomForRightJustifiedData(s, mPrintWidth))
                AddCenteredLine(s);
            else
                AddLongWord(s, 1, mPrintWidth);

        private void FormatHeaderDescriptorLines()
            // 78707 | V-Aweliwita | Waste Receipt printing
            Descriptors descriptors = null;

            // 100817 | gwelivita | if the check is a waste, use waste headers to print check
            descriptors = mCheck.IsWasteActive ? mDefs.RvcDesc.WasteHeader : mDefs.RvcDesc.CheckHeader;

            if (mCheck.Training)
                descriptors = mDefs.RvcDesc.TrainingHeader;
            else if (mIsCustReceipt)
                descriptors = mDefs.RvcDesc.CustomerReceiptHeader;
            else if (mCheck.AutofireMissed)
                descriptors = mDefs.RvcDesc.AutofireCheckOfflineHeader;

            FormatDescriptors(descriptors, mPrintHeaderIncludedBlankLine /*printIncludedBlankLines*/ );

            if (!mCheck.RvcParmDef.Format.NoGcBlankLines)
                AddBlankLines(1);

            // 100817 | gwelivita | Add waste header line for waste checks to identify a waste check like it appears on check journals
            // print the waste header line in primary language
            if (mCheck.IsWasteActive)
                FormatDescriptorLine(PosCoreTransText.Text.GetString(EPrintingIds.WasteCheckHeader, mLangData.LangId));

        /// <summary>
        ///     On the 1st page we print the "check printed" count to the right. On subsequent pages we print "Page N" to the right.
        /// </summary>
        private void FormatEmployeeNameAndPrintCountOrPageNumber()
            mPrintStr.Clear();
            mPrintStr.Add(mFormatter.EmplNumCheckName(mCheck.CheckEmployee));    //2.3: SCR 4347: Print the check employees name not the transaction employees name.

            int number = mCheck.PageNumber > 1 ? mCheck.PageNumber : mCheck.PrintCount;
            if (number == 0)
                mPrintStr.Pad(mPrintWidth);
            else if (!mPrintMemoCheck)
                string printedCountOrPageString;
                if (mCheck.PageNumber > 1)
                    printedCountOrPageString = StringUtils.SafeStringFormat(GetPrintingText(EPrintingIds.Page), mCheck.PageNumber);
                else
                    printedCountOrPageString = number.ToString();

                if (!mPrintStr.RoomForRightJustifiedData(printedCountOrPageString, mPrintWidth))
                    AddPaddedLine(mPrintStr, mPrintAttribute);
                    mPrintStr.Clear();

                mPrintStr.AddRight(printedCountOrPageString, mPrintWidth);
            AddLine(mPrintStr, mPrintAttribute);

            // Only one of these option bits are required to be enabled to add the line to the check
            // the values will print below the employee name on the guest check header.
            if (mDefs.RvcParm.Format.PrintWSOnChecksAndReceipts || mDefs.RvcParm.Format.PrintTransNumberOnChecksAndReceipts)
                AddWorkstationAndTransactionLine();
            mPrintStr.Clear();

        // TP 100910
        /// <summary>
        /// Show descriptor of any 'group' event assigned to this check.
        /// </summary>
        private void FormatEventDescriptor()
            if (mCheck.EventDefDtlID > 0L)
                string checkCurrentEventShortCode = string.Empty;
                string checkCurrentEventName = string.Empty;

                DbGroupEventDefDtl eventDefDtl = mDefs.DS.ReadGroupEventDefDtlByID(new DbKey.GroupEventDefDtlID(mCheck.EventDefDtlID));
                if (eventDefDtl != null)
                    DbGroupEventDef checkEventdef = mDefs.DS.ReadGroupEventDefByID(eventDefDtl.GroupEventDefID);
                    if (checkEventdef != null)
                        checkCurrentEventName = checkEventdef.Name.GetString(mLangData.LangId);
                        int ind = checkEventdef.EventCode.IndexOf('|');
                        if (ind > 0)
                            checkCurrentEventShortCode = checkEventdef.EventCode.Substring(0, ind);

                        AddBlankLines(1);
                        FormatDescriptorLine((!StringUtils.IsBlank(checkCurrentEventShortCode) ? checkCurrentEventShortCode + " - " : string.Empty) + checkCurrentEventName);

        private void FormatStandardCheckDetail()
            if (mPrintSeatCheck)
                FormatSeatDetail();
            else
                FormatCheckDetail();

        private void FormatCheckDetail()
            //If this is the 2nd or subsequent round on a roll printer, optionally print the previous balance.
            if (mRollPrinter && mParameters.RoundByRound && mDefs.RvcParm.Format.PrintPrevBal && mCheck.PageNumber > 1)
                AddNameAndTotalIfNotZero(EPrintingIds.PreviousBalance, mCheck.PreviousBalance);

            //92517 | Holds the status if the printing is meant for the Journal or not.
            base.FormatForJournal = this.mParameters.FormatForJournal;

            //Find the maximum width of any formatted prices so we can better align the pricrs on the guest check.
            mMaxPriceWidth = GetMaximumPriceWidth();

            if (mPrintMemoCheck)
                PrintMultiSeatHeader(mCheck.Detail.SeatFilter.ToArray());

            //106044 Belgium Tax Label umacherl
            //TODO: Add support for switching from single-wide to double-wide languages.
            //      This method needs to be called after we have sorted the check detail but before we start adding print lines.
            //      It needs to set the properties for both single and double wide printing
            //      When switching languages  between single and double-wide we need to switch the new column positions.
            SetColumnPositionsForPricesAndTaxLabels();

            foreach (SortedDetailBase line in mSortedList)
                SortedDetailBase sortedDetail = line;

                //2.5: Added use of option.
                if (mDefs.RvcParm.Format.TmedAfterSummary && line is TenderSortedDetail)
                    continue;

                // FPS-25006 | Skip tender lines in equal payment chit
                if (mParameters.EqualPaymentChit && line is TenderSortedDetail)
                    continue;

                // FPS-25006 | Skip change due lines in final check receipt or guest check print during equal payment
                if (line is TenderSortedDetail && line.DetailItem != null && line.DetailItem.IsChange())
                    continue;

                if (mParameters.EqualPaymentUsed && line is TenderSortedDetail)
                    sortedDetail = ProcessEqualPaymentTenderDetail(line);

                //Sinphony 3.0: Moved the code to handle printing menu items only (for Belgium Guest Checks) to the sorting code.
                //if (mDefs.BelgiumGuestCheck) .....

                FormatCheckDetailLine(sortedDetail, mParameters.Reprint);

            AddBlankLines(1);

        private SortedDetailBase ProcessEqualPaymentTenderDetail(SortedDetailBase line)
            try
                // FPS-25006 | Calculate the equal payment amount when overtendering a cash equal payment (payment - change due)
                int lineIndex = mSortedList.IndexOf(line);
                if (lineIndex >= 0)
                    for (int i = lineIndex + 1; i < mSortedList.Count; i++)
                        // Try to find the corresponding change due detail for the cash over tender
                        SortedDetailBase nextLine = mSortedList[i];
                        if (nextLine is TenderSortedDetail)
                            if (nextLine.DetailItem.IsChange())
                                SortedDetailBase sortedDetail = new TenderSortedDetail(line.DetailItem as DbTenderMediaDetail, mDefs.BaseCurrencyDp, null, mFormatter.NumFmtInfo);
                                sortedDetail.Amount += nextLine.Amount;
                                return sortedDetail;

                            break;
            catch (Exception)

            return line;

        private void FormatEqualPaymentChitSummaryTotals()
            List<ESummaryType> list = new List<ESummaryType>();

            if (mDefs.BelgiumGuestCheck)
                list.Add(ESummaryType.SUBTOTAL);
                list.Add(ESummaryType.TAX_LABEL_SUMMARY);
            else
                list.Add(ESummaryType.SUBTOTAL);
                list.Add(ESummaryType.NON_CHG_TIP_SVC_CHG_TOTAL);
                list.Add(ESummaryType.AUTO_SVC_CHG_TOTAL);

                AddInclusiveTaxTotals(list);

                if (mDefs.TaxParameters.TaxOpAddOn)
                    if (mDefs.TaxParameters.PrintTaxItemizers)
                        list.Add(ESummaryType.TAX_RATE_TOTALS);
                    else
                        list.Add(ESummaryType.TAX_TOTAL);

            list.Add(ESummaryType.EQUAL_PAYMENT_TOTAL);

            FormatSummaryTotals(list);

        private void FormatStandardSummaryTotals()
            // Journal always prints summary totals
            if (!mPrintSummaryTotals && !mIsForJournal)
                return;

            List<ESummaryType> list = new List<ESummaryType>();

            if (mDefs.BelgiumGuestCheck)
                list.Add(ESummaryType.SUBTOTAL);
                list.Add(ESummaryType.PAYMENT_TOTAL);
                list.Add(ESummaryType.BLANK_LINE);
                list.Add(ESummaryType.TAX_LABEL_SUMMARY);
            else
                // option bit does not apply to journal
                if (mDefs.RvcParm.Tax.PrintInclusiveTaxTotalsBeforeSummary && !mIsForJournal)
                    AddInclusiveTaxTotals(list);

                if (mDbTender.PrintSlsItmzrs && !mIsForJournal)
                    list.Add(ESummaryType.SALES_ITEMIZERS);
                    list.Add(ESummaryType.DISCOUNT_TOTAL);
                else
                    list.Add(ESummaryType.SUBTOTAL);

                list.Add(ESummaryType.SVC_CHG_TOTAL);
                list.Add(ESummaryType.AUTO_SVC_CHG_TOTAL);

                if (mDefs.TaxParameters.TaxOpAddOn)
                    if (mDefs.TaxParameters.PrintTaxItemizers && !mIsForJournal)
                        list.Add(ESummaryType.TAX_RATE_TOTALS);
                    else
                        list.Add(ESummaryType.TAX_TOTAL);

                list.Add(ESummaryType.PAYMENT_TOTAL);

            if (!mDefs.RvcParm.Tax.PrintInclusiveTaxTotalsBeforeSummary && !mIsForJournal)
                AddInclusiveTaxTotals(list);

            FormatSummaryTotals(list);

            if (mDefs.RvcParm.Format.TmedAfterSummary)
                PrintTenderDetail();

        //Simphony 2.6: Added printing of inclusive tax totals and hence renamed from "AddVatLines()"
        private void AddInclusiveTaxTotals(List<ESummaryType> list)
            if (mDbTender.PrintInclusiveTaxTotals)
                if (mDefs.TaxParameters.TaxOpVat)
                    list.Add(mDefs.RvcParm.Tax.GcPrntNetVat ? ESummaryType.TAX_RATE_TOTALS_NET : ESummaryType.TAX_RATE_TOTALS);

                    if (mDefs.RvcParm.Tax.GcPrntConsolVat)
                        list.Add(ESummaryType.TAX_TOTAL);

                if (mDefs.TaxParameters.TaxOpAddOn)
                    if (mDefs.TaxParameters.PrintItemInclusiveTaxTotal)
                        list.Add(ESummaryType.ITEM_INCLUSIVE_TAX_TOTAL);

                    if (mDefs.TaxParameters.PrintCheckInclusiveTaxTotal)
                        list.Add(ESummaryType.CHECK_INCLUSIVE_TAX_TOTAL);

        private void FormatStandardCheckTrailer()
            if (mDefs.QuebecSrmDebugLimitOutput)
                return;                                //Limit output in test mode

            if (mPrintTrailer)
                AddBlankLines(1);

                if (mDefs.TaxParameters.EnableCanadaGst)
                    PrintCanadianTrailer();

                // 100817 | gwelivita | if the check is a waste, use waste trailer to print check
                var trailer = mCheck.IsWasteActive ? mDefs.RvcDesc.WasteTrailer : mDefs.RvcDesc.CheckTrailer;
                FormatDescriptors(trailer, mPrintTrailerIncludedBlankLine /*printIncludedBlankLines*/ );
            if (mCheck.RvcParmDef.Format.PrintEventOnChecksAndReceiptsAfterTrlr)  // TP #100910.  Show any 'group' event associated with current check
                FormatEventDescriptor();

            //If configured, this prints regardless of whether we are printing the trailer           .
            if (mIsCustReceipt)
                AddOrderNumberBanner();

            if (mCheck.RvcParmDef.Format.PrintInfoAfterTrlr)
                FormatCheckInfo(mCheck.Detail, true);

            // TP's 121078, 121088 and 121094.  Show a footer with DTO information specific to order method used
            if (mCheck.IsDTOCheck && !mIsCustReceipt && !mCheck.IsWasteActive)
                FormatDTOTrailer();

        /// <summary>
        /// Added for Australian GST EPIC FPPRT-2209
        /// </summary>
        private void FormatAustralianGSTRequirementLines()
            bool isAusGST = mDefs.Check.ITaxParm.TaxOpAddOn && mDefs.Check.ITaxParm.PostInclTaxToNetSalesTotal;
            bool showAsteriskIndicator = mDefs.RvcParm.Format.ShowAsteriskIndicator;

            if(!showAsteriskIndicator)
                //print nothing if Format parameter option 61 is disabled
                return;

            //FPS-84844 | PARTCHAT | Print tax free indicator line only if the check has tax free items
            bool checkHasInclTaxFreeItems = false;

            if(mDefs.Check.ClosedCheckVoid)
                //Look for current round voided menu items for which SetInclusiveTaxToZero is true to find out if there are any tax free items in the check being voided.
                checkHasInclTaxFreeItems = mDefs.Check.IDetail.GetFlattenedList().Where(d => d is DbMenuItemDetail mi && mi.Void && !mi.PrevRnd && mi.SetInclusiveTaxToZero == true).Any();
            else
                checkHasInclTaxFreeItems = mDefs.Check.IDetail.GetActiveMenuItemList().Where(i => i.SetInclusiveTaxToZero == true).Any();

            if (!isAusGST && showAsteriskIndicator)
                //This part will work when International option 18 is OFF and Format parameter option 61 is ON. This is legacy printing code for R&A 9.1 backward compatibility.
                FormatLegacyRequirementLines(checkHasInclTaxFreeItems);
                return;

            /* FPS - 3374 | vkmadupa | Print Inclusive tax descriptor
             * FPS - 3696 | vkmadupa | Show amount as currency string
             * Related FPPRT-2209 AUS GST tickets: FPS-57863, FPS-59189, FPS-59281, FPS-60204, FPS-60759 and FPS-62510
             * Authors: PARTCHAT and CKGOUGH*/

            //If the code lands here then it means both International option 18 and Format parameter option 61 are ON and we need to print in new format
            if (mDefs.Check.ClosedCheckVoid && !mDefs.RvcParm.Format.VoidClosedCheckPrintFull)
                //FPS-61022 | Do not print Australian GST lines for a voided check if Format parameters > option 51 is OFF
                return;

            if (mDbTender.PrintInclusiveTaxTotals)
                AddBlankLines(1);

                string currencySymbol = mDefs.CurrencyParameters.BaseCurrency.Symbol.GetString(mDefs.LangId);

                // Set up a projection on the tax rates so we can inspect
                var inclusiveTaxRates = mDefs.TaxParameters.Taxes.TaxRate.Where(rate => rate.IsInclusiveTax && rate.IsEnabled);

                // This first case is in error because you have PostInclTaxToNetSalesTotal set to true and there are no inclusive rates so lets complain to the log
                if (!inclusiveTaxRates.Any())
                    LogUtils.LogAlways($"Australian GST Option is Configured in Tax Parameters but no inclusive taxes were found in the configuration");
                    // Nothing to do
                    return;

                // The code below doesn't at first glance make a whole lot of sense. But what's going on here is we are looking for a needle in a configuration haystack.
                // The needle we are looking for is the Inclusive Tax Rate Name for Australian GST. The haystack is the taxes and order type configuration.
                // Order Type Parameters can be Enterprise, Property, Revenue Center or Zone and the Tax Rates can be can be Enterprise, Property, or Zone.
                // ------------------------
                // One approach to this problem is to "Tag" the Tax rate as a GST tax rate (option bit maybe), but this is not a pattern we follow and it would
                // potentially goof up the hirearchy configuration or possibly require the customer to use a more specific/complex configuration to achieve what's coded below.
                // So we picked what's below as the solution, its not perfect but it ought to work well in a GST configured System.
                // -----------------------
                // The solution is to pick the first active order type in the configuration and then pick the first active inclusive tax from that order type.
                // It's a complicated solution and I have come back here a few times now to look at it. But it's been discussed and Jochen made a really good
                // case for this approach and the code works so this note is here to explain to the next person why we did what we did.

                //we need the first active order type
                DbOrderTypeParameter firstActiveOrderType = null;
                TaxRates taxRates = new TaxRates();
                try
                    // Order Types are not sorted so its possible that yo take an active order type from the bottom. Here we sort the lits by Order Type Index.
                    var orderType = mDefs.DS.ReadAllOrderTypeParameters(mDefs.Check.RvcIdInt).OrderBy(ot => ot.OrdTypeIndex);
                    firstActiveOrderType = orderType.Where(ot => ot.OtIsActive).First();
                catch (Exception ex)
                    LogUtils.LogAlways(string.Format("Error reading first active order type from DataStore. Exception: {0}. Using check order type.", ex.ToString()));

                taxRates = firstActiveOrderType != null ? new TaxRates(new Bits(firstActiveOrderType.TaxMask)) : new TaxRates(new Bits(mDefs.Check.IOrderType.TaxEnabled));

                TaxRateDef taxRateDef = null;

                //we need the first active tax rate in above order type
                bool foundOne = false;
                for (int i = 0; i < taxRates.Count; i++)
                    if (taxRates.RateIsActive(i + 1))
                        if (foundOne)
                            //for the first active tax rate, we will set foundOne to true so that for the next active rate we can write below log
                            LogUtils.Log(GATEWAY.ELogLevel.DETAIL_FLOW, $"Australian GST Option is Configured in International Tax Parameters and two tax rates are " +
                            $"active in the first active order type in this property. Note: Ops prints the name of the first active tax rate on the check");
                            break;

                        taxRateDef = mDefs.TaxParameters.Taxes.TaxRate[i];
                        foundOne = true;

                string taxRateName = taxRateDef != null ? taxRateDef.IName.GetString(mDefs.LangId) : string.Empty;

                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(taxRateName))
                    //add log - this is the first active tax rate of the first active order type
                    LogUtils.LogAlways(string.Format("Printing Aus GST configured check: First active tax rate in first active order type is {0}", taxRateName));
                else
                    //add log - we couldn't get the appropriate tax info. Maybe some misconfiguration happened.
                    LogUtils.LogAlways(string.Format("Printing Aus GST configured check: Could not get first active tax rate in first active order type. Please recheck your configuration"));

                // Get the Totals from the Base Totals
                decimal taxTotal = mDefs.Check.CurrentBaseTotals.ItemInclusiveTaxTotal;
                decimal taxableTotal = mDefs.Check.CurrentBaseTotals.TaxableSales.Sum() + taxTotal;

                if (mDefs.Check.ClosedCheckVoid)
                    // We are voiding the closed check the totals will be an inverse of the previous base totals
                    taxTotal = decimal.Negate(mDefs.Check.PreviousBaseTotals.ItemInclusiveTaxTotal);
                    taxableTotal = decimal.Negate(mDefs.Check.PreviousBaseTotals.TaxableSales.Sum() + mDefs.Check.PreviousBaseTotals.ItemInclusiveTaxTotal);

                string taxInfo = string.Empty.PadLeft(3) + taxRateName;
                string taxableInfo = string.Empty.PadLeft(3) + GetPrintingText(EPrintingIds.AustralianGSTTaxable);

                //adjust the alignment on check
                int diff = taxableInfo.Length - taxInfo.Length;
                string temp = string.Empty;

                if (diff >= 0)
                    temp = temp.PadRight(diff + 3) + currencySymbol + GetCurrencyString(taxTotal);
                    taxInfo += temp;
                    temp = string.Empty;
                    temp = temp.PadRight(3) + currencySymbol + GetCurrencyString(taxableTotal);
                    taxableInfo += temp;
                else
                    temp = temp.PadRight(-diff + 3) + currencySymbol + GetCurrencyString(taxableTotal);
                    taxableInfo += temp;
                    temp = string.Empty;
                    temp = temp.PadRight(3) + currencySymbol + GetCurrencyString(taxTotal);
                    taxInfo += temp;

                AddPaddedLine(taxInfo);
                AddPaddedLine(taxableInfo);

            //FPS-84844 | PARTCHAT | Print the tax free indicator line only if check has tax free menu items.
            if (checkHasInclTaxFreeItems)
                AddBlankLines(1);
                AddCenteredLineSW(StringUtils.SafeStringFormat(GetPrintingText(EPrintingIds.InclusiveTaxFreeIndicator)));

        private void FormatLegacyRequirementLines(bool checkHasInclTaxFreeItems)
            //print tax line only if tender media option 24 is enabled
            if (mDbTender.PrintInclusiveTaxTotals)
                //FPS-63784 | PARTCHAT | Get the check Total from the Base Totals
                IBaseTotals baseTotals = mDefs.Check.CurrentBaseTotals;
                decimal checkTotal = baseTotals.SalesTotal + baseTotals.DiscountTotal;

                //Add service charge or automatic service charge only if they are taxable
                decimal svcTotal = mDefs.Check.IDetail.GetFlattenedList().Where(cdi => cdi is DbServiceChargeDetail svc && svc.Taxes.AnyBitsSet && svc.InclusiveTax != 0m)
                                        .Sum(s => s.Total);
                svcTotal += baseTotals.AutoSvcInclusiveTaxTotal != 0m ? baseTotals.AutoSvcTotal : 0m;
                checkTotal += svcTotal;

                AddBlankLines(1);
                AddPaddedLine(StringUtils.SafeStringFormat(GetPrintingText(EPrintingIds.InclusiveTaxDescriptor),
                    GetCurrencyString(baseTotals.ItemInclusiveTaxTotal), GetCurrencyString(checkTotal)));

            //FPS-84844 | PARTCHAT | Print the tax free indicator line only if check has tax free menu items.
            if (checkHasInclTaxFreeItems)
                AddBlankLines(1);
                AddCenteredLineSW(StringUtils.SafeStringFormat(GetPrintingText(EPrintingIds.InclusiveTaxFreeIndicator)));

        /// <summary>
        ///
        /// </summary>
        private void PrintCanadianTrailer()
            if (mDefs.TaxParameters.CanadianGst.PrintTrailer && mDefs.RvcDesc.CanadianTaxTrailer.Count > 0)
                decimal ttl = mCheck.TotalDue + mCheck.Payment;

                // e7 uses 2 separate trailers instead of this weirdo re-use of one trailer!
                if (mDefs.TaxParameters.CanadianGst.Threshold2 != 0m && PosTransaction.Abstractions.Utility.MathUtils.AbsCompare(ttl, mDefs.TaxParameters.CanadianGst.Threshold2) >= 0)
                    PrintCanadianTrailerSkippingLine1();           // Print lines 2 through 6 if sale amount exceeds threshold2
                else if (mDefs.TaxParameters.CanadianGst.Threshold1 != 0m && PosTransaction.Abstractions.Utility.MathUtils.AbsCompare(ttl, mDefs.TaxParameters.CanadianGst.Threshold1) >= 0)
                    PrintCanadianTrailerLine1Only();                // Print line 1 only if sale amount exceeds threshold 1 only

        private void PrintCanadianTrailerSkippingLine1()
            int i = 0;
            int blankLineCount = 0;

            //89144 | v-ikottachchi | 13th Feb. 2015 | first format all the descriptor lines for primary language
            PrintCanadianTrailerSkippingLine1(ref i, ref blankLineCount, true /*isPrimaryLanguage*/ );

            //89144 | v-ikottachchi | 19th Feb. 2015 | format all the descriptor lines for other languages
            foreach (LanguageData langData in mPrintLangList)
                AddBlankLines(1); // adding blank line before printing descriptors in defferent language
                blankLineCount = 0;
                SwitchLanguage(langData);

                PrintCanadianTrailerSkippingLine1(ref i, ref blankLineCount, false /*isPrimaryLanguage*/ );

            //After formatting, switch back to primary language
            SwitchToMainLanguage();

        private void PrintCanadianTrailerSkippingLine1(ref int i, ref int blankLineCount, bool isPrimaryLanguage)
            foreach (Descriptor entry in mDefs.RvcDesc.CanadianTaxTrailer.Values)
                if (i++ != 0)
                    FormatDescriptorLine(false /*printTrailingBlankLines*/,
                                ref blankLineCount,
                                entry.Name,
                                DataStore.DescriptorTypes.CanadianTaxTrailer,
                                isPrimaryLanguage);

        private void PrintCanadianTrailerLine1Only()
            int blankLineCount = 0;

            if (mDefs.RvcDesc.CanadianTaxTrailer.Count > 0)
                //#117864 Canadian Tax Trailer | Line 1 fails to print with exception error
                FormatDescriptorLine(false /*printTrailingBlankLines*/, ref blankLineCount, mDefs.RvcDesc.CanadianTaxTrailer.Values[0],
                               DataStore.DescriptorTypes.CanadianTaxTrailer, true /*isPrimaryLanguage*/ );

            //89144 | v-ikottachchi | 19th Feb. 2015 | format all the descriptor lines for other languages
            foreach (LanguageData langData in mPrintLangList)
                AddBlankLines(1); // adding blank line before printing descriptors in defferent language
                blankLineCount = 0;
                SwitchLanguage(langData);

                //#117864 Canadian Tax Trailer | Line 1 fails to print with exception error
                FormatDescriptorLine(false /*printTrailingBlankLines*/, ref blankLineCount, mDefs.RvcDesc.CanadianTaxTrailer.Values[0],
                               DataStore.DescriptorTypes.CanadianTaxTrailer, false /*isPrimaryLanguage*/ );

            //After formatting, switch back to primary language
            SwitchToMainLanguage();

        /// <summary>
        /// Show a footer with DTO information specific to order method used

        private void FormatDTOTrailer()
            DTOPrintParameters parameters = new DTOPrintParameters();
            parameters.GC = mCheck;
            parameters.CourierName = mCheck.DeliveryEmployeeName;
            DTOGuestCheckTrailer.Print(mParameters.PrintInfo, mDefs, mPrintJob, parameters);

        protected void FormatSummaryTotals(List<ESummaryType> list)
            //TP 9459 - Conditionally print delta when printing a voided closed check.
            if (mCheck.ClosedCheckVoid && mDefs.RvcParm.Format.VoidClosedCheckPrintFull)
                mDeltaTotals = true;
            else
                //TODO: FUTURE: Special on-demand operators can go several rounds without printing. We could write the non-trivial code to generate the delta totals
                //              in this case but it makes more sense to defer this until someone requests this.
                mDeltaTotals = mDefs.RvcParm.Format.PrintDeltaTtls && mParameters.RoundByRound && mParameters.StartRoundNumber > 1 &&
                                 mParameters.EndRoundNumber == mParameters.StartRoundNumber;                //this is the clause that detects a several round of detail

            decimal amount = 0m;

            foreach (ESummaryType type in list)
                switch (type)
                    case ESummaryType.DISCOUNT_TOTAL:
                        amount = mDeltaTotals ? mCurrent.DiscountTotal - mPrevious.DiscountTotal : mCurrent.DiscountTotal;
                        PrintSummaryTotalIfNotZero(EPrintingIds.Discount, amount);
                        break;

                    case ESummaryType.PAYMENT_TOTAL:
                        PrintPaymentTotal(true);
                        break;

                    case ESummaryType.PAYMENT_TOTAL_NO_ROUNDING:
                        PrintPaymentTotal(false);
                        break;

                    case ESummaryType.EQUAL_PAYMENT_TOTAL:
                        PrintEqualPaymentTotal();
                        break;

                    case ESummaryType.SALES_ITEMIZERS:
                        PrintSalesItemizers();
                        break;

                    case ESummaryType.SUBTOTAL:
                        decimal currentSubTtl = mCurrent.SalesTotal + mCurrent.DiscountTotal;
                        decimal prevSubTtl = mPrevious.SalesTotal + mPrevious.DiscountTotal;
                        amount = mDeltaTotals ? currentSubTtl - prevSubTtl : currentSubTtl;

                        if (mParameters.EqualPaymentChit)
                            PrintSummaryTotal(mDefs.RvcDesc.Subtotal, amount);
                        else if (mDefs.BelgiumGuestCheck)
                            PrintTotalDueInternal(true);
                        else
                            PrintSummaryTotalIfNotZero(mDefs.RvcDesc.Subtotal, amount);

                        break;

                    case ESummaryType.SVC_CHG_TOTAL:
                        amount = mDeltaTotals ? mCurrent.ServiceChargeTotal - mPrevious.ServiceChargeTotal : mCurrent.ServiceChargeTotal;
                        PrintSummaryTotalIfNotZero(mDefs.RvcDesc.Other, amount);
                        break;

                    case ESummaryType.AUTO_SVC_CHG_TOTAL:
                        if (mCheck.AutoServiceChargeActive)
                            amount = mDeltaTotals ? mCurrent.AutoSvcTotal - mPrevious.AutoSvcTotal : mCurrent.AutoSvcTotal;
                            PrintSummaryTotalIfNotZero(mCheck.AutomaticServiceCharge.Name, amount);
                        break;

                    case ESummaryType.NON_CHG_TIP_SVC_CHG_TOTAL:
                        if (mDeltaTotals)
                            decimal currentAmount = mCurrent.ServiceChargeTotal - mCurrent.ChargedTipTotal;
                            decimal previousAmount = mPrevious.ServiceChargeTotal - mPrevious.ChargedTipTotal;
                            amount = currentAmount - previousAmount;
                        else
                            amount = mCurrent.ServiceChargeTotal - mCurrent.ChargedTipTotal;

                        PrintSummaryTotalIfNotZero(mDefs.RvcDesc.Other, amount);
                        break;

                    case ESummaryType.TAX_RATE_TOTALS:
                        PrintTaxRates(false);
                        break;

                    case ESummaryType.TAX_RATE_TOTALS_NET:
                        PrintTaxRates(true);
                        break;

                    case ESummaryType.TAX_TOTAL:
                        PrintTaxTotal();
                        break;

                    //106044 - Belgian Tax : umacherl
                    case ESummaryType.TAX_LABEL_SUMMARY:
                        PrintTaxSummaryWithLabels();
                        break;

                    case ESummaryType.CHECK_INCLUSIVE_TAX_TOTAL:
                        // TPID 21127 : inclusive taxes should be checked for mDeltaTotals value too for the check void operations, so that proper inclusive tax shows up
                        amount = mDeltaTotals ? mDefs.Check.CurrentBaseTotals.CheckInclusiveTaxTotal - mDefs.Check.PreviousBaseTotals.CheckInclusiveTaxTotal : mDefs.Check.CurrentBaseTotals.CheckInclusiveTaxTotal;

                        if (mDefs.TaxParameters.PrintZeroInclusiveTaxTotals)
                            PrintSummaryTotal(EPrintingIds.CheckInclusiveTaxTotal, amount);
                        else
                            PrintSummaryTotalIfNotZero(EPrintingIds.CheckInclusiveTaxTotal, amount);

                        break;

                    case ESummaryType.ITEM_INCLUSIVE_TAX_TOTAL:
                        //For FPS-26912 Tax Label tax is showing the Inclusive Item tax and not the Check Total tax
                        //EMC -->Tax parameter --> Enabled "17 -Enable Tax label" in that case item tax should not be displayed in Print text :Puspendu
                        if (mDefs.TaxParameters.EnableBelgianTax)
                            continue;
                        // TPID 21127 : inclusive taxes should be checked for mDeltaTotals value too for the check void operations, so that proper inclusive tax shows up
                        amount = mDeltaTotals ? mDefs.Check.CurrentBaseTotals.ItemInclusiveTaxTotal - mDefs.Check.PreviousBaseTotals.ItemInclusiveTaxTotal : mDefs.Check.CurrentBaseTotals.ItemInclusiveTaxTotal;

                        if (mDefs.TaxParameters.PrintZeroInclusiveTaxTotals)
                            PrintSummaryTotal(EPrintingIds.ItemInclusiveTaxTotal, amount);
                        else
                            PrintSummaryTotalIfNotZero(EPrintingIds.ItemInclusiveTaxTotal, amount);

                        break;

                    case ESummaryType.BLANK_LINE:
                        AddBlankLines(1);
                        break;

        protected void PrintSalesItemizers()
            //if ( mJobPrintOptions.PrintSlsItmzrs )        //2.5: Removed: not needed as we don't here if this option not set!
            for (short i = 0; i < mCurrent.SalesItemizer.Length; i++)
                decimal amount = mDeltaTotals ? mCurrent.SalesItemizer[i] - mPrevious.SalesItemizer[i] : mCurrent.SalesItemizer[i];
                PrintSummaryTotalIfNotZero(mDefs.RvcDesc.SalesItemizers.FindByIndex((short)(i + 1)).Name, amount);

        protected void PrintTotalDue()
            // Journal does not print in DW
            if (mIsForJournal)
                AddNameAndTotalIfNotZero(mDefs.RvcDesc.TotalDue, mCheck.TotalDue);
                return;

            PrintTotalDueInternal(false);                        //Print in the main language.

            if (mPrintLangList.Count > 0)
                foreach (LanguageData langData in mPrintLangList)
                    SwitchLanguage(langData);
                    PrintTotalDueInternal(false);

                SwitchToMainLanguage();

        /// <summary>
        ///
        /// </summary>
        private void PrintTotalDueInternal(bool isSubTotal)
            string Desc = isSubTotal ? mDefs.RvcDesc.Subtotal.GetString(mLangData.LangId) : mDefs.RvcDesc.TotalDue.GetString(mLangData.LangId);
            ReverseWordsIfArabaic(ref Desc);

            string TotalDue = isSubTotal ? GetBaseCncyWithDesc(mCheck.Subtotal, false) : GetBaseCncyWithDesc(mCheck.TotalDue, false);     //Simphony 2.7: Convert numerals if langauge so configured.

            //Simphony 2.5: TPID #11365: Added use of legacy option.
            if (mDefs.RvcParm.Format.PrntTimeAtService)
                string lhs = mFormatter.TimeLocal(DateTime.Now, false /*showSeconds*/ );

                string rhs;
                if (mPrimaryLangData.RightToLeft)
                    rhs = String.Format("{0} {1}", TotalDue, Desc);
                else
                    rhs = String.Format("{0} {1}", Desc, TotalDue);

                //106044 Belgian Tax Label - umacherl
                if (mDefs.RvcParm.Format.DontPrintChangePaymentDueinDW)
                    AddLineLeftAndRightJustified(lhs, rhs, true/*rightJustfyIf2LinesNeeded*/);
                else
                    AddLineLeftAndRightJustifiedDW(lhs, rhs, true /*rightJustfyIf2LinesNeeded*/);
            else
                //106044 Belgian Tax Label - umacherl
                if (mDefs.RvcParm.Format.DontPrintChangePaymentDueinDW)
                    if (isSubTotal)
                        AddLineLeftAndRightJustified(EJournalIds.Subtotal, mCheck.Subtotal, false, true);
                    else
                        AddLineLeftAndRightJustified(EJournalIds.PaymentDue, mCheck.TotalDue, false, true);
                else
                    AddLineLeftAndRightJustifiedDW(Desc, TotalDue, true);

        protected void PrintTaxTotal()
            if (mDefs.TaxParameters.TaxOpAddOn)
                PrintAddOnTaxTotal();
            else
                PrintVatTaxTotal();

        private void PrintAddOnTaxTotal()
            if (mDefs.TaxParameters.EnableCanadaGst)
                FormatCanadaTax();
            else
                // TPID : 21127 if closed check void is hit the mDelta totals would be true pertaining format parameters option - 51, so we differentiate the previous round and this round totals
                decimal amount = mDeltaTotals ? mCurrent.TaxTotal - mPrevious.TaxTotal : mCurrent.TaxTotal;
                PrintSummaryTotalIfNotZero(mDefs.RvcDesc.Tax, amount);

            //Florida Surcharge is no longer in effect in Florida.
            //decimal surchargeTaxTotal = 0m;             //Where do we get florida surcharge from?
            //PrintNameAndTotalIfNotZero( EPrintingIds.Surcharge, surchargeTaxTotal );

        private void PrintVatTaxTotal()
            decimal taxable = 0m;
            decimal tax = 0m;

            for (int i = 0; i < TaxRates.NumTaxRates; i++)
                TaxRateDef taxRateDef = mDefs.TaxParameters.Taxes.TaxRate[i];

                if (!taxRateDef.IsInclusiveTax)
                    continue;
                tax += (mDeltaTotals ? mCurrent.Tax[i] - mPrevious.Tax[i] : mCurrent.Tax[i]);

            //SATHRAJA | FPS-16484 | the total taxable amount is the amount of the check less the amount of inclusive tax taken out
            //FPS-66583 | PARTCHAT | Get total taxable amount
            taxable = GetVatTaxTotalTaxable();

            PrintVatLine(mDefs.RvcParm.Tax.GcPrntNetVat, mDefs.RvcDesc.Tax.Name, tax, taxable, taxable - tax);

        private decimal GetVatTaxTotalTaxable()
            decimal taxable = 0m;

            //Total taxable amount should be sum of the totals of those MI, discount and service charge details for which VATExt != 0
            var dtls = mDefs.Check.Detail.GetFlattenedList().Where(i => i is DbMenuItemDetail || i is DbDiscountDetail || i is DbServiceChargeDetail);
            taxable = dtls.Where(i => i.VATExt != 0m).Sum(i => i.Total);

            //If the below option is enabled, we need taxable value for MIs taxed at 0% VAT rate
            if (mDefs.Check.TransState.TaxParm.PostTaxableSalesWhenTaxRateZero)
                foreach(var dtl in dtls)
                    if(dtl is DbMenuItemDetail miDtl)
                        taxable += miDtl.TaxDataPerRate.Where(trd => trd.Value.Inclusive && trd.Value.Tax == 0m).Sum(trd => trd.Value.Taxable);

            //Add automatic taxable service charge taxable total
            taxable += mDefs.Check.CurrentBaseTotals.AutoSvcVatTaxExtTotal != 0m ?
                mDefs.Check.CurrentBaseTotals.AutoSvcTaxable.Where(val => val != 0m).FirstOrDefault() : 0m;

            return taxable;
