        //protected void GetInclusiveTax()
        //protected void PrinInclusiveTaxTotal()

        protected void PrintTaxRates(bool printNetVat)
            if (mDefs.TaxParameters.TaxOpAddOn)
                FormatTaxRates(); // FPS-32641 | vkmadupa | Renamed to print both Addon and Inclusive tax rates
            else
                FormatVatTaxRates(printNetVat);

        protected void PrintPaymentTotal(bool showRounding)

            // TPID 21127 : print payment totals and rounding totals must be checked for mDetalTotals for the proper value in case of check void operation
            if ((showRounding && mCurrent.SumOfRoundingTotal != 0m) || (showRounding && mDeltaTotals && (mCurrent.SumOfRoundingTotal - mPrevious.SumOfRoundingTotal != 0m)))
                decimal rounding = mDeltaTotals ? mCurrent.SumOfRoundingTotal - mPrevious.SumOfRoundingTotal : mCurrent.SumOfRoundingTotal;
                PrintSummaryTotalIfNotZero(EPrintingIds.RoundingTotal, rounding);

                //JIRA[FPS - 19068], SRM needs exact total before rouding
                if (mPrintJob.QuebecSrmConfiguredAndEnabled)
                    PrintSummaryTotalIfNotZero(EPrintingIds.OriginalTotal, mCheck.GrandTotal - rounding);

            if (mCurrent.Payments != 0m || (mDeltaTotals && (mCurrent.Payments - mPrevious.Payments != 0m)))
                if (mDefs.RvcParm.Format.PrntAmtPaidDw)
                    AddNameAndCurrencyTotalDW(mDefs.RvcDesc.Payment, (mDeltaTotals) ? mCurrent.Payments - mPrevious.Payments : mCurrent.Payments);
                else
                    PrintSummaryTotalIfNotZero(mDefs.RvcDesc.Payment, (mDeltaTotals) ? mCurrent.Payments - mPrevious.Payments : mCurrent.Payments);

            // Print change due double wide
            decimal changeDue = (mDeltaTotals) ? mCurrent.ChangeDueTotal - mPrevious.ChangeDueTotal : mCurrent.ChangeDueTotal;

            if (mCheck.PaidInFull || changeDue > 0)
                // Journal does not print change due in DW
                if (mIsForJournal)
                    AddNameAndTotalIfNotZero(EPrintingIds.ChangeDue, changeDue);
                // FPS-25006 | Skip change due line in final check receipt or guest check print during equal payment
                else if (mDefs.RvcParm.Format.DisableChangeDue == false && !mParameters.EqualPaymentUsed)
                    //106044 Belgian Tax Label - umacherl
                    if (mDefs.RvcParm.Format.DontPrintChangePaymentDueinDW)
                        AddLineLeftAndRightJustified(EPrintingIds.ChangeDue, changeDue, false, true);
                    else
                        AddNameAndCurrencyTotalDW(EPrintingIds.ChangeDue, changeDue);

                    PrintForeignChangeDue();

            // Print total due
            if (!mCheck.PaidInFull)
                PrintTotalDue();
                PrintForeignCurrencyAmount(mCheck.ForeignAmountDue);

        protected void PrintEqualPaymentTotal()
            PrintSummaryTotalIfNotZero(EPrintingIds.RoundingTotal, mCheck.CurrentBaseTotals.SumOfRoundingTotal);

            PrintSummaryTotal(mDefs.RvcDesc.TotalDue, mParameters.EPPParameters.TotalDue);

            ITranslatableString AmountDueStr = new TranslatableFormatter(mParameters.EPPParameters.IsCreditAuthorization ? EPrintingIds.EqualPaymentDueAndNumber : EPrintingIds.EqualPaymentNumber, PosCoreTransText.Text, new object[] { mParameters.EPPParameters.CurrentPaymentNumber, mParameters.EPPParameters.NumberOfPayments });

            PrintSummaryTotal(AmountDueStr, mParameters.EPPParameters.CurrentPaymentAmountDue);

            if (mParameters.EPPParameters.PaymentDetail != null)
                foreach (SortedDetailBase line in mSortedList)
                    if (line is TenderSortedDetail && line.DetailItem.DetailLink == mParameters.EPPParameters.PaymentDetail.DetailLink)
                        FormatCheckDetailLine(line);
                        break;

            AddBlankLines(1);

            // Change due in base and foreign currency
            decimal changeDue = (mParameters.EPPParameters.ChangeDueDetail != null) ? Math.Abs(mParameters.EPPParameters.ChangeDueDetail.Total) : 0m;

            if (changeDue > 0 && mDefs.RvcParm.Format.DisableChangeDue == false)
                // 106044 Belgian Tax Label - Don't Print In Double Wide
                if (mDefs.RvcParm.Format.DontPrintChangePaymentDueinDW)
                    AddLineLeftAndRightJustified(EPrintingIds.ChangeDue, changeDue, false, true);
                else
                    AddNameAndCurrencyTotalDW(EPrintingIds.ChangeDue, changeDue);

                // Change due in foreign currency
                if (mParameters.EPPParameters.ChangeDueDetail != null && mParameters.EPPParameters.ChangeDueDetail.CurrencyID > 0 && mParameters.EPPParameters.ChangeDueDetail.CurrencyAmount != 0m)
                    // If the foreign currency is the same as defined in print parameters, use it otherwise read the currency definition from db
                    DbCurrency foreignCurrency;
                    if (mDefs.ForeignCurrency != null && mParameters.EPPParameters.ChangeDueDetail.CurrencyID == mDefs.ForeignCurrency.CurrencyID)
                        foreignCurrency = mDefs.ForeignCurrency;
                    else
                        foreignCurrency = mDefs.DS.ReadCurrencyByID(mParameters.EPPParameters.ChangeDueDetail.CurrencyID);

                    if (foreignCurrency != null)
                        PrintForeignCurrencyAmount(foreignCurrency, Math.Abs(mParameters.EPPParameters.ChangeDueDetail.CurrencyAmount));

        private void PrintForeignCurrencyAmount(decimal amount)
            PrintForeignCurrencyAmount(mDefs.ForeignCurrency, amount);

        private void PrintForeignCurrencyAmount(DbCurrency currency, decimal amount)
            if (currency != null && amount != 0m)
            {   // "Pesos             120" );

                //106044 Belgian Tax Label - Don't Print In Double Wide
                if (mDefs.RvcParm.Format.DontPrintChangePaymentDueinDW)
                    AddNameAndTotal(currency.Name, amount, true);
                else
                    AddLineLeftAndRightJustifiedDW(currency.Name, GetCurrencyString(amount), true);

        private void PrintForeignChangeDue()
            BaseTotals btCurrent = ((BaseTotals)mCurrent);
            BaseTotals btPrevious = ((BaseTotals)mPrevious);
            // FPPRT-126 | Is there any change due in foreign currency?
            if (btCurrent.ForeignChangeDueTotalList.Count == 0)
                return;

            // Note that there can be multiple foreign currency over payments.
            // So, we need to print a change due line for each currency
            foreach (var currencyId in ((BaseTotals)mCurrent).ForeignChangeDueTotalList.Keys)
                decimal foreignChangeDue = btCurrent.ForeignChangeDueTotalList[currencyId];

                if (mDeltaTotals)
                    if (btPrevious.ForeignChangeDueTotalList.ContainsKey(currencyId))
                        foreignChangeDue -= btPrevious.ForeignChangeDueTotalList[currencyId];

                if (foreignChangeDue > 0m)
                    // If the foreign currency is the same as defined in print parameters, use it otherwise read the currency definition from db
                    if (mDefs.ForeignCurrency != null && currencyId == mDefs.ForeignCurrency.CurrencyID)
                        PrintForeignCurrencyAmount(mDefs.ForeignCurrency, foreignChangeDue);
                    else
                        PrintForeignCurrencyAmount(mDefs.DS.ReadCurrencyByID(new DbKey.CurrencyID(currencyId)), foreignChangeDue);

        protected void FormatCanadaTax()
            decimal amount = 0m;

            if (!mDefs.TaxParameters.CanadianGst.PrintSepLines)
                // TPID : 21127 if closed check void is hit the mDelta totals would be true pertaining format parameters option - 51, so we differentiate the previous round and this round totals
                amount = mDeltaTotals ? mCurrent.TaxTotal - mPrevious.TaxTotal : mCurrent.TaxTotal;
                AddNameAndTotal(mDefs.RvcDesc.Tax, amount);
                return;

            int gstTaxRateIndex = mDefs.TaxParameters.CanadianGst.TaxIndex - 1;
            int pst1TaxIndex = mDefs.TaxParameters.CanadianPst[0].RateIndex;
            int pst2TaxIndex = mDefs.TaxParameters.CanadianPst[1].RateIndex;

            if (gstTaxRateIndex < 0 || pst1TaxIndex < 0 || pst2TaxIndex < 0)
                return;                     //Safety check - should never occur.

            TaxRateDef gstRateDef = mDefs.TaxParameters.Taxes.TaxRate[gstTaxRateIndex];

            // Print separate lines for each tax rate
            for (int i = 0; i < Taxes.NUM_TAX_RATES; i++)
                // TPID : 21127 if closed check void is hit the mDelta totals would be true pertaining format parameters option - 51, so we differentiate the previous round and this round totals
                decimal taxTotal = mDeltaTotals ? mCurrent.Tax[i] - mPrevious.Tax[i] : mCurrent.Tax[i];
                TaxRateDef taxRateDef = mDefs.TaxParameters.Taxes.TaxRate[i];

                if (!TaxCalculator.TaxRateIsDefined(taxRateDef, mDefs.TaxParameters))
                    continue;

                if (taxTotal == 0m)
                    continue;

                if (i == pst1TaxIndex)
                    if (mDefs.TaxParameters.CanadianGst.PrintConsolidatedPst1AndPst2)
                        // TPID : 21127 if closed check void is hit the mDelta totals would be true pertaining format parameters option - 51, so we differentiate the previous round and this round totals
                        amount = mDeltaTotals ? mCurrent.Tax[pst2TaxIndex] - mPrevious.Tax[pst2TaxIndex] : mCurrent.Tax[pst2TaxIndex];
                        taxTotal += amount;
                    //FPS-7711 | Remove unused Options from EMC - Canadian GST
                else if (i == pst2TaxIndex && mDefs.TaxParameters.CanadianGst.PrintConsolidatedPst1AndPst2)
                    continue;

                if (!mDefs.TaxParameters.CanadianGst.PrintTxblAmt)
                    AddNameAndTotal(taxRateDef.Name, taxTotal, false /*inNameColumn*/ );
                else
                    // Skip this rate if gst is not defined
                    if (!TaxCalculator.TaxRateIsDefined(gstRateDef, mDefs.TaxParameters))
                        continue;

                    decimal taxableTotal = 0m;
                    // TPID : 21127 if closed check void is hit the mDelta totals would be true pertaining format parameters option - 51, so we differentiate the previous round and this round totals
                    taxableTotal = mDeltaTotals ? (mCurrent.TaxableSales[i] - mPrevious.TaxableSales[i] + mCurrent.ExtraTaxableSales[i] - mPrevious.ExtraTaxableSales[i]) : (mCurrent.TaxableSales[i] + mCurrent.ExtraTaxableSales[i]);

                    if (i == pst1TaxIndex)
                        if (mDefs.TaxParameters.CanadianGst.PrintConsolidatedPst1AndPst2)
                            taxableTotal = CompoundCanadianTaxes(gstRateDef, taxableTotal, pst2TaxIndex);

                    AddTaxAndTaxableLine(taxableTotal, taxRateDef.Name, taxTotal);

        private void AddTaxAndTaxableLine(decimal taxTotal, ITranslatableString s, decimal taxableTotal)
            AddTaxAndTaxableLineInternal(taxTotal, s, taxableTotal);

            if (mPrintLangList.Count > 0)
                foreach (LanguageData langData in mPrintLangList)
                    SwitchLanguage(langData);
                    AddTaxAndTaxableLineInternal(taxTotal, s, taxableTotal);

                SwitchToMainLanguage();

        private ITranslatableString AddTaxAndTaxableLineInternal(decimal taxTotal, ITranslatableString s, decimal taxableTotal)
            string s1;
            string Total = GetTotal(taxTotal);
            string Taxable = GetTotal(taxableTotal);

            if (mDefs.BelgiumGuestCheck)
                s1 = String.Format("{0,10} {1}", Total, s.GetString(mLangData.LangId));
            else
                if (mPrintAttribute.IsDoubleWide)
                    s1 = String.Format("{0} {1}", Total, s.GetString(mLangData.LangId));
                else
                    s1 = String.Format("{0,10} {1}", Total, s.GetString(mLangData.LangId));
            if (mPrimaryLangData.RightToLeft)
                mPrintStr.Add(Taxable);
                mPrintStr.AddRight(s1, mTotalEndColumn);
            else
                mPrintStr.Add(s1);
                mPrintStr.AddRight(Taxable, mTotalEndColumn);

            mPrintStr.Pad(mPrintWidth);
            AddLine(mPrintStr, mPrintAttribute);
            mPrintStr.Clear();
            return s;

        private decimal CompoundCanadianTaxes(TaxRateDef gstRateDef, decimal taxableTotal, int rateIndex)
            TaxRateDef tmp = mDefs.TaxParameters.Taxes.TaxRate[rateIndex];

            if (TaxCalculator.TaxRateIsDefined(tmp, mDefs.TaxParameters))
                taxableTotal += mCurrent.TaxableSales[rateIndex] + mCurrent.ExtraTaxableSales[rateIndex];
                if (mDeltaTotals)
                    taxableTotal -= (mPrevious.TaxableSales[rateIndex] + mPrevious.ExtraTaxableSales[rateIndex]);

            return taxableTotal;

        // FPS-32641 | vkmadupa | Renamed method name and changed logic to print inclusive tax rates as well
        // Print separate lines for each tax rate
        protected void FormatTaxRates()
            for (int i = 0; i < Taxes.NUM_TAX_RATES; i++)
                decimal taxTotal = mDeltaTotals ? mCurrent.Tax[i] - mPrevious.Tax[i] : mCurrent.Tax[i];
                TaxRateDef taxRateDef = mDefs.TaxParameters.Taxes.TaxRate[i];

                if (taxTotal == 0m || mCheck.TaxRateIsExempt(i + 1))  // TPID: 46825 Don't show if the rate is exempt [11/18/2013 cgough]
                    continue;

                PrintSummaryTotal(taxRateDef.Name, taxTotal);

        // Print separate lines for each tax rate
        protected void FormatVatTaxRates(bool printNetVATOnCheck)
            for (int i = 0; i < TaxRates.NumTaxRates; i++)
                TaxRateDef taxRateDef = mDefs.TaxParameters.Taxes.TaxRate[i];

                if (!taxRateDef.IsInclusiveTax)
                    continue;

                // Print Vat line only if the option bit is on
                if (mDefs.TaxParameters.VatPrintEnabled(i))
                    decimal taxable = mDeltaTotals ? mCurrent.TaxableSales[i] - mPrevious.TaxableSales[i] : mCurrent.TaxableSales[i];
                    if (taxable == 0)
                        continue;               //Don't print this rate if there are no sales at this tax rate

                    decimal taxTotal = mDeltaTotals ? mCurrent.Tax[i] - mPrevious.Tax[i] : mCurrent.Tax[i];
                    decimal grossTaxable = taxable;
                    decimal netTaxable = taxable - taxTotal;

                    PrintVatLine(printNetVATOnCheck, taxRateDef.Name, taxTotal, grossTaxable, netTaxable);

        private void PrintVatLine(bool printNetVATOnCheck, ITranslatableString name, decimal taxTotal, decimal grossTaxable, decimal netTaxable)
            if (mDefs.RvcParm.Tax.PrintZeroInclusiveTaxTotals || taxTotal != 0m)
                AddTaxAndTaxableLine(taxTotal, name, grossTaxable);

                if (printNetVATOnCheck)
                    PrintSummaryTotal(EPrintingIds.NetTotal, netTaxable);

        protected override void PrintWeightLines(DbMenuItemDetail mi, int indentLevel)
            if (!mi.WeighedItem)
                return;

            EPrintingIds unitId = GetWeightUnitPrintingId(mDefs.PropertyParameter);
            string unitsAbbr = GetPrintingText(unitId);

            bool printTareWeight = mi.TareWeight > 0m && !mDefs.PropertyParameter.General.DoNotShowShowTareWeights;

            if (mi.ManEntered)
                AddInNameColumn(EPrintingIds.ManualWeightEntry);

            if (printTareWeight)
                //clierley: TP#8593 Changed from String.Format to SafeStringFormat.
                AddInNameColumn(StringUtils.SafeStringFormat("{0,10} {1}", FormatWeight(mi.ItemWeight, unitId, ref unitsAbbr, mDefs.NumberFormatting), GetPrintingText(EPrintingIds.GrossWeight)));

                //102798 | v-ikottachchi | Do not print negative tare values if '50 - Do Not Show Negative Tare Weights' is checked.
                //clierley: TP#8593 Changed from String.Format to SafeStringFormat.
                AddInNameColumn(StringUtils.SafeStringFormat("{0,10} {1}", FormatWeight((mDefs.PropertyParameter.General.DoNotShowNegativeTareWeights) ? mi.TareWeight : -mi.TareWeight, unitId, ref unitsAbbr, mDefs.NumberFormatting), GetPrintingText(EPrintingIds.TareWeight)));

            string netStr;
            string netWord;
            if (printTareWeight)
                //clierley: TP#8593 Changed from String.Format to SafeStringFormat.
                netStr = StringUtils.SafeStringFormat("{0} {1}", GetPrintingText(EPrintingIds.NetWeight), GetPrintingText(EPrintingIds.WeightAt));
                netWord = GetPrintingText(EPrintingIds.NetWeight);
            else
                netStr = GetPrintingText(EPrintingIds.WeightAt);
                netWord = "";
            //JIRA[FPS-8241], Currency symbol for Weighted items is not displaying on check receipt.
            string weightInfo = StringUtils.SafeStringFormat("{0,10} {1} {2}/{3}", FormatWeight(mi.NetWeight, unitId, ref unitsAbbr, mDefs.NumberFormatting),
                                                                       netStr, mFormatter.BaseCncyWithDesc(mi.WeighedItemsUnitPrice), unitsAbbr);

            //TP:151042, reduce the indent level of net weight
            AddLongName(weightInfo, indentLevel);    //Handles long and short data.

        static internal string[] WeightFormatStrings = { "##0.00",        //Lbs: 999.99
                                                         "##0.000",       //Kg:  999.999
                                                         "##0.0" };       //Oz:  999.9

        /// <summary>
        /// Per e7 team/David Straub: Weights and Measures says we cannot show more decimal places than the scale supports.
        ///    o For ounce scales we can only show and print one decimal place;
        ///    o For pound scales we can only show and print two decimal places;
        ///    o For kilogram scales we need the three decimal places.
        ///    Note: RES has an option that allows 3 decimal places for lbs - we will not be adding this at this time due to the above statements.
        /// </summary>
        static internal string FormatWeight(decimal weight, EPrintingIds unitWeightId, ref string unitsAbbr, NumberFormatInfo numFormatInfo)
            int weightArrayIndex = 0;   //default to lbs.
            if (unitWeightId == EPrintingIds.Ounces)
                weightArrayIndex = 2;
            else if (unitWeightId == EPrintingIds.Kilograms)
                weightArrayIndex = 1;

            return String.Format("{0} {1}", weight.ToString(WeightFormatStrings[weightArrayIndex], numFormatInfo), unitsAbbr);              //Oz: 999.9

        protected override void AddPieceDescriptor(MiSortedDetail mi, DbMenuItemDetail detail)
            //Australian FTA: Print price of each menu item even if count is 1!
            if (mi.Amount == 0 || detail.WeighedItem)
                return;

            //TODO: FUTURE: Add code: Australian FTA   (Set pieceDescriptor to SysParm.PieceDescriptor )
            string PieceDescriptor = string.Empty;
            if (!StringUtils.IsBlank(PieceDescriptor))
                AddPaddedLine(mPrintStr, mPrintAttribute);
                mPrintStr.Clear();
                //TP ID: 25450 - @ price is not correct when decimal quantity is used for MI's - pmalagari added on 9/11/2013.
                decimal unitPrice = mi.Amount;
                if (mi.Count != 0)
                    unitPrice = mi.Amount / mi.Count;
                    try
                        unitPrice = mi.Count == 0 ? mi.Amount : mi.Amount / (Convert.ToDecimal(mi.FormattedCount));
                    catch (Exception)
                //clierley: TP#8593 Changed from String.Format to SafeStringFormat.
                string pieceString = StringUtils.SafeStringFormat("{0} {1}{2}", GetPrintingText(EPrintingIds.AtDescriptor),
                                                                    GetTotal(unitPrice), PieceDescriptor);
                mPrintStr.PadToStartColumn(1 /*indentLevel*/ );
                mPrintStr.Add(pieceString);

        protected override string GetItemPriceText(string name, SortedDetailBase line)
            if (!mDefs.RvcParm.Format.ShowItemPrice)
                return name;

            if (line.Amount == 0m || Math.Abs(line.Count) <= 1)
                return name;

            StringBuilder s1 = new StringBuilder(40);
            s1.Append(name);
            s1.Append(' ');
            s1.Append(GetPrintingText(EPrintingIds.AtDescriptor));
            s1.Append(' ');
            //TP ID: 25450 - @ price is not correct when decimal quantity is used for MI's - pmalagari added on 9/11/2013.
            decimal unitPrice = line.Amount;
            if (line.Count != 0)
                unitPrice = line.Amount / line.Count;
                try
                    unitPrice = line.Count == 0 ? line.Amount : line.Amount / (Convert.ToDecimal(line.FormattedCount));
                catch (Exception)

            s1.Append(GetCurrencyString(unitPrice));
            return s1.ToString();

        /// <summary>
        ///     2.4 MR1: Encapsulated.
        /// </summary>
        public static EPrintingIds GetWeightUnitPrintingId(DbPropertyParameter propertyParam)
            if (propertyParam.General.ItemWeightsInOunces)
                return EPrintingIds.Ounces;
            else if (propertyParam.General.ItemWeightsInKg)
                return EPrintingIds.Kilograms;
            else
                return EPrintingIds.Lbs;

        private void SortCheckDetail(int seat, bool sortBySeat = false)
            CheckDetailSorter sorter = new CheckDetailSorter();
            SortAndConsolidateParameters parameters = new SortAndConsolidateParameters();
            parameters.IsClosedCheckVoid = mCheck.ClosedCheckVoid;

            if (mIsCustReceipt)
                parameters.SetForReceipt(mCheck.RvcParmDef, mParameters.RoundByRound);
            else if (mIsForJournal)
                parameters.SetForJournal(mParameters.StartRoundNumber, mParameters.EndRoundNumber);
            else
                parameters.SetForGuestCheck(mCheck.RvcParmDef, mParameters.RoundByRound);

            parameters.Masking.StartRoundNumber = mParameters.StartRoundNumber;
            parameters.Masking.EndRoundNumber = mParameters.EndRoundNumber;
            parameters.Masking.CheckDetailLinks = mParameters.CheckDetailLinks;

            //98251 | Indicator to hold if it is meant for Journal entries
            parameters.IsForJournal = mParameters.FormatForJournal;

            //TPID:21127 with new SortAndconsolidateParameters object instantiated here the paramaters need to be updated with the voidClosedCheck related settings too
            if (mCheck.ClosedCheckVoid)
                int roundNumber = mCheck.Detail.GetMaxRoundNumber(true /*printableItemsOnly*/ );
                parameters.Masking.SetRoundbyRound(roundNumber, roundNumber);
                parameters.Masking.IncludeCurrentRoundVoids = true;
                parameters.Masking.ExcludeVoidedItems = false;
                parameters.Masking.IncludeVoidItemsOnVoidedClosedCheck = mDefs.RvcParm.Format.VoidClosedCheckPrintFull;

            //106044 Belgian Tax Label - umacherl
            //Consolidating previous rounds if this flag is on.
            parameters.Consolidation.DoNotConsolidateCurentRound = mDefs.RvcParm.Format.DoNotConsolidateCurrentRound ? true : false;

            //106044 Belgian Tax Label - umacherl
            //Enabling printing of guest check with count 1 in case of combo sides.
            parameters.IsForBelgium = mDefs.BelgiumGuestCheck ? true : false;

            //TPID: #156973 --- PORT | Tax Parameters | enabling option 17 (Enable Tax Labels) removes discount and service charge names from guest check
            //To fix the issue above, commented code line below. T.Liang, 01/17/2018.
            //parameters.Masking.IncludeMenuItemsOnly = parameters.IsForBelgium;

            sorter.Seat = seat;
            sorter.SortBySeat = sortBySeat;
            sorter.Sort(parameters, mCheck, null, mDefs.BaseCurrencyDp, out mSortedList, mFormatter.NumFmtInfo);

            // TPID : 21127 we want the check details to be printed in proper order not in reverse order, but closed check void reverses order so fixing it here
            if (mCheck.ClosedCheckVoid)
                mSortedList.Reverse();

        /// <summary>
        ///     Parse formatted print job and break it up based on number of lines per page
        ///
        ///     e7 TODO: Need to fix bug where new page is added if lines on page == maximum lines,
        ///        creates a new page with nothing but a header on it.
        /// </summary>
        private void SplitCheckIntoPages()
            if (mPageOneMaximumLines > 0)
                bool detailLinesOnPage = false;

                for (int i = 0; i < mPrintJob.PrintData.Count; i++)
                    if (CheckForNewPage() && CheckForLinesAhead(i))
                        //Finish this page and add the header for the next page by inserting print attributes/data at the current position in
                        //the list. We will resume processing on the inserted data.
                        MoveOnToNextPage(detailLinesOnPage, i);
                        detailLinesOnPage = false;

                    if (mPrintJob.PrintData[i].GetType() == typeof(PrintJobDataLine))
                        mCheck.LineFind++;              // Text line
                        detailLinesOnPage = true;       // This isn't a blank line
                    else if (mPrintJob.PrintData[i].GetType() == typeof(PrintJobDataLineAttribute))
                        PrintJobDataLineAttribute t1 = mPrintJob.PrintData[i] as PrintJobDataLineAttribute;
                        if (t1.IsDoubleHigh)
                            mCheck.LineFind++;          // Double high text line (needs an extra row)
                    else if (mPrintJob.PrintData[i].GetType() == typeof(PrintJobDataDirective))
                        PrintJobDataDirective t1 = mPrintJob.PrintData[i] as PrintJobDataDirective;
                        if (t1.mDirective == PrintJobDataDirective.EPrintJobDataDirective.D_LINEFEED)
                            mCheck.LineFind += t1.miDirectiveArgument;    //LineFeeds
                        else if (t1.mDirective == PrintJobDataDirective.EPrintJobDataDirective.D_PARTIAL_PAPERCUT ||
                                  t1.mDirective == PrintJobDataDirective.EPrintJobDataDirective.D_FULL_PAPERCUT)
                            //mCheck.PageNumber++; //TPID 46454 [12/30/2013 abush]
                            mCheck.LineFind = 0;
                            detailLinesOnPage = false;

        /// <summary>
        ///     Optionally need to make sure a roll printer check is big enough to easily fit inside a sleeve (especially
        ///     last page if multiple pages).
        /// </summary>
        private void PadPageToMinimumSize()
            // If the page isn't full yet, add the required number of blank lines to meet the minimum
            if (mDefs.PretendPrinterIsASlipPrinter && mCheck.LineFind < mPageOneMaximumLines)
                AddBlankLines(mPageOneMaximumLines - mCheck.LineFind);      //Make all "fake" slip printer pages the same size.
            else if (mCheck.LineFind < mDefs.RvcParm.Format.MinimumLines)
                AddBlankLines(mDefs.RvcParm.Format.MinimumLines - mCheck.LineFind);

        /// <summary>
        ///     If we need to continue printing on the next page:
        ///       o Print a "continuation" line
        ///       o Finish this page
        ///       o Print header for next page
        ///
        ///     This is achieved by inserting priner data/directives into the Print Jobs data list.
        /// </summary>
        private void MoveOnToNextPage(bool detailLinesOnPage, int listIndex)
            //Add data/directives to the end. In a moment we will move them to their correct position.
            int originalCount = mPrintJob.PrintData.Count;
            AddCenteredLine(EPrintingIds.SeeContinuation);
            AddFullCut();

            //Move appended print data/directives to the correct position in the List.
            int insertedLineCount = mPrintJob.PrintData.Count - originalCount;
            MovePrintData(listIndex, originalCount, mPrintJob.PrintData.Count - originalCount);
            listIndex += insertedLineCount;

            mCheck.PageNumber++;          //Move on to the next page.
            mCheck.LineFind = 0;

            //Add print data plus directives to the end. In a moment we will move them to their correct position.
            int originalCount2 = AddHeaderForNextPage();
            int numberOflinesAdded = CheckForAndHandleHeaderBeingTooLargeForThePage(listIndex, originalCount2);

            //Move appended print data/directives to the correct position in the List.
            if (numberOflinesAdded > 0)
                MovePrintData(listIndex, originalCount2, numberOflinesAdded);

        /// <summary>
        /// Determine if we've printed enough lines to require a new page
        ///
        /// If the number of lines (including a possible continuation line) is at the max, then
        /// print the continuation and start a new page
        /// </summary>
        private bool CheckForNewPage()
            int pageNum = mCheck.PageNumber;

            if (pageNum == 1 && mPageOneMaximumLines <= 0)
                return false;

            if (pageNum == 1 && (mCheck.LineFind + 1) >= Math.Max(mPageOneMaximumLines, MIN_LINES_PER_PAGE))
                return true;

            if (pageNum > 1 && mOtherPageMaximumLines <= 0)
                return false;

            if (pageNum > 1 && (mCheck.LineFind + 1) >= Math.Max(mOtherPageMaximumLines, MIN_LINES_PER_PAGE))
                return true;

            return false;

        /// <summary>
        ///
        /// </summary>
        private int AddHeaderForNextPage()
            int originalCount2 = mPrintJob.PrintData.Count;

            //Print the blank lines/check header (check/table number etc) but not the descriptors at the top of the next page.
            AddBlankLines(GetNumberOfBlankLinesAtTopOfPage());
            PrintSection(FormatStandardHeader, CustomReceiptEventArgs.HeaderAction, CustomReceiptEventArgs.CustomHeader);
            PrintSection(FormatStandardSubHeader, CustomReceiptEventArgs.SubHeaderAction, CustomReceiptEventArgs.CustomSubHeader);
            return originalCount2;

        /// <summary>
        ///     If the data printed for the "header" on this check does not leave room for at least a few lines of real data we will throw
        ///     away the excess header lines. This is needed both to enforce some common sense and to prevent an infinite loop in the code where
        ///     adding a header for a new page causes another page and header which in turn adds another ...
        /// </summary>
        private int CheckForAndHandleHeaderBeingTooLargeForThePage(int listIndex, int originalCount2)
            int numberOflinesAdded = mPrintJob.PrintData.Count - originalCount2;
            int numberOfPrintLinesInHeader = 0;

            for (int j = originalCount2 + 1; j < mPrintJob.PrintData.Count; j++)
                object entry = mPrintJob.PrintData[j];
                if (entry.GetType() == typeof(PrintJobDataLine))
                    numberOfPrintLinesInHeader++;           //Text line
                else if (entry.GetType() == typeof(PrintJobDataLineAttribute))
                    PrintJobDataLineAttribute t1 = entry as PrintJobDataLineAttribute;
                    if (t1.IsDoubleHigh)
                        numberOfPrintLinesInHeader++;       //Text line is double height so needs an extra line.
                else if (entry.GetType() == typeof(PrintJobDataDirective))
                    PrintJobDataDirective t1 = entry as PrintJobDataDirective;
                    if (t1.mDirective == PrintJobDataDirective.EPrintJobDataDirective.D_LINEFEED)
                        numberOfPrintLinesInHeader += t1.miDirectiveArgument;    //Line feeds

                //Check we don't have more lines in this "header" than we have room . If so, lets prune away some of the data
                if (numberOfPrintLinesInHeader >= Math.Max(mOtherPageMaximumLines, MIN_LINES_PER_PAGE))
                    for (int k = j; k < mPrintJob.PrintData.Count; k++)
                        mPrintJob.PrintData.RemoveAt(k);

                    numberOflinesAdded = mPrintJob.PrintData.Count - originalCount2;        //recalculate as we just removed lines.
                    break;

            return numberOflinesAdded;

        /// <summary>
        /// Check to see if we have more lines to print
        /// Sometimes a 'Normal' directive is added at the end of a line of data, should not page-break there
        /// </summary>
        private bool CheckForLinesAhead(int start)
            for (int i = start + 1; i < mPrintJob.PrintData.Count; i++)
                if (mPrintJob.PrintData[i].GetType() == typeof(PrintJobDataLine))
                    return true;

            return false;

        /// <summary>
        ///     Called when data was added to the end of the print instead of being inserted at the desired position.
        ///     Move the data to the correct position by inserting it and then removing form the appended position.
        /// </summary>
        protected void MovePrintData(int destIndex, int srcIndex, int count)
            for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
                mPrintJob.PrintData.Insert(destIndex++, mPrintJob.PrintData[srcIndex + i]);
                mPrintJob.PrintData.RemoveAt(srcIndex + i + 1);

        /// <summary>
        ///     If we are printing round by round we may still need to print evn though nothing has been added to the check. For example,
        ///     the customer is ready for the bill we may need to add the summary totals so the amount due is added.
        /// </summary>
        private bool NeedToPrintWithNoDetail()
            //83197 | Duminda | Disable SRM function on waste checks
            if (!mCheck.IsWasteActive && mDefs.PropertyParameter.General.EnableQuebecSRM && QuebecSRM.PrintWithNoDetail(mCheck))
                return true;

            // Print the check if the trailer, check transfer, check add or VAT line(s) print.
            if (mPrintTrailer || mDbTender.PrintInclusiveTaxTotals)
                return true;

            // Print the check if the check has been printed before and it is now closed.  This was put here to deal with checks
            // that have had all of their detail split away.
            if (mCheck.PageNumber > 0 && mCheck.PaidInFull)
                return true;
            };

            // Print the check if this is an on demand operator who asked for it even if there is no detail to print.
            if (mPrintSummaryTotals && mCheck.PageNumber == 0)
                return true;

            // Print check if summary totals are to be printed and they haven't been printed yet.
            if (mPrintSummaryTotals && !mCheck.SumTtlsPrinted)
                return true;
            };

            // Print check if japan tax always prints an amount due.
            if (mCheck.TransState.TaxParm.PrintJapanAmtDue)
                return true;

            if (mDefs.RvcParm.Format.PrintDeltaTtls &&
                  mParameters.RoundByRound &&
                  mDbTender.ReprintOrder &&
                  TaxesOrAutogratuityChangedThisRound() &&
                  !mPrintSeatCheck &&
                  !mPrintMemoCheck)
                return true;

            if (mParameters.RoundByRound && mCheck.TF_PRINT_CHK_XFER_LINE)
                return true;            //need to append Check Transferred information

            // Check does not need printing.
            return false;

        /// <summary>
        ///
        /// </summary>
        private bool TaxesOrAutogratuityChangedThisRound()
            decimal taxTotal = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < Taxes.NUM_TAX_RATES; i++)
                taxTotal += mCurrent.Tax[i];
                taxTotal -= mPrevious.Tax[i];
                taxTotal += mCheck.SplitBaseTotals.Tax[i];
            if (taxTotal != 0m)
                return true;

            if (mCurrent.AutoSvcTotal - mPrevious.AutoSvcTotal + mCheck.SplitBaseTotals.AutoSvcTotal != 0m)
                return true;

            return false;

        //2.5: Added check on whether to print or not.
        private bool PrintCheckOpenTime()
            if (mIsCustReceipt)
                return !mCheck.RvcParmDef.Format.NoCustRcptPrntTime;

            return mCheck.RvcParmDef.Format.GcPrntTime;

        //2.5: Added
        private void PrintTenderDetail()
            foreach (SortedDetailBase line in mSortedList)
                if (line is TenderSortedDetail)
                    SortedDetailBase sortedDetail = line;

                    // FPS-25006 | Skip tender lines in equal payment chit
                    if (mParameters.EqualPaymentChit)
                        continue;

                    // FPS-25006 | Skip change due lines in final check receipt or guest check print during equal payment
                    if (line.DetailItem != null && line.DetailItem.IsChange())
                        continue;

                    if (mParameters.EqualPaymentUsed)
                        sortedDetail = ProcessEqualPaymentTenderDetail(line);

                    FormatCheckDetailLine(sortedDetail);

        private void SetStartingPageNumber()
            bool printingInPages = mParameters.RoundByRound || mPageOneMaximumLines > 0;

            if (mCheck.PageNumber == 0)
                if (printingInPages)
                    mCheck.PageNumber = 1;
            else if (mRollPrinter && printingInPages)
                //For round by round on a roll printer each new print needs an incremented page number
                mCheck.PageNumber++;

        private void FormatInitialBlankLines()
            mPrintJob.NumLeadingLinefeeds = GetNumberOfBlankLinesAtTopOfPage();
            mCheck.LineFind = (int)mPrintJob.NumLeadingLinefeeds;

        /// <summary>
        ///
        /// </summary>
        private int GetNumberOfBlankLinesAtTopOfPage()
            //2.5: Added slip printer support
            if (AppendingToAPreviousSlip)
                return mCheck.LineFind;       //Position slip printer to where we left off.
            else if (mCheck.PageNumber > 1 && mDefs.RvcParm.Format.LineFeedsBeforeOther > 0)
                return mDefs.RvcParm.Format.LineFeedsBeforeOther;

            return (int)mDefs.RvcParm.Format.LineFeedsBeforeFirst;

        /// <summary>
        ///     If we are printing to a slip printer, make sure page sizes are configured appropriately.
        /// </summary>
        private void SetPageSizes()
            if (mSlipPrinter || mRollPrinter)
                mPageOneMaximumLines = mDefs.RvcParm.Format.LinesFirst;
                mOtherPageMaximumLines = mDefs.RvcParm.Format.LinesOther;

                if (mSlipPrinter)
                    AdjustPageSizeForBadProgramming(MIN_SLIP_PRINTER_LINES_PER_PAGE);
                else if (mRollPrinter && mPageOneMaximumLines > 0)
                    AdjustPageSizeForBadProgramming(MIN_LINES_PER_PAGE);

        /// <summary>
        ///
        /// </summary>
        private void AdjustPageSizeForBadProgramming(int minLinesPerPage)
            if (mPageOneMaximumLines < minLinesPerPage)
                mPageOneMaximumLines = minLinesPerPage;
                LogUtils.LogAlways("Adjusting number of lines per page as not configured appropriately", GATEWAY::EGatewayAppParams.LOG_ZONE_INDEX.PRINTING);

            if (mOtherPageMaximumLines < minLinesPerPage)
                mOtherPageMaximumLines = mPageOneMaximumLines;

        /// <summary>
        ///     2.5: New method.
        /// </summary>
        private void AddCoversAtEnd()
            string s;
            if (mCheck.Covers == 1)
                s = GetPrintingText(EPrintingIds.OneGuest);
            else
                s = StringUtils.SafeStringFormat(GetPrintingText(EPrintingIds.Guests), mCheck.Covers);

            AddCenteredLineDW(s);

        /// <summary>
        ///     2.5: Encapsulated
        /// </summary>
        private void AddClosedLines()
            DateTime closedTimeUtc = mCheck.CheckCloseTime;
            if (closedTimeUtc == null || closedTimeUtc == DateTime.MinValue)
                closedTimeUtc = mDefs.TimeUtc;

            //131523 Memo | Print memo check prints reference on Guest check
            //if (mPrintMemoCheck)
            //{
            //    AddBlankLines(1);
            //    AddCenteredLine(StringUtils.SafeStringFormat("{0} {1}", GetPrintingText(EPrintingIds.MemoSplitFrom), mCheck.CheckNumber));
            //}

            AddBlankLines(1);

            PrintCenteredLine(EPrintingIds.CheckClosedLine);
            // 141625 | Memo | Discounts | Closed time of the Memo checks are not getting updated correctly.
            // closedTimeUtc field value correctly updated when it is null or date time min. but it wasn't used to print.
            // used updated closedTimeUtc field to print closed line.
            AddCenteredLineSW(mFormatter.DateAndTimeUtc(closedTimeUtc, true));       //Currently too big for double wide}

        /// <summary>
        ///     2.5: Round By Round support
        /// </summary>
        private void PrintAddedToFromCheckNumber(EPrintingIds printingTextId, int checkNumber)
            if (checkNumber != 0)
                AddInNameColumn(StringUtils.SafeStringFormat(GetPrintingText(printingTextId), checkNumber), 0 /*indentLevel*/ );

        /// <summary>
        ///     For round by round checks we need to print details of these chnages.
        /// </summary>
        private void PrintCheckAddedSplitTransferredLines()
            PrintCheckTransferredInformation();                                                             //Only prints if round by round and check has been transferred
            PrintAddedToFromCheckNumber(EPrintingIds.AddedToCheck, mParameters.AddedToCheckNumber);       //Only prints if non-zero
            PrintAddedToFromCheckNumber(EPrintingIds.AddedFromCheck, mParameters.AddedFromCheckNumber);   //Only prints if non-zero
            PrintSplitToLines();                                                                            // Only prints if splitCheck data set.

        /// <summary>
        ///     2.5: Round By Round support: To print the check transferred line as:
        ///      "     CHECK TRANSFERRED TO:     "
        ///      "1 TOM               BAR REV CTR"
        ///
        /// </summary>
        private void PrintCheckTransferredInformation()
            if (mParameters.RoundByRound && mCheck.TF_PRINT_CHK_XFER_LINE)
                AddCenteredLine(EPrintingIds.CheckTransferredTo);
                AddLineLeftAndRightJustified(mFormatter.EmplNumCheckName(mCheck.CheckEmployee), mDefs.RvcParm.Name.GetString(mDefs.LangId), true);

        /// <summary>
        ///     Add split to lines:
        ///            "   Split To Check 123           $15.27   "
        /// </summary>
        private void PrintSplitToLines()
            if (mParameters.SplitChecksList != null)
                foreach (SplitCheckData data in mParameters.SplitChecksList)
                    AddNameAndTotal(StringUtils.SafeStringFormat(GetPrintingText(EPrintingIds.SplitToCheck), data.CheckNumber), data.Amount);

        /// <summary>
        ///     Simphony 2.7: Multiple language support. Changed to print the amount in all configured languages.
        /// </summary>
        private void PrintSummaryTotalIfNotZero(EPrintingIds printingId, decimal amount)
            if (amount != 0m)
                PrintSummaryTotal(printingId, amount);

        private void PrintSummaryTotal(EPrintingIds printingId, decimal amount)
            AddNameAndTotal(printingId, amount);             //Print in the main langauage

            if (mPrintLangList.Count > 0)
                foreach (LanguageData langData in mPrintLangList)
                    SwitchLanguage(langData);
                    AddNameAndTotal(printingId, amount);

                SwitchToMainLanguage();

        private void PrintSummaryTotal(ITranslatableString name, decimal amount)
            AddNameAndTotal(name, amount);         //Print in the main langauage

            if (mPrintLangList.Count > 0)
                foreach (LanguageData langData in mPrintLangList)
                    SwitchLanguage(langData);
                    AddNameAndTotal(name, amount);

                SwitchToMainLanguage();

        /// <summary>
        ///     Simphony 2.7: Multiple language support. Changed to print the amount in all configured languages.
        /// </summary>
        private void PrintSummaryTotalIfNotZero(Descriptor descriptor, decimal amount)
            if (amount == 0m)
                return;                         //zero totals do not typically print.

            AddNameAndTotalIfNotZero(descriptor, amount);

            if (mPrintLangList.Count > 0)
                foreach (LanguageData langData in mPrintLangList)
                    SwitchLanguage(langData);
                    AddNameAndTotalIfNotZero(descriptor, amount);

                SwitchToMainLanguage();

        /// <summary>
        ///     Simphony 2.7: Multiple language support. Changed to print the amount in all configured languages.
        /// </summary>
        private void PrintSummaryTotalIfNotZero(ITranslatableString name, decimal amount)
            if (amount == 0m)
                return;                         //zero totals do not typically print.

            AddNameAndTotalIfNotZero(name, amount);

            if (mPrintLangList.Count > 0)
                foreach (LanguageData langData in mPrintLangList)
                    SwitchLanguage(langData);
                    AddNameAndTotalIfNotZero(name, amount);

                SwitchToMainLanguage();

        private void PrintCenteredLine(EPrintingIds printingId)
            AddCenteredLineSW(GetPrintingText(printingId));

            if (mPrintLangList.Count > 0)
                foreach (LanguageData langData in mPrintLangList)
                    SwitchLanguage(langData);
                    AddCenteredLineSW(GetPrintingText(printingId));

                SwitchToMainLanguage();

        /// <summary>
        ///    For round by round transactions, need to include the transaction operator and workstation
        ///     (Employee Info followed by worksttaion number))
        ///
        ///       "    123 Joe Waiter 2        "
        /// </summary>
        private void AddEmployeeWorkstationLine()
            //Note: Simphony 1.0 prints this if DbOperator.OnDemand is not set which means it will print when reprinting a check (which seems wrong/unnecessary).
            if (mParameters.RoundByRound && mDefs.RvcParm.Format.EmplUwsLine)
                mPrintStr.Clear();
                mPrintStr.PadToStartColumn(0 /*indentlevel*/ );
                mPrintStr.Add(mFormatter.EmplNumCheckName(mCheck.TransactionEmployee));
                mPrintStr.Add(" ");

                string uwsNumber = mDefs.Workstation.ObjectNumber.ToString();
                if (mPrintStr.RoomForRightJustifiedData(uwsNumber, mPrintWidth))
                    mPrintStr.Add(uwsNumber);
                else
                    AddPaddedLine(mPrintStr, mPrintAttribute);
                    mPrintStr.Clear();
                    mPrintStr.AddRight(uwsNumber, mPrintWidth);

                AddPaddedLine(mPrintStr, mPrintAttribute);
                mPrintStr.Clear();

        /// <summary>
        ///     AddSecondaryLanguage()
        ///         Initially used by Guest Check Printing to optionally allow the items on the check to be printed in more than 1 language.
        /// </summary>
        protected void AddSecondaryLanguage()
            if (mCheck.IsWasteActive)
                return;        //100817 | gwelivita | The waste check should print  in 1 language only (even if multiple languages are configured)

            mPrintLangList.Clear();  //Guard against being called twice.

            // Add a 2nd langauage if it is configured and the user hasn't overridden this option by explicitly setting the customer langauage.
            if (mDefs.RvcParm.Format.PrintSecondaryLanguage && mParameters.PrintInfo.PopupGuestCheckAndCustomerDisplayLangId == 0)
                DbKey.LangID Print2ndLangId = new DbKey.LangID();

                List<DbLanguageProperty> languages = mDefs.DS.ReadLanguageProperty();
                if (languages != null)
                    foreach (DbLanguageProperty propLang in languages)
                        if (propLang.Is2ndPrintLang)
                            Print2ndLangId = propLang.LangID;
                            break;

                if (Print2ndLangId != 0)
                    if (mLangData.LangId != Print2ndLangId)
                        DbLanguageInformation langInfo = mDefs.DS.ReadLanguageInformationByID(new DbKey.LangID(Print2ndLangId));
                        if (langInfo != null)
                            LanguageData langData2 = new LanguageData();
                            langData2.Set(Print2ndLangId, langInfo);

                            mPrintLangList.Add(langData2);

        /// <summary>
        ///     Set printer attributes based on the initial print langauage
        /// </summary>
        protected override void SetActualPrintAttributes()
            SetLanguageAttributes();

        /// <summary>
        ///     Update the printer attributes when the print langauge changes.
        /// </summary>
        protected override void UpdatePrintAttributes()
            SetLanguageAttributes();
            mNameEndColumn = mPrintAttribute.IsDoubleWide ? mPrintWidth : mTotalEndColumn - mMaxPriceWidth;

        /// <summary>
        ///     Set printer attributes based on the current print langauage
        /// </summary>
        private void SetLanguageAttributes()
            if (mLangData.AsianCharacters && !mDefs.RvcParm.Format.AsianCharactersSingleWideOnGuestCheck)
                mPrintAttribute = PrintJobDataLineAttribute.DoubleWide;           //AP: Asian Guest Check should print double-wide but not double wide and high
                mPrintInverseAttribute = PrintJobDataLineAttribute.InverseDW;
            else
                mPrintAttribute = PrintJobDataLineAttribute.Normal;
                mPrintInverseAttribute = PrintJobDataLineAttribute.Inverse;

            mDescriptorAttribute = mDefs.Check.RvcParmDef.Format.PrntHdrRed ? mPrintInverseAttribute : mPrintAttribute;

            //If we change the attributes (i.e. single-wide to double-wide) then we should also chnage the LineBuilders.
            SetWidthsAndColumns();

        /// <summary>
        ///     Log summary information about the print job
        /// </summary>
        private void LogDetails(bool appendingToSlip)
            if (LogUtils.ShouldLog(GATEWAY.ELogLevel.LIGHT_FLOW, GATEWAY::EGatewayAppParams.LOG_ZONE_INDEX.PRINTING))
                if (mSlipPrinter)
                    LogUtils.LogAlways("Printing check to slip printer", GATEWAY::EGatewayAppParams.LOG_ZONE_INDEX.PRINTING);
                else if (mRollPrinter)
                    LogUtils.LogAlways("Printing check to roll printer", GATEWAY::EGatewayAppParams.LOG_ZONE_INDEX.PRINTING);
                else if (mParameters.FormatOnly)
                    LogUtils.LogAlways("Creating a check image for SIM or the journal", GATEWAY::EGatewayAppParams.LOG_ZONE_INDEX.PRINTING);
                else
                    LogUtils.LogAlways("Printing check to non roll or slip printer", GATEWAY::EGatewayAppParams.LOG_ZONE_INDEX.PRINTING);

                if (mParameters.RoundByRound)
                    if (mParameters.StartRoundNumber == mParameters.EndRoundNumber)
                        LogUtils.LogAlways(string.Format("Printing round {0}", mParameters.StartRoundNumber), GATEWAY::EGatewayAppParams.LOG_ZONE_INDEX.PRINTING);
                    else
                        LogUtils.LogAlways(string.Format("Printing round {0} to round {1}", mParameters.StartRoundNumber, mParameters.EndRoundNumber), GATEWAY::EGatewayAppParams.LOG_ZONE_INDEX.PRINTING);

                if (appendingToSlip)
                    LogUtils.LogAlways(string.Format("Appending to a previous slip at line {0}", 1 + mPrintJob.NumLeadingLinefeeds), GATEWAY::EGatewayAppParams.LOG_ZONE_INDEX.PRINTING);

                LogUtils.LogAlways(string.Format("check page {0}; line {1}; page 1 size {2}", mCheck.PageNumber, mCheck.LineFind, mPageOneMaximumLines), GATEWAY::EGatewayAppParams.LOG_ZONE_INDEX.PRINTING);

        #region BelgiumFiscalSupport
        //106044 Belgian Tax Label - umacherl
        /// <summary>
        /// Print the Discount line items
        /// </summary>
        private void PrintDiscountLines()
            Dictionary<string, decimal> tempDict = new Dictionary<string, decimal>();
            foreach (SortedDetailBase line in mSortedList)
                if (line.DetailItem is DbDiscountDetail)
                    DbDiscountDetail detail = line.DetailItem as DbDiscountDetail;
                    foreach (DiscountAllocation da in detail.DiscAllocations)
                        //Get a list of the tax labels.
                        List<string> taxLabels = new List<string>();
                        foreach (int i in da.MenuItemDetail.TaxDataPerRate.Keys)
                            TaxRateDef trDef = mDefs.TaxParameters.Taxes.TaxRate[i];
                            if (!taxLabels.Contains(trDef.TaxLabel))
                                //FPS-17062 |pgkumari| Added a nullOrEmptyString check so that it does not throw null exception
                                // If the taxLabel value is not provided, it is inserted as an empty string in SQL but in Oracle empty string is treated as null.
                                if (!String.IsNullOrEmpty(trDef.TaxLabel))
                                    taxLabels.Add(trDef.TaxLabel);
                        //For every tax label, printing consolidated discount/service charge lines.
                        foreach (string str in taxLabels)

        internal class TaxLabelSummary
            internal List<int> mTaxID;

        //106044 Belgian Tax Label - umacherl
        /// <summary>
        /// Printing the Summary Section
        /// FPS-99611 | PARTCHAT | Reworked the code to make it simpler and support different inclusive tax rates on different items configurations.
        /// This code is not equipped to handle multiple US Inclusive taxes on the same item/auto service charge.
        /// </summary>
        private void PrintTaxSummaryWithLabels()
            mTaxSummary = new SortedDictionary<string, TaxLabelSummary>();

            //Using same variables as printed on check
            decimal tax = 0m;
            decimal totalTaxable = 0m;
            decimal net = 0m;

            bool isUsTax = mDefs.TaxParameters.TaxOpAddOn;

            for (int i = 0; i < DatastoreConstants.NumTaxRates; i++)
                decimal taxable = mDeltaTotals ? mCurrent.TaxableSales[i] - mPrevious.TaxableSales[i] : mCheck.ClosedCheckVoid ? -mPrevious.TaxableSales[i] : mCurrent.TaxableSales[i];

                if (taxable == 0)
                    continue;               //Don't print this rate if there are no sales at this tax rate

                TaxRateDef taxRateDef = (TaxRateDef)mDefs.Check.TransactionStateInterface.ITaxParm.GetTaxRateDef(i);

                if (taxRateDef == null)
                    continue;

                tax = mDeltaTotals ? mCurrent.Tax[i] - mPrevious.Tax[i] : mCheck.ClosedCheckVoid ? -mPrevious.Tax[i] : mCurrent.Tax[i];

                if (taxRateDef.IsInclusiveTax)
                    if (isUsTax)
                        net = taxable;
                        totalTaxable = net + tax;
                    else
                        //VAT
                        totalTaxable = taxable;
                        net = taxable - tax;
                else
                    //Add-on percentage or breakpoint type
                    net = taxable;
                    totalTaxable = net + tax;

                string taxLabel = string.IsNullOrEmpty(taxRateDef.TaxLabel) ? "T" + (i + 1).ToString() : taxRateDef.TaxLabel;
                string key = taxLabel + "_" + taxRateDef.Percentage;

                TaxLabelSummary taxLabelSummary = new TaxLabelSummary();

                if (mTaxSummary.ContainsKey(key))
                    taxLabelSummary = mTaxSummary[key];
                else
                    //Add the tax rate information
                    taxLabelSummary.mPercentage = taxRateDef.Percentage * 100;
                    taxLabelSummary.mTaxID = new List<int>();

                    if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(taxRateDef.TaxLabel))
                        taxLabelSummary.mTaxTag = taxLabel;
                    else
                        taxLabelSummary.mLabel = taxLabel;

                    taxLabelSummary.mTaxID.Add(taxRateDef.TaxID);

                    mTaxSummary.Add(key, taxLabelSummary);

                taxLabelSummary.mNet += net;
                taxLabelSummary.mTaxTotal += tax;
                taxLabelSummary.mGrossTotal += totalTaxable;

            foreach (var taxLabelSummary in mTaxSummary.Values.Where(ts => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(ts.mTaxTag)))
                //Setting the column numbers for the prices and tax Tags using mTaxLabelColumn.
                mTaxLabelColumn = Math.Max(mPrintWidth - PrintFmt.TOTAL_END_COL_INDENTATION, Math.Min(mTaxLabelColumn, mVoidOrReturnFlagColumn - (taxLabelSummary.mTaxTag.Length + 1)));
                mTotalEndColumn = mTaxLabelColumn - 1;

            //Sort the tax summary entries on the basis of tax label values. Not sure why but Michael E suggested it is ok to do so.
            mTaxSummary.OrderBy(kvp => kvp.Value.mLabel);

            // Taxable Totals, Tax Totals, Net Totals : All summaries printed together per tax label
            PrintGrossSummary();
            PrintTaxSummary();
            PrintNetSummary();

        /// <summary>
        /// Add Summary Lines to Check
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="line">The String that has to be printed</param>
        /// <param name="total">Total Value (Gross/Tax/Net)</param>
        /// <param name="percentage">Percentage value to print in line</param>
        /// <param name="taxLabel">Tax Label (A, B, C or D)</param>
        /// <param name="isPaddingNeeded">Flag to indicate need of padding</param>
        private void AddSummaryLine(string line, string total, string percentage, string taxLabel, bool isPaddingNeeded)
            if (mPrimaryLangData.RightToLeft)
                mPrintStr.Add(taxLabel + " " + total + " " + percentage + " " + line);
            else
                if (isPaddingNeeded)
                    mPrintStr.PadToStartColumn(0 /* indentLevel */);

                //TODO: We have no flag data here so we need different column positions!!!!!
                mPrintStr.Add(line);
                string gap = string.Empty;
                mPrintStr.AddRight(percentage + gap.PadLeft((mMaxPriceWidth - total.Length) > 0 ? mMaxPriceWidth - total.Length : 0, ' ') + " " + total, mTotalEndColumn);
                if (!mPrintStr.RoomForRightJustifiedData(taxLabel, mVoidOrReturnFlagColumn))
                    mPrintStr.Pad(mPrintWidth);
                    AddLine(mPrintStr, mPrintAttribute);
                    mPrintStr.Clear();
                    mPrintStr.AddLeft(taxLabel, mVoidOrReturnFlagColumn - (taxLabel.Length + 1), mVoidOrReturnFlagColumn);
                else
                    mPrintStr.AddLeft(taxLabel, mTaxLabelColumn, mVoidOrReturnFlagColumn);

                //Printing Void Flag in case of voided closed check
                if (mCheck.ClosedCheckVoid)
                    mPrintStr.AddLeft(GetPrintingText(EPrintingIds.VoidFlag), mVoidOrReturnFlagColumn, mExemptColumn);

            mPrintStr.Pad(mPrintWidth);
            AddLine(mPrintStr, mPrintAttribute);
            mPrintStr.Clear();

        private class LineFlagInformation
            internal int MaxTaxLabelLength = 0;
            internal bool HaveTaxLabel = false;
            internal bool HaveVoids = false;
            internal bool HaveReturns = false;
            internal bool HaveExempts = false;

        /// <summary>
        /// Iterate through all the menu items and determine FlagColumn and TaxLabelColumn
        /// </summary>
        ///<param name="line"></param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        private void GetFlagStringLength(SortedDetailBase line)
            ItemFlagData flagData = new ItemFlagData();
            //Recursively call again for combo sides/condiments
            if (line != null && line is MiSortedDetail)
                MiSortedDetail menuItem = line as MiSortedDetail;
                if (menuItem.ComboSides != null)
                    foreach (MiSortedDetail miCombo in menuItem.ComboSides)
                        GetFlagStringLength(miCombo);

                if (menuItem.Condiments != null)
                    foreach (MiSortedDetail miCondiments in menuItem.Condiments)
                        GetFlagStringLength(miCondiments);
                flagData = GetItemFlagData(menuItem.DetailItem);
            else
                flagData = GetItemFlagData(line.DetailItem);

            LineFlagInformation lineInfo = new LineFlagInformation();
            lineInfo.HaveTaxLabel |= (flagData.TaxLabel != null && flagData.TaxLabel.Length > 0);
            lineInfo.HaveReturns |= (flagData.ReturnFlag != null && flagData.ReturnFlag.Length > 0);
            lineInfo.HaveVoids |= (flagData.VoidFlag != null && flagData.VoidFlag.Length > 0);
            lineInfo.HaveExempts |= (flagData.ExemptFlag != null && flagData.ExemptFlag.Length > 0);

            //Setting Columns accordingly
            if (lineInfo.HaveExempts)
                mExemptColumn = Math.Min(mExemptColumn, mPrintWidth - (flagData.ExemptFlag.Length + 1));
            if (lineInfo.HaveReturns || lineInfo.HaveVoids)
                mVoidOrReturnFlagColumn = Math.Min(mVoidOrReturnFlagColumn, mExemptColumn - (Math.Max(flagData.ReturnFlag.Length, flagData.VoidFlag.Length) + 1));

            if (lineInfo.HaveTaxLabel)
                //Set the column numbers for the prices and tax labels. If we have long tax labels, we should not force the prices too fat to the left, so the tax labels will print on a newline.
                mTaxLabelColumn = Math.Max(mPrintWidth - PrintFmt.TOTAL_END_COL_INDENTATION, Math.Min(mTaxLabelColumn, mVoidOrReturnFlagColumn - (flagData.TaxLabel.Length + 1)));
                mTotalEndColumn = mTaxLabelColumn - 1;      //Simphony 2: Changed from 1 to 2 as need a space between the price and the tax label!

        //106044 Belgium Tax Label umacherl
        /// <summary>
        ///If we need to print tax labels, then we need to shift the prices to the left so we have room to insert each label.
        /// </summary>
        private void SetColumnPositionsForPricesAndTaxLabels()
            if (mDefs.BelgiumGuestCheck)
                //Setting to maxWidth by default
                mExemptColumn = mPrintWidth;
                mVoidOrReturnFlagColumn = mPrintWidth;
                mTaxLabelColumn = mPrintWidth;
                mTotalEndColumn = mPrintWidth;

                foreach (SortedDetailBase line in mSortedList)
                    GetFlagStringLength(line);

                //For Discount and Service Charges
                foreach (CheckDetailItem item in mDefs.Check.Detail.GetActiveDiscountList())
                    SortedDetailBase lineBase = new SortedDetailBase(NumberFormatInfo.CurrentInfo);
                    lineBase.DetailItem = item;
                    GetFlagStringLength(lineBase);
                foreach (CheckDetailItem item in mDefs.Check.Detail.GetServiceChargeList())
                    SortedDetailBase lineBase = new SortedDetailBase(NumberFormatInfo.CurrentInfo);
                    lineBase.DetailItem = item;
                    GetFlagStringLength(lineBase);
            mNameEndColumn = mPrintAttribute.IsDoubleWide ? mPrintWidth : mTotalEndColumn - mMaxPriceWidth;  //TODO: Does this need to chnage when we chnage languages emglish/chinese/right to left etc? or is this old code?
#if  OBSOLETE
//TPID: 153405: This algorithm does not handle long tax labels where we print the tax labels on a newline instead of moving the menu item prices too far to the left.
            //#124714, align the price to far right for single-wide, before the flag(s) if any.
            if (!mPrintAttribute.IsDoubleWide)
                int maxFlagLen = GetMaxFlagLength();
                if (maxFlagLen > 0)
                    mTotalEndColumn = mPrintWidth - maxFlagLen - 1;     //TPID: 153403
#endif

        /// Print the tax summary for auto service charge.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="tempSummary"></param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        private void AddAutoServiceChargeToTaxSummary(Dictionary<string, TaxLabelSummary> tempSummary)
            List<TaxRateDef> trDefList = GetActiveTaxRateForAutoSvc();
            foreach (TaxRateDef trDef in trDefList)
                string key = trDef.TaxLabel + "_" + trDef.Percentage;
                TaxLabelSummary objTemp = new TaxLabelSummary();
                objTemp.mLabel = trDef.TaxLabel;
                objTemp.mPercentage = trDef.Percentage * 100;
                decimal grossTaxable = 0m;
                decimal netTaxable = 0m;
                decimal taxable = mCheck.ClosedCheckVoid ? -mPrevious.AutoSvcTotal : mCurrent.AutoSvcTotal;
                decimal taxTotal = TaxCalculator.TaxAlg(taxable, trDef, mDefs.TaxParameters, mDefs.BaseCurrencyDp);

                //International Parameters : Apply Tax as Add-On or VAT
                if (mDefs.TaxParameters.TaxOpAddOn)
                    grossTaxable = taxable + taxTotal;
                    netTaxable = taxable;
                    continue;
                else if (mDefs.TaxParameters.TaxOpVat)
                    grossTaxable = taxable;
                    netTaxable = taxable - taxTotal;
                objTemp.mTaxTotal = taxTotal;
                objTemp.mGrossTotal = grossTaxable;
                objTemp.mNet = netTaxable;
                List<int> tempTaxID = new List<int>();
                tempTaxID.Add(trDef.TaxID);
                objTemp.mTaxID = tempTaxID;
                if (tempSummary.ContainsKey(key))
                    TaxLabelSummary objTaxLabelSummary = tempSummary[key];
                    objTaxLabelSummary.mTaxTotal += taxTotal;
                    objTaxLabelSummary.mGrossTotal += grossTaxable;
                    objTaxLabelSummary.mNet += netTaxable;
                    objTaxLabelSummary.mTaxID.Add(trDef.TaxID);
                    tempSummary[key] = objTaxLabelSummary;
                else
                    tempSummary.Add(key, objTemp);

                    DbDiscountDetail detail = line.DetailItem as DbDiscountDetail;

                    taxLabelSummary.mPercentage = taxRateDef.Percentage * 100;
                    taxLabelSummary.mTaxID = new List<int>();

                    if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(taxRateDef.TaxLabel))
                        taxLabelSummary.mTaxTag = taxLabel;
                    else
                        taxLabelSummary.mLabel = taxLabel;

                    taxLabelSummary.mTaxID.Add(taxRateDef.TaxID);

                    mTaxSummary.Add(key, taxLabelSummary);

                taxLabelSummary.mNet += net;
                taxLabelSummary.mTaxTotal += tax;
                taxLabelSummary.mGrossTotal += totalTaxable;

            foreach (var taxLabelSummary in mTaxSummary.Values.Where(ts => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(ts.mTaxTag)))
                //Setting the column numbers for the prices and tax Tags using mTaxLabelColumn.
                mTaxLabelColumn = Math.Max(mPrintWidth - PrintFmt.TOTAL_END_COL_INDENTATION, Math.Min(mTaxLabelColumn, mVoidOrReturnFlagColumn - (taxLabelSummary.mTaxTag.Length + 1)));
                mTotalEndColumn = mTaxLabelColumn - 1;

            //Sort the tax summary entries on the basis of tax label values. Not sure why but Michael E suggested it is ok to do so.
            mTaxSummary.OrderBy(kvp => kvp.Value.mLabel);

            // Taxable Totals, Tax Totals, Net Totals : All summaries printed together per tax label
            PrintGrossSummary();
            PrintTaxSummary();
            PrintNetSummary();

        //106044 Belgian Tax Label - umacherl
        /// <summary>
        /// Print the Gross total for all the VAT lines together
        /// </summary>
        private void PrintGrossSummary()
            foreach (TaxLabelSummary obj in mTaxSummary.Values)
                AddSummaryLine(EPrintingIds.TaxableTotal, obj.mGrossTotal, obj);

        //106044 Belgian Tax Label - umacherl
        /// <summary>
        /// Print the Tax total for all the VAT lines together
        /// </summary>
        private void PrintTaxSummary()

            foreach (TaxLabelSummary obj in mTaxSummary.Values)
                AddSummaryLine(EJournalIds.Tax, obj.mTaxTotal, obj);

        //106044 Belgian Tax Label - umacherl
        /// <summary>
        /// Print the Net total for all the VAT lines together
        /// </summary>
        private void PrintNetSummary()
            foreach (TaxLabelSummary obj in mTaxSummary.Values)
                AddSummaryLine(EPrintingIds.Net, obj.mNet, obj);

        private void AddSummaryLine(System.Enum id, decimal amount, TaxLabelSummary obj)
            AddSummaryLine(GetPrintingText(id), GetTotal(amount), GetTotal(obj.mPercentage) + "%", (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(obj.mLabel)) ? obj.mLabel : obj.mTaxTag, true);

        //106044 Belgian Tax : umacherl
        /// <summary>
        /// Add Summary Lines to Check
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="line">The String that has to be printed</param>
        /// <param name="total">Total Value (Gross/Tax/Net)</param>
        /// <param name="percentage">Percentage value to print in line</param>
        /// <param name="taxLabel">Tax Label (A, B, C or D)</param>
        /// <param name="isPaddingNeeded">Flag to indicate need of padding</param>
        private void AddSummaryLine(string line, string total, string percentage, string taxLabel, bool isPaddingNeeded)
            if (mPrimaryLangData.RightToLeft)
                mPrintStr.Add(taxLabel + " " + total + " " + percentage + " " + line);
            else
                if (isPaddingNeeded)
                    mPrintStr.PadToStartColumn(0 /* indentLevel */);

                //TODO: We have no flag data here so we need different column positions!!!!!
                mPrintStr.Add(line);
                string gap = string.Empty;
                mPrintStr.AddRight(percentage + gap.PadLeft((mMaxPriceWidth - total.Length) > 0 ? mMaxPriceWidth - total.Length : 0, ' ') + " " + total, mTotalEndColumn);
                if (!mPrintStr.RoomForRightJustifiedData(taxLabel, mVoidOrReturnFlagColumn))
                    mPrintStr.Pad(mPrintWidth);
                    AddLine(mPrintStr, mPrintAttribute);
                    mPrintStr.Clear();
                    mPrintStr.AddLeft(taxLabel, mVoidOrReturnFlagColumn - (taxLabel.Length + 1), mVoidOrReturnFlagColumn);
                else
                    mPrintStr.AddLeft(taxLabel, mTaxLabelColumn, mVoidOrReturnFlagColumn);

                //Printing Void Flag in case of voided closed check
                if (mCheck.ClosedCheckVoid)
                    mPrintStr.AddLeft(GetPrintingText(EPrintingIds.VoidFlag), mVoidOrReturnFlagColumn, mExemptColumn);

            mPrintStr.Pad(mPrintWidth);
            AddLine(mPrintStr, mPrintAttribute);
            mPrintStr.Clear();

        private Dictionary<string, decimal> ServiceChargeTaxInformation = new Dictionary<string, decimal>();

        //106044 Belgian Tax Label - umacherl
        /// <summary>
        /// Printing a new section for discounts and service charge with tax labels
        /// </summary>
        private void FormatStandardDiscountServiceChargeWithTaxLabelTotals()
            if (mCheck.AutoServiceChargeActive)
                PrintAutoServiceChargeLines();

            PrintDiscountLines();
            PrintServiceChargeLines();
            AddBlankLines(1);

        /// <summary>
        ///
        /// </summary>
        private class LineFlagInformation
            internal int MaxTaxLabelLength = 0;
            internal bool HaveTaxLabel = false;
            internal bool HaveVoids = false;
            internal bool HaveReturns = false;
            internal bool HaveExempts = false;

        /// <summary>
        /// Iterate through all the menu items and determine FlagColumn and TaxLabelColumn
        /// </summary>
        ///<param name="line"></param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        private void GetFlagStringLength(SortedDetailBase line)
            ItemFlagData flagData = new ItemFlagData();
            //Recursively call again for combo sides/condiments
            if (line != null && line is MiSortedDetail)
                MiSortedDetail menuItem = line as MiSortedDetail;
                if (menuItem.ComboSides != null)
                    foreach (MiSortedDetail miCombo in menuItem.ComboSides)
                        GetFlagStringLength(miCombo);

                if (menuItem.Condiments != null)
                    foreach (MiSortedDetail miCondiments in menuItem.Condiments)
                        GetFlagStringLength(miCondiments);
                flagData = GetItemFlagData(menuItem.DetailItem);
            else
                flagData = GetItemFlagData(line.DetailItem);

            LineFlagInformation lineInfo = new LineFlagInformation();
            lineInfo.HaveTaxLabel |= (flagData.TaxLabel != null && flagData.TaxLabel.Length > 0);
            lineInfo.HaveReturns |= (flagData.ReturnFlag != null && flagData.ReturnFlag.Length > 0);
            lineInfo.HaveVoids |= (flagData.VoidFlag != null && flagData.VoidFlag.Length > 0);
            lineInfo.HaveExempts |= (flagData.ExemptFlag != null && flagData.ExemptFlag.Length > 0);

            //Setting Columns accordingly
            if (lineInfo.HaveExempts)
                mExemptColumn = Math.Min(mExemptColumn, mPrintWidth - (flagData.ExemptFlag.Length + 1));
            if (lineInfo.HaveReturns || lineInfo.HaveVoids)
                mVoidOrReturnFlagColumn = Math.Min(mVoidOrReturnFlagColumn, mExemptColumn - (Math.Max(flagData.ReturnFlag.Length, flagData.VoidFlag.Length) + 1));

            if (lineInfo.HaveTaxLabel)
                //Set the column numbers for the prices and tax labels. If we have long tax labels, we should not force the prices too fat to the left, so the tax labels will print on a newline.
                mTaxLabelColumn = Math.Max(mPrintWidth - PrintFmt.TOTAL_END_COL_INDENTATION, Math.Min(mTaxLabelColumn, mVoidOrReturnFlagColumn - (flagData.TaxLabel.Length + 1)));
                mTotalEndColumn = mTaxLabelColumn - 1;      //Simphony 2: Changed from 1 to 2 as need a space between the price and the tax label!

        //106044 Belgium Tax Label umacherl
        /// <summary>
        ///If we need to print tax labels, then we need to shift the prices to the left so we have room to insert each label.
        /// </summary>
        private void SetColumnPositionsForPricesAndTaxLabels()
            if (mDefs.BelgiumGuestCheck)
                //Setting to maxWidth by default
                mExemptColumn = mPrintWidth;
                mVoidOrReturnFlagColumn = mPrintWidth;
                mTaxLabelColumn = mPrintWidth;
                mTotalEndColumn = mPrintWidth;

                foreach (SortedDetailBase line in mSortedList)
                    GetFlagStringLength(line);

                //For Discount and Service Charges
                foreach (CheckDetailItem item in mDefs.Check.Detail.GetActiveDiscountList())
                    SortedDetailBase lineBase = new SortedDetailBase(NumberFormatInfo.CurrentInfo);
                    lineBase.DetailItem = item;
                    GetFlagStringLength(lineBase);
                foreach (CheckDetailItem item in mDefs.Check.Detail.GetServiceChargeList())
                    SortedDetailBase lineBase = new SortedDetailBase(NumberFormatInfo.CurrentInfo);
                    lineBase.DetailItem = item;
                    GetFlagStringLength(lineBase);
            mNameEndColumn = mPrintAttribute.IsDoubleWide ? mPrintWidth : mTotalEndColumn - mMaxPriceWidth;  //TODO: Does this need to chnage when we chnage languages emglish/chinese/right to left etc? or is this old code?

using System;

using System.Collections.Generic;
using Micros.PosCore.Common;
