namespace Micros.PosCore.Checks

    //TODO: Add check info and team info support.
    //TODO: FUTURE: Simphony 1.0 is ignoring Mi options 41 and 42 regarding consolidation of menu items
    //      with condiments for order devices. One of these bits is also copied to str_dtl.status
    //      as mi_dtl.type_def wasn't big enough in a 9700 version!
    //TODO: FUTURE: RES has options to sort all condiments or just the allowed condiments.

    public class CheckDetailSorter
        //TPID 107773 | v-ikottachchi | collection required for adding decorators
        private List<int> mDecorationsAdded = null;

        public CheckDetailSorter()
            //TPID 107773 | v-ikottachchi | collection required for adding decorators
            mDecorationsAdded = new List<int>();

        // TP#79791/79790/79789:
        internal bool CheckPickUp = false;
        internal bool NeedToNotifyChkDtlAreaAfterOrderTypeInfoChange = false;

        //2.3: Added to sort the internal contents of a Combo Meal
        public CheckDetailSorter(DbMenuItemDetail mi): this()
            mSingleMenuItemToSort = mi;

        List<SortedDetailBase> List = new List<SortedDetailBase>();

        public CheckDetailFormatOverride CheckDetailFormatOverride = null;
        //public SortedCheckParameters CheckParam = null;

        private SortAndConsolidateParameters mParameters;
        private CheckDetail mCheckDetail;
        private DataStoreClient mDS;
        private GuestCheck guestCheck;
        private IComparer<SortedDetailBase> mParentSorter;
        private CondimentSorting mCondimentSorter;
        private int mBaseCurrencyDp;
        public NumberFormatInfo mNumFmtInfo;
        private DbMenuItemDetail mSingleMenuItemToSort = null;

        private bool mSortAllowedCondimentsOnly;  // 130527 | gwelivita | Flag to determine when sort only allowed condiments
        private int mPreviousRoundParentCount = 0;
        private int mLastRoundParentCount = 0;

        internal bool SortBySeat;
        public int Seat { get; set; }

        private uint TestTicks(ref uint startTicks)
            uint endTicks = (uint)Environment.TickCount;
            uint result = endTicks - startTicks;
            startTicks = endTicks;
            return result;

        //89691 | v-ikottachchi | 12-14-2015 | Decorator group lists
        private Dictionary<int, DbDiningCourse> mDiningCourses;
        private Dictionary<int, DbMajorGroup> mMajorGroups;
        private Dictionary<int, DbFamilyGroup> mFamilyGroups;

        //The caller is expected to pass in fully configured sorting and consolidation requirements.
        public void Sort(SortAndConsolidateParameters parameters, GuestCheck check, DataStoreClient datastore,
                          int baseCurrencyDp, out List<SortedDetailBase> list, NumberFormatInfo numFmtInfo)
            //Detailed timings
            uint ticks = (uint)Environment.TickCount;
            uint initTime = 0;
            uint addTime = 0;
            uint assocTime = 0;

            mParameters = parameters;
            mCheckDetail = check.Detail;
            mDS = datastore;
            guestCheck = check;
            mBaseCurrencyDp = baseCurrencyDp;
            mParentSorter = null;
            mCondimentSorter = null;
            mNumFmtInfo = numFmtInfo;

            switch (mParameters.Sorting.SortType)
                //#8146 - Pass the KDSCourseSorting parameter onto the Sorting delegates.
                case SortingType.NoSort:
                        if (mParameters.KDSCourseSorting)
                            mParentSorter = new SortingByDiningCourse();
                            //89691 | v-ikottachchi | 12-14-2015 | Retrieve the list of dining courses
                            mDiningCourses = mDS.GetDiningCourseList (parameters.CurrentLangId);
                        break;
                case SortingType.Seat: mParentSorter = new SortingBySeat(mParameters.KDSCourseSorting); break;
                case SortingType.PrintGroup: mParentSorter = new SortingByPrintGroup(mParameters.KDSCourseSorting); break;
                case SortingType.SeatAndPrintGroup: mParentSorter = new SortingBySeatAndPrintGroup(mParameters.KDSCourseSorting); break;
                case SortingType.PrintGroupAndSeat: mParentSorter = new SortingByPrintGroupTypeAndSeat(mParameters.KDSCourseSorting); break;
                case SortingType.MajorGroup: mMajorGroups = mDS.GetMajorGroupList (parameters.CurrentLangId); break; //89691 | v-ikottachchi | 12-14-2015 | Retrieve the list of major groups
                case SortingType.FamilyGroup: mFamilyGroups = mDS.GetFamilyGroupList (parameters.CurrentLangId); break; //89691 | v-ikottachchi | 12-14-2015 | Retrieve the list of family groups

             if (mParameters.Sorting.SortType == SortingType.PrintGroup ||
                 mParameters.Sorting.SortType == SortingType.PrintGroupAndSeat ||
                 mParameters.Sorting.SortType == SortingType.SeatAndPrintGroup ||
                 mParameters.Sorting.CondimentSortType == CondimentSortType.AllCondimentSort ||
                 mParameters.Sorting.CondimentSortType == CondimentSortType.AllowedCondimentSort) // 130527 | gwelivita | Sort all the condiments
                mCondimentSorter = new CondimentSorting();

            // 130527 | gwelivita | Sort only the allowed condiments
            if (mParameters.Sorting.CondimentSortType == CondimentSortType.AllowedCondimentSort)
                mSortAllowedCondimentsOnly = true;

            if (mParameters.ViewBySeat && !guestCheck.FilteringActive)
                AddSeatDecoration(guestCheck.Seat);
                AddSeatDecoration(guestCheck.GetNextAvailableSeat());

            if (mParameters.SeatFilteringActive)
                AddSeatFilteringIndicatorText();

            //For the display, only sort previous round items.
            if (mSingleMenuItemToSort != null)
                AddMenuItem(null, mSingleMenuItemToSort, 1, null);  //2.3: Combo Meal optimization
            else if (mParameters.Masking.StartRoundNumber > 0)

                //FPS-5868 PORT - Check details are missing on the printout of void closed check, check reference is wrong.
                //FPS-5869 PORT - 137325 | Printing|Voids on Guest Checks and Receipts are not printing
                //Below if condition is for Guest check printing where voided items are not included in case of voided closed check operation and also
                //during rounds, voided items are not included on guest check printing.

                //FPS-1452 164971 | Replacing a Combo Placeholder is voiding and resending the entire combo, not just the Placeholder and its replacement item
                //Changed the Order of items to be added on sorted list for proper consolidation.
                //Consolidation is expecting voided items first and current round items next for prepare the consolidated items out of this list.

                //FPS-7070 : EMC | Format Parameters | Option 16 - Print Void Line on Checks is not printing void(s) correctly and causing overprinting on slip printer
                //Option bit 16 CSH content was wrong and removed a condition to add voided items if option bit 16 enabled.
                //Now, every time voided items will be added to list except the option bit 51 disabled(FPS-1000) for ClosedCheckVoids.
                if (!check.ClosedCheckVoid || mParameters.Masking.IncludeVoidItemsOnVoidedClosedCheck)
                    AddVoidedItems(parameters);

                //TP 142381 | shfaiz | Obtain only the active menu items to be fired the remaining items during the service total
                AddParentDetail(mCheckDetail.GetActiveParentListByRound(mParameters.Masking.StartRoundNumber, mParameters.Masking.EndRoundNumber));

            else if (mParameters.Masking.IncludeCurrentRoundOnly)
                //TP 142381 | shfaiz | Obtain only the active menu items to be fired the remaining items during the service total
                //92207 | GetCurrentRoundParentListForPrint() method returns only the menu items which are not
                //already being Held or Timed Fire. But in this case we need to have all the menu items to decide
                //if the each item needs to go to the Order Device.
                //
                // TPID 131969 Validation printing was not including menu items and service charges because
                // the hold and fire code had already set the items to ItemHasFired so the fix is that if we are sorting for the
                // display ignore the WantsToBeFired setting on the detail item. The code makes sense here anyway because
                // if you are sorting for the display and only want to see current round items you don't care if they have
                // fired to the Remote Order Devices. You want to see them on the display. [12/2/2016 ckgough]

                //TODO: Surely the check should be whether for order device or not!
                //IEnumerable<CheckDetailItem> detailToSelect = mParameters.Device.IsOrderDevice() ?
                //    mCheckDetail.GetActiveCurrentRoundParentList() : mCheckDetail.GetActiveCurrentRoundParentListForOrderDevicePrinting();

                //FPS-5868,5869. Moved include void items related lines to common method for re-using for including void items on guest check and cust receipts.

                //FPS-1452 164971 | Replacing a Combo Placeholder is voiding and resending the entire combo, not just the Placeholder and its replacement item
                //Changed the Order of items to be added on sorted list for proper consolidation.
                //Consolidation is expecting voided items first and current round items next for prepare the consolidated items out of this list.
                AddVoidedItems(parameters);

                IEnumerable<CheckDetailItem> outputDetailItems = mCheckDetail.GetActiveCurrentRoundParentList();
                //cgough https://hgbu.oracle.com/jira/browse/FPS-16855 sending partial items off a combo meal does not fire to the order device but is flagged as being sent.
                if ( mParameters.Device.IsOrderDevice() )
                    var outputItemPlusOrphans = mCheckDetail.GetActiveCurrentRoundParentListForOrderDevicePrinting().ToList();
                    // TP 146418 | We have Combo Sides that may need to be fired but their parents have already gone to the kitchen, which means they won't show up in the
                    // detailToSelect list. So we are going find all of the detail sides and check to see if we find any orphans.

                    // Get Parent Detail Links
                    var parentDetailLinks = outputItemPlusOrphans.Select( d => d.DetailLink ).ToList();
                    // Get Side items that want to fire where we don't find your parent detail link. This is an orphan. If the parent fired then it already got the children.
                    var orphanedSides = mCheckDetail.GetActiveCurrentRoundComboSidesListForOrderDevicePrinting().Where( sideItem => !parentDetailLinks.Contains( sideItem.ParentDetailLink ) );
                    // Add Orphans
                    outputItemPlusOrphans.AddRange( orphanedSides );
                    // Assign the Enumerable and off you go
                    outputDetailItems = outputItemPlusOrphans;

                AddParentDetail(outputDetailItems);

            else if (mParameters.Sorting.SortPreviousRoundsOnly)
                //Need to get previous rounds and last rounds separately so they can be sorted and consolidated
                //separately. This is for the display possibly for repeat last round functionality).
                AddParentDetail(mCheckDetail.GetPreviousRoundButNotLastRoundParentList());
                mPreviousRoundParentCount = List.Count;

                AddParentDetail(mCheckDetail.GetLastRoundParentList());
                mLastRoundParentCount = List.Count - mPreviousRoundParentCount;
            else if (mParameters.Sorting.SortRefillableItemsOnly)
                AddParentDetail(mCheckDetail.GetRefillableItemList(guestCheck.RoundNumber).Cast<CheckDetailItem>());
            else
                IEnumerable<ICheckDetailItem> detailsList = null;
                //140409 | Memo | Adding a menu item from OPS for selected seat of s MEMO check will display all the menu items attached to other seats as voided in KDS
                //140360 | Memo | Voiding a menu item from a MEMO check will display in KDS as all the other menu items attached to other seats as voided
                //When creating Suborder to send to KDS need to ignore seat filter. Otherwise details items assign to other seats will be display as void items.
                if (parameters.IsForKds)
                    detailsList = mCheckDetail.GetParentListIgnoringSeatFilter().Cast<ICheckDetailItem>();
                else
                    detailsList = mCheckDetail.GetActiveParentList();

                AddParentDetail(detailsList.OfType<CheckDetailItem>());

            if (List.Count > 0)
                CheckDetailConsolidator consolidator = new CheckDetailConsolidator(mParameters, List, mDS, mBaseCurrencyDp, numFmtInfo);

                //Do before sorting so we have less items to sort (possibly) and before the order of the items changes.
                if (parameters.Masking.IncludeCurrentRoundOnly)
                    consolidator.RemoveItemsMovedToCurrentRoundButNotChanged();

                SortParents();

                //Sort previous round condiments
                if (!mParameters.Sorting.SortCurrentRoundCondiments && !mParameters.IsForOrderDevice)
                    if (mCondimentSorter != null)
                        SortCondiments(mCondimentSorter);

                AssociateDiscounts();

                //TODO: FUTURE: OPTIMIZATION: If need to sort and consolidate by round, we should pass
                //in lists by round rather than have the consolidator try and consolidate different rounds and
                //have to check for a round match. This would reduce the number of loop iterations.
                consolidator.Consolidate();

                if (mParameters.ViewFireTimes)
                    AddDecorationOrderedTimes();

            //For the display, append the current round items without sorting or consolidation
            if (mParameters.Sorting.SortPreviousRoundsOnly && mParameters.Masking.StartRoundNumber == 0 && mSingleMenuItemToSort == null)
                initTime = TestTicks(ref ticks);
                AddParentDetail(mCheckDetail.GetCurrentRoundParentList().OfType<CheckDetailItem>());
                addTime = TestTicks(ref ticks);
                AssociateDiscounts();
                assocTime = TestTicks(ref ticks);

            //Live sorting of discount coupons
            MoveDiscountCouponsToTop();
            uint moveDiscsTime = TestTicks(ref ticks);

            //Live sorting of condiments on the display.
            if (mParameters.Sorting.SortCurrentRoundCondiments ||
                 mParameters.Sorting.CondimentSortType == CondimentSortType.AllCondimentSort ||
                 mParameters.Sorting.CondimentSortType == CondimentSortType.AllowedCondimentSort)
                    SortCondiments(mCondimentSorter);

            //Live rollup of combo meal side prices into parents
            RollupComboMealPrices();

            list = List;

            //Log detailed timings.
            uint doneTime = TestTicks(ref ticks);
            string s = "Init: " + initTime.ToString() + " Add: " + addTime.ToString() + " Assoc: " + assocTime.ToString() + " MoveDisc: " + moveDiscsTime.ToString() + " Done: " + doneTime.ToString();
            LogUtils.LogDetailFlow(s, LES.EGateway.EGatewayAppParams.LOG_ZONE_INDEX.POSCORE);

        private void AddVoidedItems(SortAndConsolidateParameters parameters)
            //TP146686|Yaswanth|Order Device Output | Void is not sent to Order Devices when Menu Item from previous round is modified.
            //Removed the code from KDS specific section as this should be applicable for Ordered devices as well.
            //Simphony 3.0: Colin: Moved the void check here.
            if (parameters.Masking.IncludeCurrentRoundVoids && !parameters.Masking.ExcludeVoidedItems)

                if (parameters.Masking.IncludeVoidItemsOnVoidedClosedCheck)
                    IEnumerable<CheckDetailItem> voidedItems = mCheckDetail.GetCurrentRoundTotalVoidedList();
                    if (voidedItems.Count() > 0)
                        AddParentDetail(voidedItems);
                else
                    //TP146686|Yaswanth|Order Device Output | Void is not sent to Order Devices when Menu Item from previous round is modified.
                    //Reading the voided items from the current round to be sent to KDS
                    //FPS-93790 | PARTCHAT | Apart from voided menu items, voided discounts, service charges and tender media also need to be added to the check journal.
                    //Voided discounts, service charges and tender media are not needed for order device printer output.
                    IEnumerable<CheckDetailItem> voidedItems = mParameters.IsForJournal ? mCheckDetail.GetCurrentRoundTotalVoidedList() : mCheckDetail.GetCurrentRoundVoidedList();

                    if (voidedItems.Count() > 0)
                        AddParentDetail(voidedItems);

                // FPS-1171.  Add current round voided service charges if we are producing a validation slip
                if (parameters.Masking.IncludeVoidValidation)
                    var voidedService = mCheckDetail.GetCurrentRoundVoidedServiceChargeList().ToList().ConvertAll( d => (CheckDetailItem)d);
                    if (voidedService.Any())
                        AddParentDetail(voidedService);

        //TODO: FUTURE: ComboMeals: Add parent only unless parent not included in sort.
        //TODO: FUTURE: Fixed Price Meals: Add parents only unless parent not included in sort.
        private void AddParentDetail(IEnumerable<CheckDetailItem> detailList)
            //Scan through the check detail looking for items to add.
            foreach (CheckDetailItem item in detailList)
                //TP 16190 - Hide unflagged items.
                if (!item.CanDisplay)
                    // FPS-15775 | Equal Payment | Include change due details to calculate actual payment amount on Guest Checks and Receipts
                    if (!(mParameters.Device.IsGuestCheckOrCustomerReceipt() && item.IsChange()))
                        continue;

                if (mParameters.Masking.ExcludeVoidedItems && item.LineNumVoid)
                    continue;

                if (mParameters.Masking.ExcludeReturns && item.Return)
                    continue;

                //Simphony 3.0: This check is performed earlier now.
                //if (mParameters.Masking.ExcludeVoidsOfPreviousRoundItems && (item.LineNumVoid || item.Void))
                //        continue;

                //Fixed price meal handling different in Simphony (part of Combo Meals)
                //if (Parameters.Masking.ExcludeUnpricedFixedPriceMealCourses && item.IsZeroPricedFpmCourse)
                //    continue;

                if (mParameters.Masking.ExcludeMenuItemsWithCondiments && item.HasCondiments)
                    continue;

                if (mParameters.Masking.ExcludeMenuItemsWithoutCondiments && !item.HasCondiments)
                    continue;

                if (mParameters.Masking.ExcludeTenders && item is DbTenderMediaDetail)
                    continue;

                if (mParameters.Masking.IncludeValidationOnly)
                    bool include = item.ValidationRequired;

                    if (mParameters.Masking.IncludeEmployeeMeal)
                        if (item.IsEmployeeMealDiscount() || item.IsEmployeeMealTip())
                            include = true;

                    if (mParameters.Masking.IncludeTaxExempt && item.RequiresTaxExemptValidation())
                        include = true;

                    //Bug 11415 : Print validation chits for returned items.
                    if (mParameters.Masking.IncludeReturnValidation && item.Return)
                        include = true;

                    //TP 45544 - Do not include "system void" items
                    //Simphony 18.1: TPID: 160807: Directly voided items should also be included.
                    if (mParameters.Masking.IncludeVoidValidation && item.Void && !item.IsDsc && !item.SystemVoid)
                        include = true;

                    if (!include)
                        continue;

                if (mParameters.Masking.IncludeEndorsementOnly)
                    if (!item.EndorsementRequired)
                        continue;

                if (mParameters.Masking.ExcludeDiscountCoupons && item.DiscountCoupon)
                    continue;

                if (mParameters.Masking.CheckDetailLinks != null && !mParameters.Masking.CheckDetailLinks.Contains(item.DetailLink))
                    continue;

                DbMenuItemDetail miDtl = item as DbMenuItemDetail;
                if (miDtl != null)
                    // Touch Fire support: Need to verify that the fired/firing state matches.

                    if ( mParameters.Masking.IncludeRefireItemsOnly )
                        if (miDtl.HoldAndFireStatus != HOLD_N_FIRE_STATUS.ReFire)
                            continue;
                    else if (mParameters.Masking.CheckHoldAndFireItems)
                        if (mParameters.Masking.ExcludeFiredItems && miDtl.HasFired  )
                            continue;

                        if ( mParameters.Masking.ExcludeHeldItems && miDtl.OnHold )
                            continue;

                    if (mParameters.Masking.ExcludeDomIncompleteItems && miDtl.DontSendToDomOnNext)
                        continue;           //Kds Support

                    if (mParameters.Masking.ExcludeAnonymousItems && miDtl.IsAnonymousItem)
                        continue;           //Kds Support

                    if (mParameters.Masking.ExcludeComboMeals && miDtl.IsComboMealParent)
                        continue;
                else
                    if (mParameters.Masking.IncludeMenuItemsOnly || mParameters.Masking.IncludeRefireItemsOnly )
                        continue;

                //TP# 30128 :  7/9/2013
                //If round by round printing,  Skip printing deposits that are moved to the Current round.
                //When we pick up a check with deposits and close that check ( pay in full) we move the previous round deposits
                //to the current round and add the payment information to the deposit dtl object. When we move an
                //item to the current round we add a voided copy and a non voided copy of the item to the current
                //round. So the below code will skip the printing of the deposits , unless
                //the deposit information has been edited after picking up the check.
                //TP# 46735 | Added checking for flags "IncludeCurrentRoundOnly" and "IncludeCurrentRoundVoids"
                //to ensure that we are only doing this for round by round printing.
                if (item is DbDepositDetail && !item.PrevRnd && mParameters.Masking.IncludeCurrentRoundOnly && mParameters.Masking.IncludeCurrentRoundVoids)
                    if (SkipCurrentRoundDeposits(item as DbDepositDetail))
                        continue;

                //Round By Round printing needs to include current round voids of previous round items.
                if (mParameters.Masking.IncludeCurrentRoundVoids)
                    if (item.LineNumVoid)
                        if (item.PrevRnd)
                            continue;

                        if (!item.Void)
                            continue;          //This is the original non-voided item

                        var parent = guestCheck.Detail.GetItemFromDetailLink(item.VoidLink);
                        // FPS-1183 - Also checkj for TreatAsPreviousRound flag, so Void Validation gets printed for voided items split from
                        // previous round items or partial voids of multiple quantity entries from previous rounds.
                        if (parent != null && !(parent.PrevRnd || parent.TreatAsPreviousRound))
                            continue;

                //TODO: Add code when DbCreditAuthDetail defined.
                //if ( Parameters.Masking.ExcludeCreditAuth && item is DbCreditAuthDetail )
                //    continue;

                if (mParameters.Masking.IncludeAuthorizedVoidsOnly && (item.EmployeeID == 0 || !item.Void))
                    continue;
                // For KDS, ignore the fact that the check is seat filtered
                if (!mParameters.IsForKds && !guestCheck.SeatActive(item.Seat) && !item.AutoDiscount)
                    continue;
                //TP#149166 - vkabeeru | KDS | Don't send Automatic discounts to order devices
                if (mParameters.Masking.ExcludeAutomaticDiscounts && item.AutoDiscount)
                    continue;

                List<DbComponent> componentList = null;

                // 103234 | gwelivita | If there is component which should send for current order device, add to this parent item
                if (ParentPrintsOnThisDevice(item, ref componentList) && !SkipComboParent(miDtl))
                    AddParent(item, componentList);
                else if (item is DbDiscountDetail)
                    DbDiscountDetail discDetail = item as DbDiscountDetail;
                    if (discDetail.PrintsOnThisDevice(mParameters.Device))
                        AddDiscount(discDetail);
                else if (miDtl != null)
                    AddCondimentsThatPrintByThemselves(miDtl);
                    AddComboMealSides(null /*parentMi*/, miDtl);     //Add Combo Meal sides that print by themselves.

        bool ExcludeMenuItemForPreProductionRule(DbMenuItemDetail miDetail)
            if (miDetail == null || !mParameters.Device.IsOrderDevice() || mParameters.OrderDevicePType == OrderDevicePrintType.Normal)
                return false; // this item is not being considered

            if (mParameters.OrderDevicePType == OrderDevicePrintType.NewPreProduction || mParameters.OrderDevicePType == OrderDevicePrintType.UnClaimedPreProduction)
                // Exclude this item if it has been sent before
                return miDetail.SentToPreProductionChit;

            if (mParameters.OrderDevicePType == OrderDevicePrintType.ClaimedPreProduction)
                // A Claim means that you have passed through the God forsaken pre production process

                if (miDetail.SentToPreProductionChit)
                    return false; // Don't exclude this item because we want it to show under the "Claimed" Header

                return true;  // Exclude this item because it has not been through the pre production process and so it it not claimed

            return false; // in all other cases are not being considered

        private bool ParentPrintsOnThisDevice( CheckDetailItem item, ref List<DbComponent> componentList )
            bool parentPrints = false;
            componentList = null;
            DbMenuItemDetail miDtl = item as DbMenuItemDetail;
            if (ExcludeMenuItemForPreProductionRule(item as DbMenuItemDetail))
                // Pre Production Rules say no ... don't print here
                return false;

            //Simphony 19.1.1; FPS-15653: PreProduction support: Find which print class to use to dictate where to print
            if (mParameters.OrderDevicePType == OrderDevicePrintType.NewPreProduction && miDtl != null)

                var miClass = miDtl.GetDbMenuItemClass(mDS, mParameters.RvcId);

                if (miClass == null || miClass.PreProdChitPrintClassObjNum == 0)
                    return false;

                DbPrintClass preProductionPrintClass = mDS.ReadPrintClassByNum(mParameters.RvcId, miClass.PreProdChitPrintClassObjNum);
                if (preProductionPrintClass == null)
                    return false;

                parentPrints = item.IsConfiguredToPrint(mParameters.Device, preProductionPrintClass.PrintOptionBits);
            else
                if (!PrintingOverriddenByItsCondiments(item, out parentPrints))
                    parentPrints = item.PrintsOnThisDevice(mParameters.Device);

            //TODO: How much of this code needs to be skipped fopr pre-production printing????/

            if (!parentPrints && item is DbTenderMediaDetail && mParameters.Device == EDevice.PL_GST_CHK)
                var tmedDtl = item as DbTenderMediaDetail;
                if (tmedDtl.IsServiceTotal())
                    parentPrints = tmedDtl.TaxExempt;
            //Simphony 2.6: Multiple Order Type support. Apply filtering by order type if we have menu items with different order
            //types on the check. This only applies to order device printing.
            if (item is DbMenuItemDetail && mParameters.OrderTypeList != null)
                if (((DbMenuItemDetail)item).OrderType != null)
                    if (!mParameters.OrderTypeList.Contains(((DbMenuItemDetail)item).OrderType))
                        parentPrints = false;
                else if (!mParameters.OrderTypeList.Contains(mParameters.OrderType))
                    parentPrints = false;

            // 103234 | gwelivita | If there is any component defined to the current parent item and if it is set to send for the current order device, add the parent item.
            // Following code doesn't duplicate parent item as this effects when order device processing.
            // get the component(s) of the parent menu item
            // Need to search and add the components when the sort() calls from the KDS class.
            if (mDS != null && (item is DbMenuItemDetail) && mParameters.IncludeComponent)
                List<DbMenuItemComponent> compList = mDS.ReadMenuItemComponentByMiDef(guestCheck.RevenueCenterID.Value, (item as DbMenuItemDetail).MenuItemDefID);
                componentList = new List<DbComponent>();

                // if we have components to add
                if (compList.Count > 0)
                    // go by each component and read print class and check the order devices assigned to print class
                    foreach (DbMenuItemComponent component in compList)
                        DbComponent compo = mDS.ReadComponentByObjectNumber(guestCheck.RevenueCenterID.Value, (int)component.ObjectNumber);

                        if (compo.PrintClassObjNum == 0) // if no print class is assigned, no need to send the component to order device.
                            continue;

                        // get the print class using the conponent's print class object number
                        DbPrintClass printClass = mDS.ReadPrintClassByNum(guestCheck.RevenueCenterID.Value, compo.PrintClassObjNum);
                        for (int i = 0; i < OrderDevices.NumOrderDevices; i++)
                            // if the currest order deivce is equal to the the order device set for the component we have to add the parent item
                            if ((printClass.OrderDeviceOutput.ToCharArray()[i]) == '1' && ((EDevice)((int)EDevice.PL_RMT_ORDR_1 + i) == mParameters.Device))
                                parentPrints = true;
                                item.IsComponentAvailable = true;
                                componentList.Add(compo); // Add the componet to the component list of tme menu item

            return parentPrints;

        private List<int> mSkippedComboParents = new List<int>();

        /// <summary>
        ///     RES/Desired functionality (SCR 4597) for the kitchen is that the Combo Parent does not print (even if configured to) after
        ///     a combo side substitution of a previous round item:
        ///
        ///     Note: This does do what the user wants in the normal case but functionality doesn't seem quite right if the user subsequently:
        ///           o voids the combo meal
        ///           o uncombos and then does autocombo
        ///           o changes combo meal size
        ///           o etc.
        /// </summary>
        private bool SkipComboParent(DbMenuItemDetail mi)
            if (mParameters.Masking.IncludeCurrentRoundOnly && mi != null && mi.IsComboMealParent)
                if (mi.IsVoidOfMovedPreviousRoundItem)
                    mSkippedComboParents.Add(mi.CopiedToLink);
                    return true;
                else if (mSkippedComboParents.Contains(mi.DetailLink))
                    return true;

            return false;

        //TP# 30128 :  7/9/2013
        //For round by round printing, we should not print the deposit
        //detail that has been moved to the current round, unless
        //we have made some modifications to the deposit information.
        private bool SkipCurrentRoundDeposits(DbDepositDetail depItem)
            DbDepositDetail activeDepDtl = null;

            //Get the list of deposits that are active in the current round.
            foreach (DbDepositDetail depDtl in guestCheck.Detail.GetActiveDepositList())
                if (depItem.Data.mDepositId == depDtl.Data.mDepositId)
                    activeDepDtl = depDtl;

            //Compare the deposit information in the current and previous rounds. If we find that the deposit information has changed
            //in the current round we print a voided copy of the previous round deposit and a non voided copy of the modified
            //deposit. if there is no change we do not print any deposit information. ( Round by round printing ).
            if (activeDepDtl != null)
                foreach (DbDepositDetail prevDepDtl in guestCheck.Detail.GetPreviousRoundDepositList())
                    if (depItem.Data.mDepositId == prevDepDtl.Data.mDepositId)
                        return activeDepDtl.CompareDeposit(prevDepDtl);

            return false;

        //We are only looking at parent items here
        private bool PrintingOverriddenByItsCondiments(CheckDetailItem item, out bool parentPrints)
            parentPrints = false;
            if (mParameters.Sorting.CondimentsCanOverrideParentOutput && item is DbMenuItemDetail)
                string printOptionBits = null;
                DbMenuItemDetail miDetail = item as DbMenuItemDetail;
                List<DbMenuItemDetail> list = miDetail.GetCondimentsList();         //Condiments and condiments of condiments
                foreach (DbMenuItemDetail condiment in list)
                    if (condiment.OverideParentOrderDevices)
                        parentPrints = condiment.PrintsOnThisDevice( mParameters.Device );
                        printOptionBits = condiment.PrintOptionBits;
                        //break;        //TODO: Shouldn't we add a break/return here?

                if (printOptionBits != null)
                    return true;

            return false;

        private void AddCondimentsThatPrintByThemselves(DbMenuItemDetail miDetail)
            List<DbMenuItemDetail> list = miDetail.GetCondimentsList();         //Condiments and condiments of condiments
            foreach (DbMenuItemDetail condiment in list)
                // #16534: [10/19/2012 COuk] Previously we check based only on option 22-PrintCndmntSep
                // But we also have to check whether the Condiment can be print on the order device
                // Before we added it to the sortdetail object for PrintJob.
                // Reference:
                // Class: $\Common\PosCore\Printing\OrderDevices.cs
                // Method: static internal void Print(...)
                // It loops through order devices from #1 to #32
                // And try to create a print job like this:
                // PrintJob job;
                // printDevice.CreatePrintJob(out job);
                // if (job != null)
                //    PrintManager.SubmitUnsupervisedJob(job, isBackup);
                // print job object is not null once sortdetail object is filled
                // that is why we have to check to make sure that the condiment can be filled
                // in sortdetail object only if it can be PrintsOnThisDevice and if Option
                // 22 - ON = Use Own Output; OFF = Use Parent's (Condiments Only) true.
                if (condiment.PrintCndmntSep && condiment.PrintsOnThisDevice(mParameters.Device))
                    AddParent(condiment as CheckDetailItem, null);

        private void AddParent( CheckDetailItem item, List<DbComponent> componentList )
            //94227 | Add the decorators only if the view mode is either ViewBySeat|VireByCourse|ViewFireTimes
            if (mParameters.AddDecorators)
                if (mParameters.ViewBySeat)
                    AddSeatDecoration( item.Seat );
                else if (mParameters.ViewByCourse && item is DbMenuItemDetail)
                    AddCourseDecoration( (item as DbMenuItemDetail).KdsCourseNum );
                //105391|cgehan|09-18-2015|Add new fire by major group and family group decorators accordingly
                else if (mParameters.ViewByMajorGroup && item is DbMenuItemDetail)
                    AddMajorGroupDecoration((item as DbMenuItemDetail).MajGrpObjNum);
                else if (mParameters.ViewByFamilyGroup && item is DbMenuItemDetail)
                    AddFamilyGroupDecoration((item as DbMenuItemDetail).FamGrpObjNum);
            //TP 4221 - Added DbReferenceDetail
            if (item is DbMenuItemDetail miDtl)
                //103234 | gwelivita | If we have component(s) found for the parent item and if the current order device is not configured to send the parent item
                // then, we send only component(s) to the current order device.
                bool add_component_only = (item.IsComponentAvailable && mParameters.IncludeComponent) && !item.PrintsOnThisDevice(mParameters.Device);

                // 146654 | gwelivita | Set the value to the flag which overrides the KDS sort priority above normal flag on parent menu item.
                // When the current menu item has any condiment or combo side which KDSSortPriorityAboveNormal option enabled, then override the parent menu item with the same option.
                miDtl.OverrideKDSSortPriorityAboveNormalOnParent = miDtl.GetFlattenedListOfComboSidesAndCondiments().Any(mi => mi.KDSSortPriorityAboveNormal);

                if (add_component_only)
                    AddComponents(null, (DbMenuItemDetail)item, 1, componentList);
                else
                    AddMenuItem(null, (DbMenuItemDetail)item, 1, componentList);
            else if (item is DbDiscountDetail)
                AddDiscount((DbDiscountDetail)item);
            else if (item is DbServiceChargeDetail)
                AddServiceCharge((DbServiceChargeDetail)item);
            else if (item is DbTenderMediaDetail)
                AddTenderMedia((DbTenderMediaDetail)item);
            else if (item is DbExtensibilityDataDetail)
                AddExtensibilityData(item as DbExtensibilityDataDetail);
            else if (item is DbDepositDetail)
                AddDeposit(item as DbDepositDetail);
            else if (item is DbReferenceDetail)
                AddReference(item as DbReferenceDetail);

        /// <summary>
        ///     Add the menu item to the sorted list if it is configured to print on this device.
        ///     parentMi will only be set if we are checking the Combo meal sides when the Combo Meal parent has been added.
        ///
        /// </summary>
        private void AddMenuItem( MiSortedDetail parentMi, DbMenuItemDetail item, int indentLevel, List<DbComponent> componentList )
            //If seat filter is there then we need items belonging to that particular seat only.
            if (SortBySeat && item.Seat != Seat)
                return;

            // TP#9215,gyou,3/19/2012, pass the parameters for kds combo meal sides count
            MiSortedDetail mi = new MiSortedDetail(item, mBaseCurrencyDp, CheckDetailFormatOverride, indentLevel, mNumFmtInfo, mParameters);

            // TPID 68526: If this is a void of a previous round item, and it is going to be sent to an order device through the use of "IsForOrderDevice", then the following loop for TPID 31684
            // must be bypassed. This is due to the fact that kitchen order devices need to have the original void count instead of the consolidated count (that the
            // printed guest check requires).

            // TPID 31684: the logic of partially voiding of menu item is that the menu item from previous round is flagged voided and two new items are added to current round
            // first would have the voided flag and another non-void item, the current round item would have the number of items of previous voided menu item which needs to be
            // changed to show the right number of items voided say -3 from the previous round 8 items, this change in count is done to sorteddetail only so that posting is not effected (see TP bug)
            // the case we are relying for the menu item to ve a void menu item on is that it is IsVoidOfMovedPreviousRoundItem AND the voided item was added right before the new item

            // TPID 21454 | jharesh | According to KDS controller formatted count of the parent should be equal to its void copy's formatted count in-Order to void the correct parent item.
            // Parent item's formatted count has been changed by this method, this is causing problems when calculating production count.
            if (item.IsVoidOfMovedPreviousRoundItem && !mParameters.Masking.IncludeCurrentRoundOnly)
                foreach (DbMenuItemDetail dbmid in guestCheck.Detail.GetCurrentRoundParentMenuItemList())
                    //22276 | jharesh | Changed the conditon to compare CopiedToLink of original item with the new item's DetailLink
                    //since item.DetailLink == (dbmid.DetailLink - 1) will fail in cases like voiding second item when having three items in check.
                    if (item.CopiedToLink == dbmid.DetailLink)
                        Fraction countPrevious = new Fraction(0, 1);

                        // this is how we calculate the count of items
                        if (dbmid.SalesCountTrueCount || dbmid.Denominator == 0)
                            countPrevious = new Fraction(dbmid.SalesCount, 1);
                        else
                            countPrevious = new Fraction(dbmid.Numerator, dbmid.Denominator);

                        Fraction count = new Fraction(0, 1);
                        // If using count in SalesCount or denominator invalid then use sales count
                        if (item.SalesCountTrueCount || item.Denominator == 0)
                            count = new Fraction(item.SalesCount, 1);
                        else
                            count = new Fraction(item.Numerator, item.Denominator);

                        mi.FormattedCount = (count + countPrevious).ToString();
                        // TPID 43965: get the right amount as well
                        mi.FormattedAmount = indentLevel > MiSortedDetail.PARENT_INDENT_LEVEL && item.Total == 0 ? "" : CurrencyToString(dbmid.Total + item.Total);

                        break;

            //TODO: PERFORMANCE: This should be cached in DbMenuItemDetail just like ExpandedName
            //94188 | v-djayaratne | Changed Method to accept Revenue center Id
            if (item.IsComboMealParent || !item.IsPartOfComboMeal)
                DataStoreClient.GetReasonName(item.VoidReasonID, ref mi.ReasonName, mDS, guestCheck.RevenueCenterID);

            //Simphony 2.8: Extensibility should only be added if it is configured to show/print on the device.
            AddExtensibilityToSortedDetail( item, mi );
            AddCondiments(mi, item);
            AddFees( mi, item );              //TP# 83621 | Add Menu Item Fees
            AddItemDiscounts(mi, item);

            // 103234 | gwelivita | If component available for current menu item we have to add them as component(s) and
            // parent manu item both are configured to send to current order device.
            if (item.IsComponentAvailable)
                AddComponents(mi, item, 1, componentList);

            mi.OverridePrintGroup();

            // FPS-1183: Try to get the right void value on the void validation chit for partial voids
            if (mParameters.Masking.IncludeVoidValidation && item.ActualVoidQty != 0)
                mi.Amount = item.ActualVoidTotal;
                mi.FormattedAmount = CurrencyToString(item.ActualVoidTotal);
                mi.Count = item.ActualVoidQty;
                mi.FormattedCount = item.ActualVoidQty.ToString();

            if (parentMi == null)
                AddComboMealSides(mi, item);           //Go add any Combo Meal sides
                mi.ExtensibilityData = item.ExtensibilityData; // TP #72238 - support for item level extensibility in the sorted details list
                List.Add(mi);
            else
                bool includeItem = true;
                if (mParameters.Masking.ExcludeUnpricedComboMealSides)
                    DbMenuItemDetail comboParentMiDtl = parentMi.MenuItem as DbMenuItemDetail;
                    if (comboParentMiDtl != null)
                        if (comboParentMiDtl.ComboMealPricedSidesOnlyOnGuestCheck &&
                            (comboParentMiDtl.ComboMealPriceRollup || item.Total == 0m))
                            includeItem = false;

                if (includeItem)
                    parentMi.ComboSides.Add(mi);

        //Support Combo Sides printing with/without their parent.
        private void AddComboMealSides(MiSortedDetail parentMi, DbMenuItemDetail item)
            int indentLevel = parentMi == null ? 1 : 2;

            foreach (DbMenuItemDetail side in item.ComboSides)
                if (mParameters.Masking.ExcludePlaceholders && side.Placeholder && side.HidePlaceholder)
                    continue;

                //106910 | eheennapita | Check hold & fire related conditions before adding the combo meal side item.
                //Below conditions are added based on the code in AddParentDetail method (Line: 291)
                if ( mParameters.Masking.IncludeRefireItemsOnly )
                    if (side.HoldAndFireStatus != HOLD_N_FIRE_STATUS.ReFire)
                        continue;
                else if (mParameters.Masking.CheckHoldAndFireItems)
                    if (mParameters.Masking.ExcludeFiredItems && side.HasFired)
                        continue;

                    if (mParameters.Masking.ExcludeHeldItems && side.OnHold)
                        continue;

                if (mParameters.ViewByCourse && mParameters.AddComboSideCourseDecorations )
                    AddCourseDecoration( side.KdsCourseNum );

                //103234 | gwelivita | Add new component list
                List<DbComponent> componentList = null;

                if ( mParameters.IsForOrderDevice )
                    //Simphony 19.1: FPS-8989: New option to always include this side on the Order Device if the combo parent was included. Designed for
                    //Strip Steak (combo parent) + 2 sides where one of the sides is a cold side such as a salad and the salad will typically not go to the hot KDS/printer.
                    if ( parentMi != null && side.ComboSideAlsoPrintsOnComboParentsOrderDevices )
                        AddMenuItem(parentMi, side, indentLevel, componentList);
                        return;

                if (ParentPrintsOnThisDevice(side, ref componentList))
                    AddMenuItem(parentMi, side, indentLevel, componentList);          //Recursive call!
                else
                    AddCondimentsThatPrintByThemselves(side);

        private void AddDiscount(DbDiscountDetail item)
            DscSortedDetail dsc = new DscSortedDetail(item, mBaseCurrencyDp, CheckDetailFormatOverride, mNumFmtInfo);

            //If there is a seat filter we need to find the discount associated with that particular seat.
            if (SortBySeat)
                //Simphony 2.8: Seat Checks with discounts broken ((discounts not showing/discounts showing with $0)
                //              Add/rework changes for #21035, #74907, #75487
                Decimal seatDiscountAmount = 0;
                DbDiscountDetail discDtl = dsc.DetailItem as DbDiscountDetail;

                //Find the discount for this seat by adding all the discount allocations for menu items on the seat.
                foreach (DiscountAllocation alloc in discDtl.DiscAllocations)
                    if ( alloc.MenuItemDetail.Seat == Seat)
                        seatDiscountAmount += alloc.Total;

                // If discount Amount is zero it means there is no discount associated with this seat and the discount should not be included!
                // Simphony 2.8: THIS IS THE REAL FIX for #21035/74907/75487
                if ( seatDiscountAmount == 0 )
                    return;

                dsc.Seat = Seat;
                dsc.Amount = seatDiscountAmount * -1;       //The amounts in the DiscountAllocation records have the reverse sign to the actual discount amount!
                dsc.FormattedAmount = CurrencyToString(dsc.Amount);

            if (Math.Abs(dsc.Count) != 1)
                dsc.NoConsolidation = true;

            AddExtensibilityToSortedDetail(item, dsc); //FPS-76693 || Adding item level extensibility in the sorted details list

            if (!item.Amt)
                dsc.NoConsolidation = true;

            // TP 9190: commented out the following line.
            // SBUX has 0 amount Free Refill Discounts and used to be displayed in the check detail area.
            // When void a close check, the Void.cs was reporting Void Not Allowed error because the entry is not in SortedDetail.
            //if ( dsc.Amount != 0 )
            List.Add(dsc);

            //94188 | v-djayaratne | Changed Method to accept Revenue center Id
            DataStoreClient.GetReasonName(item.VoidReasonID, ref svc.ReasonName, mDS, guestCheck.RevenueCenterID);

            if (Math.Abs(svc.Count) != 1)
                svc.NoConsolidation = true;

item.starteditem_13command_executionpowershell.exe -Command '$ErrorActionPreference='"'Stop'; "'$p='"'OPS/Ops/CommandHandlers/TenderMedia.cs'; (Get-Content "'$p | Select-Object -Index (5050..5135)) -join "`n" | Write-Output'in_progress
item.completeditem_13command_executionpowershell.exe -Command '$ErrorActionPreference='"'Stop'; "'$p='"'OPS/Ops/CommandHandlers/TenderMedia.cs'; (Get-Content "'$p | Select-Object -Index (5050..5135)) -join "`n" | Write-Output'            // would calculate the summary totals of the items which are not in the seat filter.
            if (CS.GuestCheck.FilteringActive)
                if (def.TendMedType == TenderTypes.TmedPaymentType)
                    List<int> currentFilteredSeats = CS.GuestCheck.Detail.SeatFilter.ToList();

                    // CaclucalateTotals() methods requires that the items to be in seat filter
                    // Hence putting the items that are not in filter to the filter to calculate the
                    // totals for the primary check.
                    CS.GuestCheck.Detail.SeatFilter.Clear();

                    foreach (CheckDetailItem item in CS.GuestCheck.Detail.Items)
                        if (!currentFilteredSeats.Contains(item.Seat))
                            CS.GuestCheck.PutSeatInFilter(item.Seat);

                    result = PostTotals.PostSaleWriteCheck(info, OP.DataStore, CS.TransState, CS.GuestCheck, OP.Journal.GetNoOpenReceptacleEntry);
                    //TP 142860 | shfaiz | Moved the total calculation method after performing total posting. This prevent incorrect begun and paid amount being post
                    // Total calculation for primary check
                    CS.CalculateTotals();

                    // Returning back to original filtered state
                    CS.GuestCheck.ResetSeatFilter();

                    foreach (int seat in currentFilteredSeats)
                        CS.GuestCheck.PutSeatInFilter(seat);

                    // Total calculation for memo check
                    CS.CalculateTotals();
            else
                result = PostTotals.PostSaleWriteCheck(info, OP.DataStore, CS.TransState, CS.GuestCheck, OP.Journal.GetNoOpenReceptacleEntry);

            OP.SetReadyPrompt();

            logger.End(result);

            if (result.IsFailed)
                OP.ShowError(new CommandResult(result));
            else if (result.IsSuccess)
                OP.Journal.LogTransactionJournal(CS.GuestCheck, CS.TransState.EmployeeSession.TransactionEmployee, CS, def, heldItemsFiredThisRound);

            if (CS.GuestCheck.PaidInFull == true)
                args.SetEvent();
                OP.RaiseExtensibilityAndSimEvents(args);

        /// <summary>
        /// Saves the paid memo check as a new check
        /// </summary>
        private void SplitAndSaveAsMemoCheck()
            AppOfflineInfo info = new AppOfflineInfo(OP);

            GuestCheck memoCheck = new GuestCheck(OP.TransactionState);
            memoCheck.Detail = new CheckDetail();

            memoCheck.TransState = CS.GuestCheck.TransState;
            memoCheck.AutoServiceChargeActive = CS.GuestCheck.AutoServiceChargeActive;
            memoCheck.AutoSvcTurnedOff = CS.GuestCheck.AutoSvcTurnedOff;
            memoCheck.SetAutogratuityFromTransState();
            memoCheck.Covers = CS.GuestCheck.Covers;

            // Adding event details
            memoCheck.EventAreaObjNum = CS.GuestCheck.EventAreaObjNum;
            memoCheck.EventDataLoaded = CS.GuestCheck.EventDataLoaded;
            memoCheck.EventDefDtlID = CS.GuestCheck.EventDefDtlID;
            memoCheck.EventDefObjNum = CS.GuestCheck.EventDefObjNum;
            memoCheck.EventMainMenuLevel = CS.GuestCheck.EventMainMenuLevel;
            memoCheck.EventSubMenuLevel = CS.GuestCheck.EventSubMenuLevel;
            memoCheck.EventSubTypeId = CS.GuestCheck.EventSubTypeId;

    public class JournalFormatter
        //Simphony 2.8: Cash Management: Changed to allow OPS to create and use a real object.
        private TransactionState mTransState;
        private List<string> mHeaderLines = new List<string>();
        private List<string> mDataLines = new List<string>();

        const int LINE_WIDTH = 40;     //Historical value when journal was sent to a printer but also allows reporting to show in a chit style.
        internal DbPrinter JournalPrinter = null;      //Used by engineering/QA to get a visible copy of the journal

        internal event EventHandler Intercept;

        private int mLangId => mTransState.Languages.DefaultLangID;

        internal JournalFormatter( TransactionState transState )
            mTransState = transState;

        private void ClearLists()
            mHeaderLines.Clear();
            mDataLines.Clear();

        /// <summary>
        ///     Get next transaction number.
        /// </summary>
        internal static int GetNextTransNum(TransactionState transState)
            if (transState == null)
                return 9999;        //We should never get here!

            CGwGetNextTransNumRequest req = new CGwGetNextTransNumRequest();
            req.mWorkstationID = transState.WorkstationId;

            CGwGetNextTransNumResponse resp = new CGwGetNextTransNumResponse();
            PosCoreResult pcr = transState.PostingInterface.SendLocally(EMsgTypes.MSG_GET_NEXT_TRANS_NUMBER, req, resp, ref resp.mReturnCode);
            if ( pcr.IsFailed || resp == null )
                //For some reason the call failed (probably a major database issue). This is extremely unikely but need to continue so use a local in-memory
                //copy of the transaction number.
                transState.UwsDef.NextTransNumber++;
                return transState.UwsDef.NextTransNumber;

            transState.UwsDef.NextTransNumber = resp.TransactionNumber;       //Save a local copy of the the number in case of database issues.
            return resp.TransactionNumber;

        #region CGwJournalLogEntry data object init methods

        /// <summary>
        ///     Simphony 2.8: Encapsulated
        /// </summary>
        private static void SetEntryFromTransState( CGwJournalLogEntry cgwJnlLogEntry, TransactionState transState, JournalType type )
            cgwJnlLogEntry.mUwsDbId = transState.WorkstationId;
            cgwJnlLogEntry.mRvcDbId = transState.RvcId;

            //Not set if no-one is signed in.
            if( transState.EmployeeSession.EmployeeSignedIn )
                cgwJnlLogEntry.mEmplDbId = transState.EmployeeId;

            cgwJnlLogEntry.mTransTime = DateTime.UtcNow;
            cgwJnlLogEntry.mCheckOpenTime = cgwJnlLogEntry.mTransTime;   //default time if no check.

            cgwJnlLogEntry.mType = (byte)type;

            cgwJnlLogEntry.mStatus = new byte[ 1 ];
            cgwJnlLogEntry.mStatus[ 0 ] = 0;

            cgwJnlLogEntry.mRequestGuid = Guid.NewGuid();

        /// <summary>
        ///     Simphony 2.8: Encapsulated
        /// </summary>
        private static void SetCMEntryFromTransState(CGwCMJournalLogEntry cgwJnlLogEntry, TransactionState transState, JournalType type)
            cgwJnlLogEntry.mUwsDbId = transState.WorkstationId;
            cgwJnlLogEntry.mRvcDbId = transState.RvcId;

            //Not set if no-one is signed in.
            if (transState.EmployeeSession.EmployeeSignedIn)
                cgwJnlLogEntry.mEmplDbId = transState.EmployeeId;

            cgwJnlLogEntry.mTransTime = DateTime.UtcNow;
            cgwJnlLogEntry.mCheckOpenTime = cgwJnlLogEntry.mTransTime;   //default time if no check.

            cgwJnlLogEntry.mType = (byte)type;

            cgwJnlLogEntry.mStatus = new byte[1];
            cgwJnlLogEntry.mStatus[0] = 0;

            cgwJnlLogEntry.mRequestGuid = Guid.NewGuid();

        /// <summary>
        ///     Simphony 2.8: Encapsulated
        /// </summary>
        private static void SetEntryFromCheck( CGwJournalLogEntry cgwJnlLogEntry, GuestCheck check )
            if ( check == null )
                cgwJnlLogEntry.mGuid = new CGwDruid(); // zero guid
            else
                cgwJnlLogEntry.mRvcDbId = check.RevenueCenterID;
                cgwJnlLogEntry.mCheckNum = check.CheckNumber;
                cgwJnlLogEntry.mCheckOpenTime = check.CheckOpenTime;

                if ( check.CheckOpenTime == DateTime.MinValue )
                    cgwJnlLogEntry.mCheckOpenTime = DateTime.UtcNow;

                cgwJnlLogEntry.mGuid = CgwDruidExt.StringToCGwDruid( check.Guid  );

        private void GenerateNonSalesJournalEntry( CGwJournalLogEntry cgwJnlLogEntry, JournalType type, int transactionNumber )
            cgwJnlLogEntry.mJournalID = transactionNumber;

            SetEntryFromTransState( cgwJnlLogEntry, mTransState, type  );
            cgwJnlLogEntry.mGuid = new CGwDruid();

        private void GenerateCMNonSalesJournalEntry(CGwCMJournalLogEntry cgwJnlLogEntry, JournalType type, int transactionNumber)
            cgwJnlLogEntry.mJournalID = transactionNumber;

            SetCMEntryFromTransState(cgwJnlLogEntry, mTransState, type);
            cgwJnlLogEntry.mGuid = new CGwDruid();

        //TODO: Used by check discarded code that doesn't have access to TransState? This needs to be changed to fix the TODO below yesterday and simplify the code
        private static void GenerateNonSalesJournalEntry( CGwJournalLogEntry cgwJnlLogEntry,
                                                          DbKey.RevCtrID rvcDbId,
                                                          long emplDbId,
                                                          DbKey.WorkstationID wsId,
                                                          JournalType type,
                                                          byte status,
                                                          int checkNum,
                                                          DateTime checkOpenTime,
                                                          CGwDruid checkGuid )
            try
                cgwJnlLogEntry.mJournalID = GetNextTransNum(null);      // TODO: BryCarey - Need to deal with this null and actually update the database with the proper NextTransNum
                cgwJnlLogEntry.mUwsDbId = wsId;
                cgwJnlLogEntry.mRvcDbId = rvcDbId;
                cgwJnlLogEntry.mEmplDbId = emplDbId;

                if( checkNum <= 0 || checkGuid == null )
                    cgwJnlLogEntry.mGuid = new CGwDruid();
                else
                    cgwJnlLogEntry.mGuid = checkGuid;

                SetCommonDataInEntry( cgwJnlLogEntry, type, status, checkNum, checkOpenTime );
            catch( Exception e )
                LogException( e, "non sales" );
                cgwJnlLogEntry = null;

        /// <summary>
        ///     Encapsulated common code
        /// </summary>
        private static void SetCommonDataInEntry( CGwJournalLogEntry cgwJnlLogEntry, JournalType type, byte status, int checkNum, DateTime checkOpenTime )
            cgwJnlLogEntry.mCheckNum = checkNum;
            cgwJnlLogEntry.mTransTime = DateTime.UtcNow;
            cgwJnlLogEntry.mType = (byte)type;

            // If the check time is bogus (i.e. there is no check ), use the trans time to avoid problems
            // with this non-nullable field in the DB.  The db datetime type doesn't like dates before 1753.
            cgwJnlLogEntry.mCheckOpenTime = (checkOpenTime.Year > 2000) ? checkOpenTime : cgwJnlLogEntry.mTransTime;
            cgwJnlLogEntry.mStatus = new byte[ 1 ];
            cgwJnlLogEntry.mStatus[ 0 ] = status;

            cgwJnlLogEntry.mRequestGuid = Guid.NewGuid();

        /// <summary>
        ///     Populate CGwJournalLogEntry object.
        /// </summary>
        private void GenerateSalesJournalEntry( CGwJournalLogEntry cgwJnlLogEntry, JournalType type, int transactionNumber, GuestCheck check )
            try
                cgwJnlLogEntry.mJournalID = transactionNumber;

                //TODO_FUTURE: Combine these 2?
                SetEntryFromTransState( cgwJnlLogEntry, mTransState, type );
                SetEntryFromCheck( cgwJnlLogEntry, check );
            catch( Exception e )
                LogException( e, "sales" );

        #endregion CGwJournalLogEntry data object init methods

        #region Journal formatter methods

        /// <summary>
        /// Log no sale journal.
        /// </summary>
        internal void LogNoSaleJournal( ref CGwJournalLogEntry entry, string reasonName, string sessionID,int drawerNumber)
            ClearLists();

            entry = new CGwJournalLogEntry();
            GetNoSaleEntry(entry, null /*GuestCheck*/, EJournalIds.NoSale, JournalType.NoSale, reasonName, sessionID,drawerNumber);
            return;

        // SCR#5013: gyou: Internationalzation support
        private static string CurrencyToString( decimal data, TransactionState transState )
            return Micros.PosCore.Common.MathUtils.CurrencyToString(data, transState.BaseCurrencyDP, transState.TransCultureInfo.NumberFormat );

        // SCR#5013: gyou: Internationalzation support
        private string CurrencyToString( decimal data )

        /// <summary>
        /// Formats the currency amount to a specified number of decimal places.
        /// </summary>
        private string CurrencyToString(decimal data, int decimalPlaces)
