        /// <summary>
        /// Log no sale journal.
        /// </summary>
        internal void LogTransCancelJournal( GuestCheck check, decimal amount, ref CGwJournalLogEntry entry  )
            ClearLists();

            entry = new CGwJournalLogEntry();

            if( check.TF_CLSD_CHK_EDIT )
                AddCenteredLine( PosCoreTransText.Text.GetString( ECheckStatesIds.Closed ) );

            string transCancelText = PosCoreTransText.Text.GetString( EJournalIds.TransactionCancel );
            string totalString = CurrencyToString( amount );
            AddLineLeftAndRight( transCancelText, totalString );

            GetSimpleEntry( entry, check, EJournalIds.None, JournalType.TransCancel );
            return;

        internal void LogAutoFireCheckFiredIndicationJournal(GuestCheck check)
            ClearLists();

            string afLine = StringUtils.SafeStringFormat(PosCoreTransText.Text.GetString(EJournalIds.AutofireCheckFired), check.CheckNumber);
            AddCenteredLine(afLine);

            LogSalesEntry(EJournalIds.None, JournalType.AutofireCheckFired, check, true, null);
            ClearLists();

        internal void LogRoundCancelJournal( GuestCheck check, decimal amount )
            ClearLists();

            if( check.TF_CLSD_CHK_EDIT )
                AddCenteredLine( PosCoreTransText.Text.GetString( EPrintingIds.ClosedCheck ).ToUpper() );

            string transCancelText = GetText( EJournalIds.RoundCancel );
            AddLineLeftAndRight( transCancelText, CurrencyToString(amount) );

            LogSalesEntry( EJournalIds.None, JournalType.TransCancel, check, true /*addCheckHeader*/, null );
            ClearLists();

        //Used by Transaction Services and OPS
        //FPS-67461 | PARTCHAT | Added an additional parameter to set the sorting StartRoundNumber to 0 for an AF check that is being fired so that the POS journal receives
        //an image of the "real" check
        internal void LogTransactionJournal( GuestCheck check, IDbEmployee employee, IPrintInfo printInfo, DbTenderMedia tenderMedia, bool logFullFiredAfCheck = false )
            LogTransactionJournal(mLangId, check, employee, printInfo, tenderMedia, null, logFullFiredAfCheck);

        //98251 | An overloaded method to directly support Journals for timed fire items by minimizing
        //the sorting effort. The timedFiredDetailLinks collection will hold the detaillink of all the timed fired items.
        internal void LogTransactionJournal(GuestCheck check, IDbEmployee employee, IPrintInfo printInfo, DbTenderMedia tenderMedia, List<int> firedHeldItemOrTimedFiredDetailLinks)
            LogTransactionJournal(mLangId, check, employee, printInfo, tenderMedia, firedHeldItemOrTimedFiredDetailLinks);

        internal void LogTransactionJournal(int langID, GuestCheck check, IDbEmployee employee, IPrintInfo printInfo, DbTenderMedia tenderMedia,
            List<int> firedHeldItemOrTimedFiredDetailLinks, bool logFullFiredAfCheck = false )
            try
                ClearLists();

                // Do not print sales transaction on journal if option set
                if( !check.TF_CLSD_CHK_EDIT && check.RvcParmDef.Confirm.JnlDoNotPrntSales )
                    return;

                // Do not print journal if nothing has been entered this round.
                // This part moved from 1.X to here for the "matching exact 1.X"'s sake.
                // Not Sure what this big "if" means.
                // probably means, do not print if
                // - Nothing actively entered in current round.
                // - Auto SVC did not go from ON to OFF, which
                //   knock the previous auto svc out of the check.
                // - Not split check
                // - Not adjust closed check
                // - Not new check
                if ( check.Detail.GetReverseActiveCurrentRoundDetailList() == null &&
                        !check.OriginalCheckAsvcOnThenOff &&
                        !( check.SplitOutCheckCount != 0 ||
                        ( check.SplitFromCheckNum != 0 && check.ChkSplitXfer ) ||
                        ( check.SplitCheckAdded ) ) &&
                        !check.TF_CLSD_CHK_EDIT &&  !check.TF_NEW_CHK )
                    return;

                if ( check.TF_CLSD_CHK_EDIT )
                    AddCenteredHeaderLine( PosCoreTransText.Text.GetString( ECheckStatesIds.ClosedEdit, mLangId ) );

                // Add an image of the check
                GuestCheckPrintParameters parameters = new GuestCheckPrintParameters( printInfo, tenderMedia, 0, null, null );
                parameters.FormatForJournal = true;
                // Adjust closed check should include previous round items
                // Include all items for autofire check

                //98251 | If there are timed fire items being set to be fired despite the fired round we'll be sorting through
                //all the menu items in the check and then keep just the timed fire items left in the check for the journaling purpose.
                if (firedHeldItemOrTimedFiredDetailLinks != null && firedHeldItemOrTimedFiredDetailLinks.Count > 0)
                    parameters.StartRoundNumber = 0;
                else
                    parameters.StartRoundNumber = (check.TF_CLSD_CHK_EDIT || check.DoNotPostTtl || logFullFiredAfCheck) ? 0 : (int)check.RoundNumber;

                parameters.EndRoundNumber = check.RoundNumber;

                //98251 | Passing in the heldItemFired or timed fired item list for journaling purpose.
                GuestCheckPrinting.GetCheckImage( parameters, mLangId, check.CheckTransactionIsActive, mDataLines, firedHeldItemOrTimedFiredDetailLinks );
                GetVoidReasonName();
                LogSalesEntry( EJournalIds.None, JournalType.Transaction, check, true /*addCheckHeader*/, null );

            catch( Exception e )
                LogException( e, "Transaction" );
            finally
                ClearLists();

        internal void LogCheckAddTransferJournal( GuestCheck addTransCheck, GuestCheck curCheck, IDbEmployee orgEmpl, IDbEmployee employee, ECheckStatesIds state )
            ClearLists();
            string addCheckMessage = string.Empty;

            if (state == ECheckStatesIds.Added)
                //TP 19715 - for added checks, clarify which check was added to which
                addCheckMessage = StringUtils.SafeStringFormat(PosCoreTransText.Text.GetString(EJournalIds.AddCheck), addTransCheck.CheckNumber, curCheck.CheckNumber);

                ExecuteLogCheckAddTransferJournal( addTransCheck, curCheck, orgEmpl, employee, state, addCheckMessage );
                ExecuteLogCheckAddTransferJournal( curCheck, addTransCheck, orgEmpl, employee, state, addCheckMessage );
            else
                ExecuteLogCheckAddTransferJournal( addTransCheck, curCheck, orgEmpl, employee, state, addCheckMessage );

        private void ExecuteLogCheckAddTransferJournal( GuestCheck addTransCheck, GuestCheck curCheck, IDbEmployee orgEmpl, IDbEmployee employee, ECheckStatesIds state, string addCheckMessage )
            try
                //
                // If this is a reopen, format line as:-
                // "REOPEN CHECK: 1234"
                //
                if( state == ECheckStatesIds.Reopened )
                    mDataLines.Add(
                                   StringUtils.SafeStringFormat( "{0}: {1}",
                                                                PosCoreTransText.Text.GetString( EJournalIds.ReopenCheck ),
                                                                curCheck.ReopenedFromCheckNum.ToString()));
                //
                // If this is an add, format line as:-
                // "Add a guest check"
                //
                else if( state == ECheckStatesIds.Added )
                    //TP 19715 - for added checks, clarify which check was added to which
                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(addCheckMessage))
                        mDataLines.Add(addCheckMessage);
                //
                // If this is a transfer format next line as:-
                // "Transfer a guest check"
                //
                else
                    AddLine( EJournalIds.TransferCheck );

                //
                // For both chk add and chk xfer,
                // Format line as:-
                // "TBL 1234/5 CHK 1234   123.45 "
                // "1 TOM         RVC NAME       "
                //
                if( state != ECheckStatesIds.Reopened )
                // "TBL 1234/5 CHK 1234   123.45 "
                    // TBL
                    string tbl = String.Empty;
                    if( addTransCheck.RvcParmDef.General.UseTblObjNum && addTransCheck.DiningTableNum > 0 )
                        string strTblNum = addTransCheck.DiningTableNum.ToString();
                        // use last 5 digits of table object number. is it becuase printing length?

                        tbl = StringUtils.SafeStringFormat( "{0} {1}/{2}",
                                                           PosCoreTransText.Text.GetString( EPrintingIds.OrderTableHeader ),
                                                           strTblNum,
                                                           addTransCheck.GroupNum.ToString());
                    else if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(addTransCheck.DiningTableName)) // use table name
                        //TP 19707 - Use DiningTableName instead of the DiningTableID
                        tbl = StringUtils.SafeStringFormat("{0} {1}/{2}",
                                                           PosCoreTransText.Text.GetString( EPrintingIds.OrderTableHeader ),
                                                           addTransCheck.DiningTableName,
                                                           addTransCheck.GroupNum.ToString() );
                    // CHK
                    string chk = StringUtils.SafeStringFormat( "{0} {1}",
                                                              PosCoreTransText.Text.GetString( EPrintingIds.CheckHeader ),
                                                              addTransCheck.CheckNumber.ToString() );
                    // Total
                    if( tbl.Length > 0 )
                        mDataLines.Add(
                                       StringUtils.SafeStringFormat( "{0,-20}{1,-10}{2,10}",
                                                                    tbl,
                                                                    chk,
                                                                    CurrencyToString(addTransCheck.OrigDue)));
                    else
                        mDataLines.Add(
                                       StringUtils.SafeStringFormat( "{0,-20}{1,20}",
                                                                    chk,
                                                                    CurrencyToString(addTransCheck.OrigDue)));

                // From Employee
                if( state == ECheckStatesIds.TransferAccepted )
                    mDataLines.Add( StringUtils.SafeStringFormat( "{0}:", PosCoreTransText.Text.GetString( EJournalIds.TransferCheckFrom )));
                // "1 TOM         RVC NAME       "

                string empl = orgEmpl != null ? orgEmpl.NumPlusFirstName : string.Empty;
                string rvcName = mTransState.RvcParm.Name.GetString( mLangId );

                AddLineLeftAndRight( empl, rvcName );

                // To Employee
                if( state == ECheckStatesIds.TransferAccepted )
                    mDataLines.Add( StringUtils.SafeStringFormat( "{0}:", PosCoreTransText.Text.GetString( EJournalIds.TransferCheckTo ) ));

                    empl = addTransCheck.CheckEmployee != null ? addTransCheck.CheckEmployee.NumPlusFirstName : string.Empty;
                    AddLineLeftAndRight( empl, rvcName );

                LogSalesEntry( EJournalIds.None, JournalType.CheckAddTransfer, curCheck, true /*addCheckHeader*/, null );
            catch( Exception e )
                LogException( e, "Check Add Transfer" );
            finally
                ClearLists();

        public static void LogCheckDiscardedJournal( GuestCheck check, TransactionState transState, string journalInfo)
            try
                // Not set if no-one is signed in.
                long employeeId = DbKey.EmployeeID.FromValue(0);
                if( transState.EmployeeSession.EmployeeSignedIn )
                    employeeId = transState.EmployeeId;

                string total = CurrencyToString(check.TotalDue, transState).PadRight(LINE_WIDTH);

                string journalText;
                LogCheckDiscardedJournal(EJournalIds.ContentsDiscardedMessage, // "WS XX could not save check.."
                                                check.CheckNumber,
                                                transState.RvcId,
                                                employeeId,
                                                total,
                                                CgwDruidExt.StringToCGwDruid(check.Guid),
                                                transState.WorkstationId,
                                                check.CheckOpenTime,
                                                journalInfo,
                                                transState.PostingInterface,
                                                out journalText);
            catch( Exception e )
                LogException( e, "LogCheckDiscardedJournal (transstate)" );

        //TODO: Called from Check Sharing code: NEED to add Journal object to check sharing code in order to re-use code.
        public static void LogCheckDiscardedJournal(EJournalIds extraJournalId,
                                                             int checkNumber,
                                                             DbKey.RevCtrID rvcDbId,
                                                             long employeeId,
                                                             string total,
                                                             CGwDruid checkGuid,
                                                             DbKey.WorkstationID wsId,
                                                             DateTime checkOpenTime,
                                                             string journalInfo,
                                                             PostingInterface pi,
                                                             out string journalText)
            journalText = "";
            try
                CGwJournalLogEntry entry = new CGwJournalLogEntry();
                GenerateNonSalesJournalEntry( entry,
                                              rvcDbId,
                                              employeeId,
                                              wsId,
                                              JournalType.CheckDiscarded,
                                              0,
                                              checkNumber,
                                              checkOpenTime,
                                              checkGuid );

                StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
                string hdr = PosCoreTransText.Text.GetString( EJournalIds.ContentsDiscarded );
                sb.AppendLine( hdr.PadLeft(( LINE_WIDTH + hdr.Length ) / 2 ).PadRight( LINE_WIDTH ));

                string[] words =
                    StringUtils.SafeStringFormat(
                        PosCoreTransText.Text.GetString( extraJournalId ),
                        wsId.ToString(),
                        checkNumber.ToString(),
                        rvcDbId.ToString(),
                        journalInfo).Split( ' ' );
                int len = 0;
                foreach( string word in words )
                    string w = word;
                    if( w.Length > LINE_WIDTH )
                        w = w.Substring( 0, LINE_WIDTH );

                    if ( len + w.Length > LINE_WIDTH )
                        sb.Append( "\n".PadLeft( LINE_WIDTH - len + 1 ));
                        len = 0;

                    sb.Append( w + " " );
                    len += w.Length + 1;
                sb.Append( "\n".PadLeft( LINE_WIDTH - len + 1 ));

                sb.AppendLine(
                    StringUtils.SafeStringFormat( "{0} {1}",
                    PosCoreTransText.Text.GetString( EJournalIds.CheckTotal ),
                    total));

                entry.mJournalText = sb.ToString();
                journalText = entry.mJournalText;

                if( entry != null && !StringUtils.IsEmpty( entry.mJournalText ) )
                    PostTotals.SendJournalLog( pi, entry );
            catch( Exception e )
                LogException( e, "LogCheckDiscardedJournal" );

        internal void LogSplitCheckJournal( GuestCheck mainCheck, GuestCheck splitCheck, IDbEmployee employee, IPrintInfo printInfo )
            try
                ClearLists();

                //Journal entry  for the "Split to check"

                //Format the header (in mLines)
                int transactionNumber = GetNextTransNum(mTransState);

                //Not needed - the header comes from the print image
                //AddHeader( transactionNumber, splitCheck );

                //TPID|141696|Added new information to the check journal report
                AddHeaderLineLeftAndRight(employee.NumPlusFirstName.ToString(), " ");
                AddCenteredHeaderLine(mainCheck.RvcCfg.Name.ToString());

                //142912 | Memo | OPS | Reports | “Memo Check” header does not getting displayed on the Split Check in the Check Journal Reports
                //Added "Memo Check" header for memo checks.
                if (mainCheck.FilteringActive)
                    AddCenteredLine(PosCoreTransText.Text.GetString(EPrintingIds.MemoCheck).ToUpper());

                AddCenteredLine("----------------------------------------");

                //Add "Split From CHK #"
                mHeaderLines.Add( GetCheckLine( EJournalIds.SplitCheckFrom, mainCheck.CheckNumber ) );

                //Add an image of the check
                GuestCheckPrintParameters parameters = new GuestCheckPrintParameters( printInfo, null, 0, null, null );
                parameters.FormatForJournal = true;
                parameters.StartRoundNumber = 0;
                parameters.EndRoundNumber = splitCheck.RoundNumber;
                GuestCheckPrinting.GetCheckImage( parameters, mLangId, splitCheck.CheckTransactionIsActive, mDataLines );

                SendToJournal( JournalType.CheckSplitTo, transactionNumber, splitCheck, false /*showTransactionEmployee*/ );
                ClearLists();

                //Journal entry  for the "Split from check"

                //Add "Split To CHK 1234   $5.00"
                string s = StringUtils.SafeStringFormat( "{0,-30}{1,10}", GetCheckLine( EJournalIds.SplitCheckTo, splitCheck.CheckNumber ), CurrencyToString(splitCheck.TotalDue));
                LogSalesEntry( EJournalIds.None, JournalType.CheckSplitTo, mainCheck, true /*addCheckHeader*/, s );
            catch( Exception e )
                LogException( e, "Split Check" );

        /// <summary>

        /// </summary>
        private string GetCheckLine( EJournalIds journalId, int checkNumber )
            string chkNum = String.Empty;
            fmt_chk_field( checkNumber, ref chkNum );
            // The PosCoreTransText value should always contain the string format place holder for the check number. eg. "Split To {0}"
            return StringUtils.SafeStringFormat(PosCoreTransText.Text.GetString( journalId ), chkNum );

        /// <summary>
        /// Journal record for credit authorization processes.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="check">Current check for credit authorization.</param>
        /// <param name="employee">Employee of check session.</param>
        /// <param name="vData">Credit voucher data.</param>
        internal void LogCaVoucherJournal( GuestCheck check, IDbEmployee employee, IVoucherData vData)
            try
                ClearLists();

                // Temp string for formatting.
                string tmp = String.Empty;

                // Print training mode line
                if( mTransState.TrainingModeActive )
                    tmp = PosCoreTransText.Text.GetString( EJournalIds.CreditAuthorizationTraining ).ToUpper();

                    // Center Text
                    mDataLines.Add(
                        ( tmp.Length > LINE_WIDTH )
                        ? tmp.Substring( 0, LINE_WIDTH )
                        : tmp.PadLeft(( LINE_WIDTH + tmp.Length ) / 2 ));

                // Print check number format as:
                // "CHECK:   1234"
                if( check != null )
                    mDataLines.Add(
                        StringUtils.SafeStringFormat( "{0,-12}: {1}",
                        PosCoreTransText.Text.GetString( EJournalIds.CreditAuthorizationCheck ).ToUpper(),
                        check.CheckNumber.ToString() ));

                // Print table format as:
                // "TABLE:   1234/99"
                if ( check != null &&
                    fmt_tbl_num_grp( check, ref tmp ))
                    mDataLines.Add(
                        StringUtils.SafeStringFormat( "{0,-12}: {1}",
                        PosCoreTransText.Text.GetString( EJournalIds.CreditAuthorizationCheck ).ToUpper(),
                        tmp ));

                // Print server information as:
                // "SERVER:  1234 ARMSTRONG"
                if ( employee != null )
                    tmp =
                        StringUtils.SafeStringFormat( "{0,-12}: {1}",
                        PosCoreTransText.Text.GetString( EJournalIds.CreditAuthorizationServer ).ToUpper(), employee.NumPlusCheckName );

                    // Truncate to line max char
                    if( tmp.Length > LINE_WIDTH )
                        tmp.Substring( 0, LINE_WIDTH );

                    mDataLines.Add( tmp );

                // Timestamp
                timetoa( DateTime.UtcNow, ref tmp, mTransState );
                mDataLines.Add(
                    StringUtils.SafeStringFormat( "{0,-12}: {1}",
                    PosCoreTransText.Text.GetString( EJournalIds.CreditAuthorizationDate ).ToUpper(),
                    tmp ));

                // Credit card type
                // "CARD TYPE:   tmed name "
                if( vData != null && !StringUtil.IsBlank( vData.CardName ))
                    mDataLines.Add(
                        StringUtils.SafeStringFormat( "{0,-12}: {1}",
                        PosCoreTransText.Text.GetString( EJournalIds.CreditAuthorizationCardType ).ToUpper(),
                        vData.CardName ));

                // Print the account number
                if ( vData != null && !StringUtil.IsBlank( vData.MaskedCardNumber ))
                    mDataLines.Add(
                        StringUtils.SafeStringFormat( "{0,-12}: {1}",
                        PosCoreTransText.Text.GetString( EJournalIds.CreditAuthorizationAccountNumber ).ToUpper(),
                        vData.MaskedCardNumber ));

                // Print the expiration date " EXP DATE:  06/94"
                // NOTE: use the date returned from the unpack_cc_account_info call
                //       instead of what is in dtl_ptr->ca_auth_1.exp_date. The later
                //       does not have any data when the card is swipe using lookup key.
                if ( vData != null && vData.ExpDate != 0 )
                    mDataLines.Add(
                        StringUtils.SafeStringFormat( "{0,-12}: {1:D}/{2:D}",
                        PosCoreTransText.Text.GetString( EJournalIds.CreditAuthorizationExpirationDate ).ToUpper(),
                        vData.ExpDate / 100,
                        vData.ExpDate % 100 ));

                // Print the authorization code
                if ( vData != null && !StringUtil.IsBlank( vData.AuthCode ))
                    mDataLines.Add(
                        StringUtils.SafeStringFormat( "{0,-12}: {1}",
                        PosCoreTransText.Text.GetString( EJournalIds.CreditAuthorizationCode ).ToUpper(),
                        vData.AuthCode ));

                if ( vData.DriverData != null && vData.DriverData.Count > 0 )
                    foreach ( string driverData in vData.DriverData )
                        if( StringUtils.IsBlank( driverData ))
                            continue;

                        mDataLines.Add( driverData );

                        if( !mTransState.RvcParm.Credit.FullDriverData )
                            mDataLines.Add(
                                           StringUtils.SafeStringFormat( "{0,-12}{1}",
                                                                        PosCoreTransText.Text.GetString( EPrintingIds.VoucherInfo ),
                                                                        driverData ));
                            break;

                //svc code CA_OB_3C_SVC_CODE_ON_VOUCHER
                if ( mTransState.RvcParm.Credit._3cSvcCodeOnVoucher )
                    mDataLines.Add(
                        StringUtils.SafeStringFormat( "{0,-12}{1}",
                        PosCoreTransText.Text.GetString( EPrintingIds.VoucherServiceChargeCode ),
                        vData.SvcCode ));

                if ( mTransState.PropertyParm.Credit.TotalOnVoucher ) // Print total
                    tmp = PosCoreTransText.Text.GetString( EJournalIds.CreditAuthorizationTotal ).ToUpper();
                else // Print subtotal
                    tmp = PosCoreTransText.Text.GetString( EJournalIds.CreditAuthorizationSubtotal ).ToUpper();

                mDataLines.Add(
                    StringUtils.SafeStringFormat( "{0,-12}: {1}",
                    tmp,
                    CurrencyToString(vData.AuthAmount)));

                LogSalesEntry( EJournalIds.None, JournalType.CaVoucher, check, true /*addCheckHeader*/, null );
            catch( Exception e )
                LogException( e, "CA Voucher" );
            finally
                ClearLists();

        /// <summary>
        /// Journal record for a failed credit authorization process.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="check">Current check for credit authorization.</param>
        /// <param name="employee">Employee of check session.</param>
        /// <param name="failedMessage">PSP returned error message.</param>
        internal void LogCaFailedJournal(GuestCheck check, IDbEmployee employee, string failedMessage)
            try
                ClearLists();

                // Temp string for formatting.
                string tmp = String.Empty;

                // Print training mode line
                if (mTransState.TrainingModeActive)
                    tmp = PosCoreTransText.Text.GetString(EJournalIds.CreditAuthorizationTraining).ToUpper();

                    // Center Text
                    mDataLines.Add(
                        (tmp.Length > LINE_WIDTH)
                        ? tmp.Substring(0, LINE_WIDTH)
                        : tmp.PadLeft((LINE_WIDTH + tmp.Length) / 2));

                // Print check number format as:
                // "CHECK:   1234"
                if (check != null)
                    mDataLines.Add(
                        StringUtils.SafeStringFormat("{0,-12}: {1}",
                        PosCoreTransText.Text.GetString(EJournalIds.CreditAuthorizationCheck).ToUpper(),
                        check.CheckNumber.ToString()));

                // Print table format as:
                // "TABLE:   1234/99"
                if (check != null &&
                    fmt_tbl_num_grp(check, ref tmp))
                    mDataLines.Add(
                        StringUtils.SafeStringFormat("{0,-12}: {1}",
                        PosCoreTransText.Text.GetString(EJournalIds.CreditAuthorizationCheck).ToUpper(),
                        tmp));

                // Print server information as:
                // "SERVER:  1234 ARMSTRONG"
                if (employee != null)
                    tmp =
                        StringUtils.SafeStringFormat("{0,-12}: {1}",
                        PosCoreTransText.Text.GetString(EJournalIds.CreditAuthorizationServer).ToUpper(), employee.NumPlusCheckName);

                    // Truncate to line max char
                    if (tmp.Length > LINE_WIDTH)
                        tmp.Substring(0, LINE_WIDTH);

                    mDataLines.Add(tmp);

                // Timestamp
                timetoa(DateTime.UtcNow, ref tmp, mTransState);
                mDataLines.Add(
                    StringUtils.SafeStringFormat("{0,-12}: {1}",
                    PosCoreTransText.Text.GetString(EJournalIds.CreditAuthorizationDate).ToUpper(),
                    tmp));

                // Note we don't get IssuerId / masked card number on a failure so not writing

                AddCenteredLine(StringUtils.SafeStringFormat(PosCoreTransText.Text.GetString(EJournalIds.CreditAuthorizationFailureMsg)));

                // Add failure reason.
                mDataLines.Add(
                    StringUtils.SafeStringFormat("{0,-12}: {1}",
                    PosCoreTransText.Text.GetString(EJournalIds.CreditAuthorizationFailed).ToUpper(),
                    failedMessage));

                // FPS-81314.  Log to Journal failed auth attempts.  Using differing JournalType to enable specific filtering.
                LogSalesEntry(EJournalIds.None, JournalType.CaFailedAuth, check, true /*addCheckHeader*/, null);
            catch (Exception e)
                LogException(e, "CA Failed");
            finally
                ClearLists();

        internal PosCoreResult LogCashDrawerJournal( IAppOfflineInfo info, int drawerNumber, IDbEmployee employee, JournalType journalType, EJournalIds journalId )
            try
                int transactionNumber = GetNextTransNum(mTransState);
                AddNonSalesHeader(transactionNumber);

                if( journalType == JournalType.AssignCashDrawer || journalType == JournalType.UnassignCashDrawer )
                    AddLine( journalId, drawerNumber );
                    mDataLines.Add( employee.NumPlusCheckName ); // Return the check name if there is one, else use the first or last name
                else if( journalType == JournalType.PmcCashDrawerOpen )
                    mDataLines.Add( StringUtils.SafeStringFormat( "{0}:{1} {2}",
                        PosCoreTransText.Text.GetString( EJournalIds.PMCTestOpenDrawer ),
                        PosCoreTransText.Text.GetString( EJournalIds.CashDrawer ),
                        drawerNumber.ToString()));
                else
                    AddLine( journalId );

                return SendToJournal(journalType, transactionNumber, null, true /*showTransactionEmployee*/  );
            catch( Exception e )
                LogException( e, "Cash Drawer" );

            return new PosCoreResult( EPosCoreResultIds.Failure );

        /// <summary>
        ///     Add the detail for each active seat.
        /// </summary>
        private void FormatSeatDetail()
            int numSeats = 0;
            int previousSeat = mCheck.Seat;
            // FPS-26432 | vaipraka | ToList() returns a new list from the IEnumerable. Without ToList() any changes on SeatFilter will reflect on previous variable.
            var previous = mCheck.Detail.SeatFilter.ToList();
            foreach (int seat in mCheck.GetOpenSeats())
                // FPS-34141 | PORT 19.2.1 | FPS-33294 | vaipraka | Clearing the seatfilter and only adding the current seat.
                // Moved the filtering logic from CalculateTotals, so that mSortedList contains the prorated manual service charge corresponding to each seat.
                mCheck.Detail.SeatFilter.Clear();
                mCheck.Detail.SeatFilter.Add(seat);
                mCheck.SetCurrentSeat(seat);
                mCheck.UpdateManualServiceCharges();                          //Calculate the service charge for a particular seat at a time.
                SortCheckDetail(seat, true /*sortBySeat*/ );                 //Get the list of items for a particular seat.
                if (mSortedList.Count <= 0)
                    continue;

                //Simphony 2.6: If this is the 2nd/3rd/4th seat, add the check header. We already have the header for the 1st check.
                if (mPrintFullSeatCheck && numSeats >= 1)
                    CutPaperAndPrintHeaderForNextSeat();

                numSeats++;
                PrintSeatHeader(seat);

                //Calculate Totals for the  seat
                mCheck.CalculateTotals(mDefs.CurrencyParameters, mDefs.TaxParameters);

                //Print Seat items and totals
                PrintSection(FormatCheckDetail, CustomReceiptEventArgs.DetailAction, CustomReceiptEventArgs.CustomDetail);
                //106044 Belgian tax Label - umacherl
                //Printing a new section for discounts and service charge with tax labels
                if (mDefs.BelgiumGuestCheck)
                    FormatStandardDiscountServiceChargeWithTaxLabelTotals();
                PrintSection(FormatStandardSummaryTotals, CustomReceiptEventArgs.SummaryTotalsAction, CustomReceiptEventArgs.CustomSummaryTotals);

                if (mPrintFullSeatCheck)
                    PrintSection(FormatStandardPreTrailer, CustomReceiptEventArgs.PreTrailerAction, CustomReceiptEventArgs.CustomPreTrailer);
                    PrintSection(FormatStandardCheckTrailer, CustomReceiptEventArgs.TrailerAction, CustomReceiptEventArgs.CustomTrailer);
                else
                    AddBlankLines(1);

            //This prints a header "All Seats" with no items. I think this is intended to nform the user that the checks for all customers have been printed.
            if (!mPrintFullSeatCheck)
                PrintAllSeatsHeader(numSeats);

            // FPS-34141 | PORT 19.2.1 | FPS-33294 | vaipraka | Resetting the seat filter and the current seat.
            mCheck.Detail.SeatFilter = previous;
            mCheck.SetCurrentSeat(previousSeat);
            mCheck.UpdateManualServiceCharges(); // Recalculate manual service charge for the check.
            //Recalculate check tootals instead of seat totals
            mCheck.CalculateTotals(mDefs.CurrencyParameters, mDefs.TaxParameters);

        private void CutPaperAndPrintHeaderForNextSeat()

        /// <summary>

        public static EPrintingIds GetWeightUnitPrintingId(DbPropertyParameter propertyParam)
            if (propertyParam.General.ItemWeightsInOunces)
                return EPrintingIds.Ounces;
            else if (propertyParam.General.ItemWeightsInKg)
                return EPrintingIds.Kilograms;
            else
                return EPrintingIds.Lbs;

        private void SortCheckDetail(int seat, bool sortBySeat = false)
            CheckDetailSorter sorter = new CheckDetailSorter();
            SortAndConsolidateParameters parameters = new SortAndConsolidateParameters();
            parameters.IsClosedCheckVoid = mCheck.ClosedCheckVoid;

            if (mIsCustReceipt)
                parameters.SetForReceipt(mCheck.RvcParmDef, mParameters.RoundByRound);
            else if (mIsForJournal)
                parameters.SetForJournal(mParameters.StartRoundNumber, mParameters.EndRoundNumber);
            else
                parameters.SetForGuestCheck(mCheck.RvcParmDef, mParameters.RoundByRound);

            parameters.Masking.StartRoundNumber = mParameters.StartRoundNumber;
            parameters.Masking.EndRoundNumber = mParameters.EndRoundNumber;
            parameters.Masking.CheckDetailLinks = mParameters.CheckDetailLinks;

            //98251 | Indicator to hold if it is meant for Journal entries
            parameters.IsForJournal = mParameters.FormatForJournal;

            //TPID:21127 with new SortAndconsolidateParameters object instantiated here the paramaters need to be updated with the voidClosedCheck related settings too
            if (mCheck.ClosedCheckVoid)
                int roundNumber = mCheck.Detail.GetMaxRoundNumber(true /*printableItemsOnly*/ );
                parameters.Masking.SetRoundbyRound(roundNumber, roundNumber);
                parameters.Masking.IncludeCurrentRoundVoids = true;
                parameters.Masking.ExcludeVoidedItems = false;
                parameters.Masking.IncludeVoidItemsOnVoidedClosedCheck = mDefs.RvcParm.Format.VoidClosedCheckPrintFull;

            //106044 Belgian Tax Label - umacherl
            //Consolidating previous rounds if this flag is on.
            parameters.Consolidation.DoNotConsolidateCurentRound = mDefs.RvcParm.Format.DoNotConsolidateCurrentRound ? true : false;

            //106044 Belgian Tax Label - umacherl
            //Enabling printing of guest check with count 1 in case of combo sides.
            parameters.IsForBelgium = mDefs.BelgiumGuestCheck ? true : false;

            //TPID: #156973 --- PORT | Tax Parameters | enabling option 17 (Enable Tax Labels) removes discount and service charge names from guest check
            //To fix the issue above, commented code line below. T.Liang, 01/17/2018.
            //parameters.Masking.IncludeMenuItemsOnly = parameters.IsForBelgium;

            sorter.Seat = seat;
            sorter.SortBySeat = sortBySeat;
            sorter.Sort(parameters, mCheck, null, mDefs.BaseCurrencyDp, out mSortedList, mFormatter.NumFmtInfo);

            // TPID : 21127 we want the check details to be printed in proper order not in reverse order, but closed check void reverses order so fixing it here
            if (mCheck.ClosedCheckVoid)
                mSortedList.Reverse();

        //This will sort all level 1 condiments. This could be a mix of required and allowed condiments.
        //Condiments of condiments are also sorted.
        // 130527 | gwelivita | Pass the sorter type to sort condiments
        private void SortCondiments(MiSortedDetail mi, IComparer<MiSortedDetail> sorter)
            if (!((DbMenuItemDetail)mi.DetailList[0]).SortCndmntsByPg)
                return;

            // 130527 | gwelivita | Check if required to sort only allowed condiments.
            if (mSortAllowedCondimentsOnly)
                if (mi.Condiments.Count > 1)
                    mi.Condiments = SortAllowedCondiments(mi.Condiments, sorter);  // 130527 | gwelivita | Call allowed condiment sorting method.

                //Now sort the condiments of the condiments
                if (mi.Condiments.Count > 0)
                    foreach (MiSortedDetail cond in mi.Condiments)
                        SortCondiments(cond, sorter);     //Recursive call to sort the condiments of the condiments

                return;

            if (sorter is CondimentSorting)
                if (mi.Condiments.Count > 1)
                    mi.Condiments.Sort(sorter);

                //Now sort the condiments of the condiments
                if (mi.Condiments.Count > 0)
                    foreach (MiSortedDetail cond in mi.Condiments)
                        SortCondiments(cond, sorter);     //Recursive call to sort the condiments of the condiments

        private void MoveDiscountCouponsToTop()
            int insertPosition = 0;

            // 126121 | mzameer | If seat fitlering is on, then the seat filtering indicator should be on top.
            // Coupons will be second.
            if (mParameters.SeatFilteringActive)
                insertPosition = 1;

            var automaticDiscountList = guestCheck.Detail.GetActiveDiscountList().Where(d => d.AutoDiscount).ToList();
            for (int i = 0; i < List.Count; i++)
                if (List[i] is DscSortedDetail discount && discount.DetailItem.DiscountCoupon && (i >= insertPosition) )
                    bool couponUsed = IsCouponUsed(discount.DetailItem.DetailLink, automaticDiscountList);
                    if (couponUsed)
                        List.RemoveAt(i);
                        i--;
                    else
                        SortedDetailBase item = List[i];
                        List.RemoveAt(i);
                        List.Insert(insertPosition++, item);
